=== web/src/auth/session.test.ts
// @vitest-environment node
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { authFetch, login, onSignedOut, __resetSessionForTests } from './session';

const BASE = 'http://localhost:5134';

type Call = { auth: string | null; body: string };
let fake: {
  refreshCount: number;
  refreshOk: boolean;
  validToken: string; // the only token the fake API accepts
  nextToken: string; // what /auth/refresh hands out
  calls: Call[]; // every non-auth request the fake saw
};

const json = (data: unknown) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

beforeEach(() => {
  __resetSessionForTests(); // fresh module state for every test
  fake = { refreshCount: 0, refreshOk: true, validToken: 'new', nextToken: 'new', calls: [] };

  // Fake API. openapi-fetch passes a Request object, so we handle Request AND string URLs.
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const isReq = input instanceof Request;
    const url = isReq ? input.url : String(input);
    const headers = isReq ? input.headers : new Headers(init?.headers);

    if (url.endsWith('/auth/login')) return json({ accessToken: 'old' });
    if (url.endsWith('/auth/refresh')) {
      fake.refreshCount++;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20)); // delay so the race can really happen
      if (!fake.refreshOk) return new Response(null, { status: 401 });
      return json({ accessToken: fake.nextToken });
    }

    const body = isReq ? await input.clone().text() : String(init?.body ?? '');
    const auth = headers.get('Authorization');
    fake.calls.push({ auth, body });
    return auth === `Bearer ${fake.validToken}` ? json({ ok: true }) : new Response(null, { status: 401 });
  });
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

const get = () => authFetch(new Request(`${BASE}/api/v1/stokvels`));

describe('session', () => {
  it('five parallel 401s cause exactly one refresh', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw'); // token "old" is not accepted by the fake
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get(), get(), get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([200, 200, 200, 200, 200]);
  });

  it('a later expiry starts a new refresh', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    await Promise.all([get(), get(), get(), get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);

    // token "expires": the fake now only accepts "newer"
    fake.validToken = 'newer';
    fake.nextToken = 'newer';
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(2); // the first promise was cleared
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([200, 200]);
  });

  it('a failed refresh signs out once', async () => {
    fake.refreshOk = false;
    const signedOut = vi.fn();
    onSignedOut(signedOut);
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get()]);
    expect(signedOut).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(2); // each request sent once, never retried
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([401, 401]);
  });

  it('no token means no loop', async () => {
    fake.refreshOk = false; // fresh visitor: no cookie
    const res = await get();
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1); // one refresh attempt
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(1); // one request
    expect(res.status).toBe(401); // comes straight back
  });

  it('a POST body survives the retry', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ amount: 500 });
    const res = await authFetch(
      new Request(`${BASE}/api/v1/contributions`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: payload,
      }),
    );
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(2); // first try 401, retry 200
    expect(fake.calls[0].body).toBe(payload);
    expect(fake.calls[1].body).toBe(payload); // same body on the retry
  });
});

=== web/src/auth/session.ts
/*
 * WHY THE REFRESH MUST BE SINGLE-FLIGHT FOR MY API:
 * My API rotates the refresh cookie, so every refresh uses up the cookie it was sent with.
 * If five requests expire together and each sends its own refresh with the SAME old cookie,
 * the first wins and the other four are rejected ([FILL IN: the status you saw in check 5,
 * e.g. 401 or 409]), which would sign the member out. One shared refresh avoids that.
 *
 * This is the ONLY file in the project that reads or writes the access token.
 */
import { apiErrorFromResponse } from '../api/apiError';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../api/config';

// Token lives only in this variable (never in browser storage, JS-set cookies, or React state)
let accessToken: string | null = null;
// The refresh that is currently running (shared by everyone who asks at the same time)
let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
const signedOutListeners = new Set<() => void>();

// The rest of the app subscribes here to hear "member signed out"
export function onSignedOut(listener: () => void): () => void {
  signedOutListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    signedOutListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function notifySignedOut() {
  signedOutListeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

// Reads accessToken out of a JSON body without hand-writing a type
function tokenFrom(body: unknown): string | null {
  if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'accessToken' in body && typeof body.accessToken === 'string') {
    return body.accessToken;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/login`, {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'include', // so the browser stores the refresh cookie
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw await apiErrorFromResponse(res);
  const token = tokenFrom(await res.json());
  if (!token) throw new Error('Login response had no access token');
  accessToken = token;
}

export async function logout(): Promise<void> {
  const tokenBefore = accessToken;
  accessToken = null; // forget the token first, no matter what happens next
  try {
    await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/logout`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
      headers: tokenBefore ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenBefore}` } : {},
    });
  } catch {
    // network failed: we still sign out locally
  } finally {
    notifySignedOut(); // always tell the app
  }
}

// The real refresh call. Success stores the token; failure clears it and signs out.
async function doRefresh(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    const token = res.ok ? tokenFrom(await res.json()) : null;
    if (!token) throw new Error('refresh failed');
    accessToken = token;
    return token;
  } catch {
    accessToken = null;
    notifySignedOut();
    return null;
  }
}

export function refreshAccessToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  // SINGLE-FLIGHT: if a refresh is already running, everyone gets that same promise.
  // .finally clears it (success OR failure) so the next expiry can start a new refresh.
  refreshPromise ??= doRefresh().finally(() => {
    refreshPromise = null;
  });
  return refreshPromise;
}

// Sends a copy of the request with the token and cookie settings added
function send(req: Request, token: string | null): Promise<Response> {
  const headers = new Headers(req.headers);
  if (token) headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  return fetch(new Request(req, { headers, credentials: 'include' }));
}

// The fetch we hand to openapi-fetch
export async function authFetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  // A body can only be read once, so keep a clone for a possible retry
  const retryCopy = request.clone();

  // After a page reload memory is empty: get a token using the cookie first
  if (!accessToken) await refreshAccessToken();

  const tokenUsed = accessToken;
  const response = await send(request, tokenUsed);

  // Not a 401, or we had NO token to begin with: return now (this stops the endless loop)
  if (response.status !== 401 || !tokenUsed) return response;

  // If another request already got a newer token, use it instead of refreshing again
  const freshToken =
    accessToken && accessToken !== tokenUsed ? accessToken : await refreshAccessToken();

  if (!freshToken) return response; // refresh failed, doRefresh already signed us out
  return send(retryCopy, freshToken); // retry exactly once
}

// ONLY for tests: wipes module state between tests
export function __resetSessionForTests() {
  accessToken = null;
  refreshPromise = null;
  signedOutListeners.clear();
}

=== web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useStokvels } from '../api/queries';
import {
  clearSelectedStokvel,
  setSelectedStokvelId,
  useSelectedStokvelId,
} from '../state/selectedStokvel';
import { ErrorView } from './ErrorView';
import { Skeleton } from './Skeleton';
import { StokvelScreen } from './StokvelScreen';

export function Dashboard() {
  const stokvels = useStokvels();
  const selectedId = useSelectedStokvelId();
  const [typedId, setTypedId] = useState('');

  if (stokvels.isPending) return <Skeleton label="Loading your stokvels" />;
  if (stokvels.isError) {
    return <ErrorView error={stokvels.error} onRetry={() => void stokvels.refetch()} />;
  }

  // ADJUST: this assumes GET /stokvels returns an array of { id, name }
  const list = stokvels.data;
  if (list.length === 0) {
    return <p>You are not in any stokvel yet. Ask a treasurer to add you.</p>;
  }

  // The selected id is the ONLY input to the contribution hooks
  const activeId = selectedId ?? list[0].id;

  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor="stokvel-select">Stokvel</label>{' '}
      <select
        id="stokvel-select"
        value={list.some((s) => s.id === activeId) ? activeId : ''}
        onChange={(e) => setSelectedStokvelId(e.target.value)}
      >
        <option value="" disabled>Chooseâ€¦</option>
        {list.map((s) => (
          <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {/* Testing helper: lets you open a stokvel id you don't belong to (to see the 404 view) */}
      <div style={{ margin: '8px 0' }}>
        <label htmlFor="open-by-id">Open a stokvel by id (testing)</label>{' '}
        <input id="open-by-id" value={typedId} onChange={(e) => setTypedId(e.target.value)} />{' '}
        <button onClick={() => typedId && setSelectedStokvelId(typedId.trim())}>Open</button>
      </div>

      <StokvelScreen stokvelId={activeId} onBack={clearSelectedStokvel} />
    </div>
  );
}

=== web/src/components/DueCountdown.tsx
// NEW: "Due today / Due tomorrow / Due in N days / Overdue by N days".
// It re-renders ONCE just after each Johannesburg midnight, not every second (it only shows days).
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { dueCountdown, msUntilNextSaMidnight } from '@/lib/countdown'

export function DueCountdown({ due, cycleStatus }: { due: string; cycleStatus: string }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date())

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cycleStatus !== 'Open') return // Closed / PaidOut cycles have no countdown, so no timer
    // setTimeout (not setInterval): one timer for the next SA midnight. +50ms lands just after it.
    const id = setTimeout(() => setNow(new Date()), msUntilNextSaMidnight(now) + 50)
    return () => clearTimeout(id) // cleanup: StrictMode and unmounting must not leave a timer behind
    // The effect READS `now`, so it must run again when `now` changes: that schedules the next midnight.
  }, [now, cycleStatus])

  const text = dueCountdown(due, now, cycleStatus)
  if (text === null) return null
  return <p className="text-sm font-medium">{text}</p>
}

=== web/src/components/ErrorView.tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { describeError, rateLimitMessage } from '../lib/errorMessages';

// Counts down from "start" seconds; its timer is cleared when the component unmounts
function useCountdown(start: number | null): number | null {
  const [endsAt] = useState(() => (start === null ? null : Date.now() + start * 1000));
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    if (endsAt === null) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [endsAt]);
  return endsAt === null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.ceil((endsAt - now) / 1000));
}

// Reference the member can select and copy and read out to support
export function Reference({ id }: { id: string | null }) {
  if (!id) {
    return <p style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>No reference available (the request never reached RondiTrack).</p>;
  }
  return (
    <p style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
      Reference: <code style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', userSelect: 'all' }}>{id}</code>
    </p>
  );
}

type Props = { error: unknown; onRetry?: () => void; onBack?: () => void };

// The ONE error view every screen uses
export function ErrorView({ error, onRetry, onBack }: Props) {
  const d = describeError(error);
  const seconds = useCountdown(d.retryAfterSeconds);

  // Session ended: App shows the sign-in form, so we show nothing here (no stacked error)
  if (d.kind === 'sessionEnded') return null;

  const message =
    d.kind === 'rateLimited' && seconds !== null
      ? seconds > 0
        ? rateLimitMessage(seconds)
        : 'You can try again now.'
      : d.message;

  return (
    <div role="alert" style={{ border: '1px solid #c33', padding: 16, borderRadius: 8, margin: '16px 0' }}>
      <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>{d.title}</h2>
      <p>{message}</p>
      {d.kind === 'notFound' && onBack && <button onClick={onBack}>Back to my stokvels</button>}
      {d.kind !== 'notFound' && onRetry && (
        // for a 429 the button stays disabled until the countdown reaches zero
        <button onClick={onRetry} disabled={seconds !== null && seconds > 0}>
          Try again
        </button>
      )}
      <Reference id={d.correlationId} />
    </div>
  );
}

=== web/src/components/LoginForm.tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { login } from '../auth/session';
import { describeError } from '../lib/errorMessages';
import { Reference } from './ErrorView';

export function LoginForm({ onSignedIn }: { onSignedIn: () => void }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await login(email, password);
      onSignedIn();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err); // shown through describeError below
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const d = error ? describeError(error, 'login') : null;

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8, maxWidth: 320 }}>
      <h1>Sign in to RondiTrack</h1>
      <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
      <input id="email" type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
      {d?.fieldErrors.email?.map((m) => <small key={m}>{m}</small>)}
      <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
      <input id="password" type="password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
      {d?.fieldErrors.password?.map((m) => <small key={m}>{m}</small>)}
      {d && d.kind !== 'validation' && (
        <div role="alert">
          <p>{d.message}</p>
          <Reference id={d.correlationId} />
        </div>
      )}
      <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Signing inâ€¦' : 'Sign in'}</button>
    </form>
  );
}

=== web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx
// NEW: one badge for every RondiTrack status. It takes a KIND as well as a status, because
// "Paid" (a member's claim) and "PaidOut" (the whole pot went out) must never look alike.
// Every badge shows a WORD + an ICON + a tone: never colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
import {
  Banknote, Check, CheckCheck, CircleDot, Clock, Info, Lock, TriangleAlert, type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { formatCents } from '@/lib/money'

export type StatusKind = 'cycle' | 'contribution'

// Light + dark colour pairs chosen for 4.5:1 text contrast. Measure them in DevTools (README table).
const TONE = {
  indigo: 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 dark:border-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200',
  slate: 'border-slate-300 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 dark:border-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100',
  violet: 'border-violet-300 bg-violet-100 text-violet-900 dark:border-violet-800 dark:bg-violet-950 dark:text-violet-200',
  amber: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200',
  sky: 'border-sky-300 bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950 dark:text-sky-200',
  green: 'border-green-300 bg-green-100 text-green-900 dark:border-green-800 dark:bg-green-950 dark:text-green-200',
  red: 'border-red-300 bg-red-100 text-red-900 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-red-950 dark:text-red-200',
  neutral: 'border-border bg-muted text-foreground', // theme tokens for the "unknown" look
}

type Look = { label: string; Icon: LucideIcon; tone: string }

const CYCLE_LOOK = new Map<string, Look>([
  ['Open', { label: 'Open', Icon: CircleDot, tone: TONE.indigo }],
  ['Closed', { label: 'Closed', Icon: Lock, tone: TONE.slate }],
  ['PaidOut', { label: 'Paid out', Icon: Banknote, tone: TONE.violet }], // human words, not "PaidOut"
])

const CONTRIBUTION_LOOK = new Map<string, Look>([
  ['Pending', { label: 'Pending', Icon: Clock, tone: TONE.amber }],
  ['Paid', { label: 'Paid, awaiting check', Icon: Check, tone: TONE.sky }], // the member's claim
  ['Confirmed', { label: 'Confirmed', Icon: CheckCheck, tone: TONE.green }], // the treasurer's check
])

export function StatusBadge({ kind, status }: { kind: StatusKind; status: string }) {
  const table = kind === 'cycle' ? CYCLE_LOOK : CONTRIBUTION_LOOK
  // An unknown status shows its raw value in a neutral badge: no crash, no guess
  const look = table.get(status) ?? { label: status, Icon: Info, tone: TONE.neutral }
  const { label, Icon, tone } = look
  return (
    <Badge variant="outline" className={cn('h-auto gap-1 whitespace-normal text-left', tone)}>
      <Icon aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5 shrink-0" />

    </Badge>
  )
}

// Arrears badge: shows only when the caller really owes arrears. No arrears means no badge at all.
export function ArrearsBadge({ cents }: { cents: number | null | undefined }) {

      <TriangleAlert aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5 shrink-0" />

      </span>
    </Badge>
  )

=== web/src/components/StokvelScreen.tsx
import { useContributions, useCycles, useStokvel } from '../api/queries';
import { formatCentsAsRand } from '../lib/rand';
import { ErrorView } from './ErrorView';
import { Skeleton } from './Skeleton';

// NOTE: do not give this component key={stokvelId}. Remounting would hide the keepPreviousData
// bug instead of fixing it, and the Part 4 proof test would no longer prove anything.
export function StokvelScreen({ stokvelId, onBack }: { stokvelId: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const stokvel = useStokvel(stokvelId);
  const cycles = useCycles(stokvelId);

  // Show the open cycle, otherwise the newest one
  const sorted = cycles.data ? [...cycles.data].sort((a, b) => b.number - a.number) : [];
  const cycle = sorted.find((c) => c.status === 'Open') ?? sorted[0];

  const contributions = useContributions(stokvelId, cycle?.id);

  // 1) error state is checked FIRST so a 404 never leaves a spinner forever
  if (stokvel.isError || cycles.isError || contributions.isError) {
    const error = stokvel.error ?? cycles.error ?? contributions.error;
    return (
      <ErrorView
        error={error}
        onBack={onBack}
        onRetry={() => {
          void stokvel.refetch();
          void cycles.refetch();
          void contributions.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  // 2) loading state: skeleton, never the old stokvel's rows
  if (stokvel.isPending || cycles.isPending) return <Skeleton label="Loading stokvel" />;

  // 3) empty state: no cycle yet
  if (!cycle) {
    return (
      <section>
        <h2>{stokvel.data.name}</h2>
        <p>
          No contribution cycle has been started yet. This is normal for a new stokvel. The
          treasurer can start the first cycle.
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (contributions.isPending) return <Skeleton label="Loading contributions" />;

  const rows = contributions.data.pages.flatMap((page) => page.items);
  const totalCents = rows.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.amountCents, 0);

  return (
    <section>
      <h2>{stokvel.data.name}</h2>
      <p>Cycle {cycle.number}</p>

      {/* 3) empty state: cycle exists but nobody has paid yet */}
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p>
          No contributions yet. This is normal for a new cycle. The treasurer can record the
          first contribution once a member pays in.
        </p>
      ) : (
        // 4) data state
        <>
          <p>Total shown: <strong>{formatCentsAsRand(totalCents)}</strong></p>
          <ul>
            {rows.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id}>
                {c.memberName}: {formatCentsAsRand(c.amountCents)} ({c.status})
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {contributions.hasNextPage && (
            <button
              onClick={() => void contributions.fetchNextPage()}
              disabled={contributions.isFetchingNextPage}
            >
              {contributions.isFetchingNextPage ? 'Loadingâ€¦' : 'Load more'}
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// NEW: Light / Dark / System buttons. aria-pressed tells a screen reader which one is on.
import { Monitor, Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react'

import { useTheme, type Theme } from '@/theme/theme-context'

const OPTIONS: { value: Theme; label: string; Icon: typeof Sun }[] = [
  { value: 'light', label: 'Light', Icon: Sun },
  { value: 'dark', label: 'Dark', Icon: Moon },
  { value: 'system', label: 'System', Icon: Monitor },
]

export function ThemeToggle() {

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label="Colour theme" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
      {OPTIONS.map(({ value, label, Icon }) => (
        <Button
          key={value}
          type="button"
          size="sm"
          variant={theme === value ? 'default' : 'outline'}
          aria-pressed={theme === value}
          onClick={() => setTheme(value)}
        >
          <Icon aria-hidden="true" />
          {label}
        </Button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

=== web/src/lib/countdown.test.ts
// NEW: boundary tests for the due-date maths. Every test passes its own "now".
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { dueCountdown, dueDateToDeadline, msUntilNextSaMidnight } from './countdown'

const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso)

describe('dueDateToDeadline', () => {
  it('turns a calendar date into the END of that day in Johannesburg', () => {
    expect(dueDateToDeadline('2026-10-31').toISOString()).toBe('2026-10-31T22:00:00.000Z')
  })

  it('does not treat the date as UTC midnight', () => {
    expect(dueDateToDeadline('2026-10-31').toISOString()).not.toBe('2026-10-31T00:00:00.000Z')
  })

  it('uses the South African day of an instant', () => {
    expect(dueDateToDeadline('2026-10-31T21:59:59Z').toISOString()).toBe('2026-10-31T22:00:00.000Z')
  })

  it('throws on a value that is not a date', () => {
    expect(() => dueDateToDeadline('banana')).toThrow()
  })
})

describe('dueCountdown', () => {
  it('23:30 SAST on the due date is Due today, not overdue', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-31T21:30:00Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Due today')
  })

  it('00:30 SAST on the due date is Due today', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-30T22:30:00Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Due today')
  })

  it('one second after the deadline is Overdue by 1 day', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-31T22:00:01Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Overdue by 1 day')
  })

  it('counts several days overdue', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-11-03T10:00:00Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Overdue by 3 days')
  })

  it('the day before is Due tomorrow', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-30T10:00:00Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Due tomorrow')
  })

  it('later shows Due in N days', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-26T10:00:00Z'), 'Open')).toBe('Due in 5 days')
  })

  it('shows no countdown for Closed or PaidOut cycles', () => {
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-31T10:00:00Z'), 'Closed')).toBeNull()
    expect(dueCountdown('2026-10-31', at('2026-10-31T10:00:00Z'), 'PaidOut')).toBeNull()
  })
})

describe('msUntilNextSaMidnight', () => {
  it('from 23:30 SAST it is 30 minutes', () => {
    expect(msUntilNextSaMidnight(at('2026-10-31T21:30:00Z'))).toBe(30 * 60 * 1000)
  })

  it('from exactly midnight it is 24 hours, not 0', () => {
    expect(msUntilNextSaMidnight(at('2026-10-31T22:00:00Z'))).toBe(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  })
})

=== web/src/lib/countdown.ts
// NEW: South African due-date maths. Pure functions: "now" is always passed in, never read here.
const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000
// South Africa is UTC+2 all year with no daylight saving since 1944, so a fixed offset is safe.
const SA_OFFSET_MS = 2 * 3_600_000
const CALENDAR_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/

// Which South African calendar day an instant falls on (a whole number of days since 1970).
export function saDayIndex(instant: Date): number {
  return Math.floor((instant.getTime() + SA_OFFSET_MS) / MS_PER_DAY)
}

// The South African calendar day a due date means. "2026-10-31" is that day itself;
// an instant like "2026-10-31T21:59:59Z" is the SA day it falls on.
function dueDayIndex(due: string): number {
  if (CALENDAR_DATE.test(due)) {
    const year = Number(due.slice(0, 4))
    const month = Number(due.slice(5, 7))
    const day = Number(due.slice(8, 10))
    return Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day) / MS_PER_DAY
  }
  const instant = new Date(due)
  if (Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())) throw new Error(`not a valid due date: ${due}`)
  return saDayIndex(instant)
}

// The moment the due day ENDS in Johannesburg. "2026-10-31" -> 2026-10-31T22:00:00Z (not 00:00Z).
export function dueDateToDeadline(due: string): Date {
  return new Date((dueDayIndex(due) + 1) * MS_PER_DAY - SA_OFFSET_MS)
}

// Milliseconds until the next Johannesburg midnight. Exactly at midnight it returns 24 hours, never 0.
export function msUntilNextSaMidnight(now: Date): number {
  return (saDayIndex(now) + 1) * MS_PER_DAY - SA_OFFSET_MS - now.getTime()
}

function days(n: number): string {
  return n === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'
}

// The countdown words, or null when no countdown should show (cycle Closed or PaidOut).
export function dueCountdown(due: string, now: Date, cycleStatus: string): string | null {
  if (cycleStatus !== 'Open') return null

  if (now.getTime() >= dueDateToDeadline(due).getTime()) {
    const late = saDayIndex(now) - dueDayIndex(due)
    return `Overdue by ${late} ${days(late)}`
  }

  const left = dueDayIndex(due) - saDayIndex(now)
  if (left === 0) return 'Due today'
  if (left === 1) return 'Due tomorrow'
  return `Due in ${left} days`
}

=== web/src/lib/dates.test.ts
// NEW: tests proving the midnight case and the calendar-date case.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from './dates'

describe('dates', () => {

  it('shows the midnight payment on 01 Nov 2026, 00:30', () => {

=== web/src/lib/dates.ts
// NEW: formats dates in South African time, whatever time zone the laptop is set to.
const TIME_ZONE = 'Africa/Johannesburg'

// "01 Nov 2026, 00:30"
const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-ZA', {
  dateStyle: 'medium',
  timeStyle: 'short',
  timeZone: TIME_ZONE,
})

// "01 Nov 2026"
const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-ZA', {
  dateStyle: 'medium',
  timeZone: TIME_ZONE,
})

// Matches a plain calendar date like "2026-10-31" (no time, no Z)
const CALENDAR_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/

function toDate(value: string): Date {
  // A plain calendar date is already a South African day. Noon UTC (14:00 in SA)
  // means no time zone can push it onto the wrong day.
  const date = CALENDAR_DATE.test(value) ? new Date(`${value}T12:00:00Z`) : new Date(value)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    throw new Error(`not a valid date: ${value}`)
  }
  return date
}

// For UTC instants like "2026-10-31T22:30:00Z" (date AND time, in SA time)
export function formatDateTime(value: string): string {
  return dateTimeFormatter.format(toDate(value))
}

// Date only. Works with both a UTC instant and a calendar date
export function formatDate(value: string): string {
  return dateFormatter.format(toDate(value))
}

  it('gives 0 for a date in the past', () =>
    expect(parseRetryAfter('Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:00:00 GMT', NOW)).toBe(0));
  it('gives null for garbage', () => {
    expect(parseRetryAfter('soon', NOW)).toBeNull();
    expect(parseRetryAfter(null, NOW)).toBeNull();
    expect(parseRetryAfter('', NOW)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('404 says stokvel not found and keeps the reference', () => {
    const d = describeError(new ApiError(404, { correlationId: 'abc' }, null));
    expect(d.kind).toBe('notFound');
    expect(d.title).toBe('Stokvel not found');
    expect(d.correlationId).toBe('abc');
  });
  it('429 shows the number from the header', () => {
    const d = describeError(new ApiError(429, null, '23'));
    expect(d.message).toBe('Too many requests. Try again in 23 seconds.');
  });
  it('wrong password never says which part was wrong', () => {

    expect(d.message).toBe('Email or password is incorrect.');
  });

    expect(d.kind).toBe('network');

=== web/src/lib/errorMessages.ts
import { ApiError } from '../api/apiError';

export type ErrorKind =
  | 'network'
  | 'rateLimited'
  | 'badCredentials'
  | 'sessionEnded'
  | 'notFound'
  | 'validation'
  | 'generic';

export type DescribedError = {
  kind: ErrorKind;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  correlationId: string | null; // null = there is no reference to show
  retryAfterSeconds: number | null;
  fieldErrors: Record<string, string[]>; // keys are lower-case, e.g. "email"
};

// Retry-After is either seconds ("23") or an HTTP date. Returns seconds or null.
export function parseRetryAfter(header: string | null | undefined, now: number = Date.now()): number | null {
  if (!header) return null;
  const text = header.trim();
  if (/^\d+$/.test(text)) return Number(text);
  const when = Date.parse(text);
  if (Number.isNaN(when)) return null;
  return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((when - now) / 1000)); // date in the past = 0
}

export function rateLimitMessage(seconds: number | null): string {
  if (seconds === null) return 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.';
  return `Too many requests. Try again in ${seconds} ${seconds === 1 ? 'second' : 'seconds'}.`;
}

const asString = (v: unknown): string | null => (typeof v === 'string' && v ? v : null);

// Turns ANY error into plain words. Never uses the "detail" field (it can leak internals on a 500).
export function describeError(error: unknown, context: 'data' | 'login' = 'data'): DescribedError {
  const empty = { correlationId: null, retryAfterSeconds: null, fieldErrors: {} };

  // fetch itself failed (API down, no internet): there is no response and no reference
  if (error instanceof TypeError) {
    return {
      ...empty,
      kind: 'network',
      title: "Can't reach RondiTrack",
      message: 'Check your connection.',
    };
  }

  if (!(error instanceof ApiError)) {
    return {
      ...empty,
      kind: 'generic',
      title: 'Something went wrong',
      message: 'Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.',
    };
  }

  const correlationId = asString(error.problem?.correlationId);
  const base = { ...empty, correlationId };

  if (error.status === 429) {
    const seconds = parseRetryAfter(error.retryAfter);
    return {
      ...base,
      kind: 'rateLimited',
      title: 'Too many requests',
      message: rateLimitMessage(seconds),
      retryAfterSeconds: seconds,
    };
  }
  if (error.status === 401) {
    return context === 'login'
      ? { ...base, kind: 'badCredentials', title: 'Sign in failed', message: 'Email or password is incorrect.' }
      : { ...base, kind: 'sessionEnded', title: 'Session ended', message: 'Please sign in again.' };
  }
  if (error.status === 404) {
    return {
      ...base,
      kind: 'notFound',
      title: 'Stokvel not found',
      message: "This stokvel doesn't exist, or you are not a member of it.",
    };
  }
  if (error.status === 400) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    const raw = error.problem?.errors;
    if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) fieldErrors[key.toLowerCase()] = value.map(String);
      }
    }
    return { ...base, kind: 'validation', title: 'Please check your details', message: 'Some fields need your attention.', fieldErrors };
  }
  return {
    ...base,
    kind: 'generic',
    title: 'Something went wrong',
    message: 'Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.',
  };
}

=== web/src/lib/groupContributionsByCycle.test.ts
// NEW: tests for the grouping function.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { UNKNOWN_CYCLE_KEY, groupContributionsByCycle } from './groupContributionsByCycle'

const cycles = [
  { id: 'c1', number: 1 },
  { id: 'c3', number: 3 },
  { id: 'c2', number: 2 },
]

const contributions = [
  { id: 'a', cycleId: 'c3' },
  { id: 'b', cycleId: 'c1' },
  { id: 'c', cycleId: 'c3' },
]

describe('groupContributionsByCycle', () => {
  it('puts the newest cycle first', () => {
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, contributions)
    expect(groups.map((g) => g.key)).toEqual(['c3', 'c2', 'c1'])
  })

  it('still shows a cycle that has no contributions', () => {
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, contributions)
    const empty = groups.find((g) => g.key === 'c2')
    expect(empty?.contributions).toEqual([])
  })

  it('keeps contributions in the order given, under the right cycle', () => {
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, contributions)
    expect(groups[0].contributions.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['a', 'c'])
    expect(groups[2].contributions.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['b'])
  })

  it('puts an unknown cycle id in a final Unknown cycle group and never drops it', () => {
    const withOrphan = [...contributions, { id: 'z', cycleId: 'missing' }]
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, withOrphan)
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1]
    expect(last.key).toBe(UNKNOWN_CYCLE_KEY)
    expect(last.cycle).toBeNull()
    expect(last.contributions.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['z'])
  })

  it('has no Unknown cycle group when nothing is orphaned', () => {
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, contributions)
    expect(groups.some((g) => g.key === UNKNOWN_CYCLE_KEY)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('the total number of contributions out equals the number in', () => {
    const withOrphan = [...contributions, { id: 'z', cycleId: 'missing' }]
    const groups = groupContributionsByCycle(cycles, withOrphan)
    const total = groups.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.contributions.length, 0)
    expect(total).toBe(withOrphan.length)
  })
})

=== web/src/lib/groupContributionsByCycle.ts
// NEW: groups contributions under their cycle. A pure function: no state, no effects, called during render.
// Generic on purpose: it only needs a cycle id + number and a contribution cycleId, so the real types come from the API.
export const UNKNOWN_CYCLE_KEY = 'unknown-cycle'

export type CycleGroup<C, T> = {
  key: string // the cycle id (or "unknown-cycle"): open/closed state is keyed by this, never by position
  cycle: C | null // null only for the "Unknown cycle" group
  contributions: T[]
}

export function groupContributionsByCycle<
  C extends { id: string; number: number },
  T extends { cycleId: string },
>(cycles: readonly C[], contributions: readonly T[]): CycleGroup<C, T>[] {
  const knownIds = new Set(cycles.map((cycle) => cycle.id))
  const byCycle = new Map<string, T[]>()
  const orphans: T[] = []

  // Keep each contribution in the order the API gave it (newest first)
  for (const contribution of contributions) {
    if (knownIds.has(contribution.cycleId)) {
      const list = byCycle.get(contribution.cycleId) ?? []
      list.push(contribution)
      byCycle.set(contribution.cycleId, list)
    } else {
      orphans.push(contribution) // never dropped: it goes to "Unknown cycle"
    }
  }

  // Newest cycle first (highest number). A cycle with no contributions still gets a group.
  const groups: CycleGroup<C, T>[] = [...cycles]
    .sort((a, b) => b.number - a.number)
    .map((cycle) => ({ key: cycle.id, cycle, contributions: byCycle.get(cycle.id) ?? [] }))

  if (orphans.length > 0) {
    groups.push({ key: UNKNOWN_CYCLE_KEY, cycle: null, contributions: orphans })
  }
  return groups
}

=== web/src/lib/money.ts
// NEW: turns an integer number of cents into "R 150,50" without ever using fractional floats.
const zarFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-ZA', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'ZAR',
})

export function formatCents(cents: number): string {
  // Reject 10.5, NaN, Infinity, or numbers too big to be exact
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cents)) {
    throw new Error('not a whole number of cents')
  }

  // BigInt keeps everything as whole numbers, so there is no float rounding at all
  const big = BigInt(cents)
  const negative = big < 0n
  const abs = negative ? -big : big

  // Integer division and remainder: 15050 cents -> 150 rands and 50 cents
  const rands = abs / 100n
  const rest = abs % 100n

  // Build an exact decimal string like "150.50" (pad so 5 cents becomes "05")
  const decimal = `${negative ? '-' : ''}${rands}.${rest.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`

  // Intl accepts an exact decimal string, so it formats without turning it into a float
  return zarFormatter.format(decimal as `${number}`)
}

// Step 7 name: later files import formatRand, so it forwards to formatCents
export function formatRand(value: number): string {
  return formatCents(value)
}

=== web/src/lib/queryClient.ts
import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ApiError } from '../api/apiError';

// Makes a fresh client (tests use this so each test starts clean)
export function createQueryClient() {
  return new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: {
        staleTime: 30_000,
        refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        // 404, 403, 429 will not fix themselves, so never retry any 4xx
        retry: (failureCount, error) => {
          if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status >= 400 && error.status < 500) return false;
          return failureCount < 3;
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

// The one client the real app uses
export const queryClient = createQueryClient();

=== web/src/lib/roles.ts
// NEW: the ONLY place the role strings are compared, so a typo can't silently hide the section.
const TREASURER = 'Treasurer'
const MEMBER = 'Member'
const ADMIN = 'Admin'

export function isTreasurer(role: string): boolean {
  return role === TREASURER
}

// The role is always shown as words (never colour alone)
export function roleLabel(role: string): string {
  if (role === TREASURER) return "You're the Treasurer"
  if (role === MEMBER) return "You're a Member"
  if (role === ADMIN) return "You're an Admin"
  return `Unknown role: ${role}`
}

=== web/src/state/selectedStokvel.ts
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

// The selected stokvel id lives ONLY here (not in browser storage), so sign-out can clear it
let selectedId: string | null = null;
const subscribers = new Set<() => void>();

export function setSelectedStokvelId(id: string | null) {
  selectedId = id;
  subscribers.forEach((s) => s());
}

export function clearSelectedStokvel() {
  setSelectedStokvelId(null);
}

export function useSelectedStokvelId(): string | null {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    (callback) => {
      subscribers.add(callback);
      return () => {
        subscribers.delete(callback);
      };
    },
    () => selectedId,
  );
}

=== web/src/theme/ThemeProvider.tsx
// NEW: remembers the theme choice and puts the "dark" class on <html>. System follows the OS live.
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { THEME_STORAGE_KEY, ThemeContext, type Theme } from './theme-context'

// Storage can be blocked (private browsing), so every read and write is guarded
function readStoredTheme(): Theme {
  try {
    const value = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)
    if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark' || value === 'system') return value
  } catch {
    // storage blocked: fall back to the default
  }
  return 'system'
}

function applyTheme(theme: Theme) {
  const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
  const dark = theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'system' && prefersDark)
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', dark)
  document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = dark ? 'dark' : 'light'
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(readStoredTheme)

  useEffect(() => {
    applyTheme(theme)
    if (theme !== 'system') return
    // System mode: re-apply whenever the operating system switches light/dark
    const media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
    const onChange = () => applyTheme('system')
    media.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    return () => media.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [theme])

  function setTheme(next: Theme) {
    setThemeState(next)
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, next)
    } catch {
      // storage blocked: the choice still works until the page reloads
    }
  }

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
}

=== web/src/theme/theme-context.ts
// NEW: the theme "contract": which values exist and how components read/change them.
import { createContext, useContext } from 'react'

export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'
export const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'ronditrack-theme'

export type ThemeContextValue = { theme: Theme; setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void }
export const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | null>(null)

export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
  const value = useContext(ThemeContext)
  if (!value) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider')
  return value
}

=== API/Controllers/StokvelsController.cs
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using RondiTrack.Web;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using RondiTrack.Api.Common.Paging;
using RondiTrack.Auth;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Services;

namespace RondiTrack.Controllers;

[Route($"{ApiRoutes.V1}/stokvels")]
[ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]   // NEW 6.1: documented on every action
[ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]      // NEW 6.1
public class StokvelsController(
    IStokvelRepository stokvels,
    IStokvelMembershipService membershipService,
    IContributionService contributionService,
    MemberPagingService memberPaging,
    IStokvelAccess access) : RondiControllerBase   // NEW 6.1: access = the 404/403 decision for the contribution check
{
    /// <summary>Lists all stokvels. Platform admins only.</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = AuthConstants.PlatformAdminRole)]   // NEW 6.1: the ONE plain role check in the whole API
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(IReadOnlyList<StokvelResponse>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IReadOnlyList<StokvelResponse>>> GetAll()
    {
        var all = await stokvels.GetAllAsync();
        return Ok(all.Select(s => s.ToResponse()));
    }

    /// <summary>Gets a single stokvel by id. The ETag header is the concurrency token.</summary>
    [HttpGet("{stokvelId:guid}")]
    [RequireStokvelMember]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(StokvelResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<StokvelResponse>> GetById(Guid stokvelId)
    {
        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId) ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");
        ETagHelper.Set(Response, stokvel.Version);   // ADDED 5.3: token leaves the server
        return Ok(stokvel.ToResponse());
    }

    /// <summary>Creates a new stokvel. Any signed-in user (see README gap about the creator).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(StokvelResponse), StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<StokvelResponse>> Create(StokvelRequest request)
    {
        var stokvel = new Stokvel(request.Name, request.ContributionAmount, request.Frequency, request.MaxMembers);
        await stokvels.AddAsync(stokvel);

        ETagHelper.Set(Response, stokvel.Version);   // ADDED 5.3
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { stokvelId = stokvel.Id }, stokvel.ToResponse());
    }

    /// <summary>Updates a stokvel's details. Treasurer or Admin only. Requires the If-Match header.</summary>
    [HttpPut("{stokvelId:guid}")]
    [RequireStokvelOfficer]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(StokvelResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status409Conflict)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status412PreconditionFailed)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status428PreconditionRequired)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<StokvelResponse>> Update(
        Guid stokvelId, StokvelRequest request, [FromHeader(Name = "If-Match")] string? ifMatch)
    {
        var expectedVersion = ETagHelper.ParseIfMatch(ifMatch);   // ADDED 5.3: the token is required

        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId) ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");
        stokvel.UpdateDetails(request.Name, request.ContributionAmount, request.Frequency, request.MaxMembers);
        stokvel.SetExpectedVersion(expectedVersion);   // ADDED 5.3: use the version the CLIENT saw
        await stokvels.UpdateAsync(stokvel);

        ETagHelper.Set(Response, stokvel.Version);     // ADDED 5.3: hand back the new token
        return Ok(stokvel.ToResponse());
    }

    /// <summary>Deletes a stokvel. Treasurer or Admin only.</summary>
    [HttpDelete("{stokvelId:guid}")]
    [RequireStokvelOfficer]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid stokvelId)
    {
        if (!await stokvels.DeleteAsync(stokvelId))
            throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");
        return NoContent();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lists a stokvel's members in rotation order. CHANGED 5.3: paged in the database.
    /// Query: pageSize, pageToken.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{stokvelId:guid}/members")]
    [RequireStokvelMember]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(PagedResponse<UserResponse>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PagedResponse<UserResponse>>> GetMembers(
        Guid stokvelId, [FromQuery] int? pageSize, [FromQuery] string? pageToken, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var result = await memberPaging.ListAsync(stokvelId, pageSize, pageToken, ct)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Gets a single member of a stokvel.</summary>
    [HttpGet("{stokvelId:guid}/members/{userId:guid}")]
    [RequireStokvelMember]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(UserResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserResponse>> GetMember(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId)
    {
        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId) ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");
        var member = stokvel.FindMember(userId) ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"User {userId} was not found in this stokvel.");
        return Ok(member.ToResponse());
    }

    /// <summary>Adds an existing user as a member. Treasurer or Admin only.</summary>
    [HttpPost("{stokvelId:guid}/members")]
    [RequireStokvelOfficer]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(UserResponse), StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status409Conflict)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status422UnprocessableEntity)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserResponse>> AddMember(Guid stokvelId, AddMemberRequest request)
    {
        var user = await membershipService.AddMemberAsync(stokvelId, request.UserId);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetMember), new { stokvelId, userId = user.Id }, user.ToResponse());
    }

    /// <summary>Removes a member from a stokvel. Treasurer or Admin only.</summary>
    [HttpDelete("{stokvelId:guid}/members/{userId:guid}")]
    [RequireStokvelOfficer]   // NEW 6.1
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status204NoContent)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RemoveMember(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId)
    {
        await membershipService.RemoveMemberAsync(stokvelId, userId);
        return NoContent();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Records a contribution. A member may record their own; a Treasurer or Admin may record for anyone.
    /// Requires an Idempotency-Key header.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("{stokvelId:guid}/contributions")]
    [EnableRateLimiting(RateLimitPolicies.Contribution)]
    [RequireStokvelMember]   // NEW 6.1: must at least be a member (non-members get 404 before anything else)
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ContributionResponse), StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status409Conflict)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ProblemDetails), StatusCodes.Status422UnprocessableEntity)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ContributionResponse>> RecordContribution(
        Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request, [FromHeader(Name = "Idempotency-Key")] string? idempotencyKey)
    {
        // NEW 6.1: own contribution = ok, someone else's = officer only (403 otherwise)
        await access.EnsureAsync(User, stokvelId, Policies.RecordContribution, request.UserId);

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(idempotencyKey))
            throw new DomainValidationException("The Idempotency-Key header is required.");

        var (response, replayed) = await contributionService.RecordContributionAsync(stokvelId, request, idempotencyKey);
        if (replayed) Response.Headers[ApiHeaders.IdempotencyReplayed] = "true";
        return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status201Created, response);
    }
}

=== API/Services/ContributionServices.cs
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;   // NEW 6.2

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

public interface IContributionService
{
    Task<(ContributionResponse Response, bool WasReplayed)> RecordContributionAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request, string idempotencyKey);
}

public sealed class ContributionService(
    IStokvelRepository stokvels,
    IUserRepository users,
    IContributionCycleRepository cycles,
    IContributionRepository contributions,
    IIdempotencyStore idempotencyStore) : IContributionService
{
    public async Task<(ContributionResponse Response, bool WasReplayed)> RecordContributionAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request, string idempotencyKey)
    {
        var requestHash = ComputeHash(stokvelId, request);

        var existing = await idempotencyStore.GetAsync(idempotencyKey);
        if (existing is not null)
        {
            if (existing.RequestHash != requestHash)
                throw new DomainConflictException("This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.");

            return (existing.Response, true);
        }

        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");

        var user = await users.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId)
            ?? throw new DomainReferenceException($"User {request.UserId} does not exist.");

        if (!stokvel.HasMember(user.Id))
            throw new DomainReferenceException("That user is not a member of this stokvel.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no name, no stokvel name

        var cycle = await cycles.GetByIdAsync(request.CycleId);
        if (cycle is null || cycle.StokvelId != stokvelId)
            throw new DomainReferenceException($"Cycle {request.CycleId} does not exist for this stokvel.");

        if (await contributions.ExistsAsync(stokvelId, user.Id, request.CycleId))
            throw new DomainConflictException("This member has already contributed for this cycle.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no name

        var contribution = new Contribution(stokvelId, user.Id, request.CycleId, request.Amount);
        await contributions.AddAsync(contribution);
        RondiMetrics.ContributionRecorded();   // NEW 6.2: counted only after the row is really saved

        var response = contribution.ToResponse();
        await idempotencyStore.SaveAsync(idempotencyKey, new IdempotencyRecord(requestHash, response));

        return (response, false);
    }

    private static string ComputeHash(Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request)
    {
        var raw = $"{stokvelId}|{request.UserId}|{request.CycleId}|{request.Amount}";
        var bytes = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(raw));
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes);
    }
}

=== API/Errors/RondiExceptionHandler.cs
using FluentValidation;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Npgsql;
using RondiTrack.Api.Common.Paging;
using RondiTrack.Auth;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;
using RondiTrack.Web;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace RondiTrack.Errors;

public sealed class RondiExceptionHandler(ILogger<RondiExceptionHandler> logger) : IExceptionHandler
{
    public async ValueTask<bool> TryHandleAsync(HttpContext httpContext, Exception exception, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // UseExceptionHandler wipes response headers (including CORS), so put them back
        await CorsSetup.ReapplyAsync(httpContext);

        var correlationId = CorrelationId.For(httpContext);

        var status = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
        var title = "Internal Server Error";
        var detail = "An unexpected error occurred.";
        Dictionary<string, string[]>? errors = null;   // field -> messages, validation only

        if (exception is ValidationException vex)
        {
            status = StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest;
            title = "Validation Failed";
            detail = "One or more fields are invalid.";
            errors = vex.Errors
                .GroupBy(e => JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(e.PropertyName))
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToArray());
        }
        else if (exception is DomainNotFoundException) { status = 404; title = "Not Found"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainConflictException) { status = 409; title = "Conflict"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainReferenceException) { status = 422; title = "Unprocessable Entity"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainValidationException) { status = 400; title = "Bad Request"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is ApiBadRequestException) { status = 400; title = "Bad Request"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is PreconditionRequiredException) { status = 428; title = "Precondition Required"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is InvalidCredentialsException or InvalidRefreshTokenException)
        {
            status = 401; title = "Unauthorized"; detail = exception.Message;
            httpContext.Response.Headers.WWWAuthenticate = "Bearer";
        }
        else if (exception is ForbiddenException) { status = 403; title = "Forbidden"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DbUpdateConcurrencyException)
        {
            if (httpContext.Request.Headers.ContainsKey("If-Match"))
            {
                status = 412; title = "Precondition Failed";
                detail = "This record was changed by someone else since you loaded it. Reload it and try again.";
            }
            else
            {
                status = 409; title = "Conflict";
                detail = "This record was changed by someone else at the same time. Reload it and try again.";
            }
        }
        else if (exception is DbUpdateException { InnerException: PostgresException { SqlState: PostgresErrorCodes.UniqueViolation } })
        {
            status = 409; title = "Conflict";
            detail = "That record already exists (it would break a uniqueness rule).";
        }

        if (status >= 500)
            logger.LogError(exception, "Request failed with status {Status}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}", status, correlationId);
        else
            logger.LogInformation("Request rejected with status {Status} ({ExceptionType}). CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
                status, exception.GetType().Name, correlationId);

        var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails { Status = status, Title = title, Detail = detail };
        problemDetails.Extensions["correlationId"] = correlationId;
        if (errors is not null) problemDetails.Extensions["errors"] = errors;

        httpContext.Response.StatusCode = status;
        httpContext.Response.ContentType = "application/problem+json";
        await httpContext.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(problemDetails), cancellationToken);
        return true;
    }
}

=== API/Web/CorsSetup.cs
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors.Infrastructure;

namespace RondiTrack.Web;

public static class CorsSetup
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddFrontendCors(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddCors();
        // Options pattern = read lazily, so test UseSetting overrides are always seen
        services.AddOptions<CorsOptions>().Configure<IConfiguration>((o, config) =>
        {
            var origins = config.GetSection("Cors:AllowedOrigins").Get<string[]>() ?? [];
            if (origins.Any(x => x.Contains('*') || x.EndsWith('/')))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Cors:AllowedOrigins must be exact origins: no '*', no trailing slash.");

            o.AddPolicy(CorsPolicies.Frontend, p => p
                .WithOrigins(origins)                                   // empty list = nobody allowed
                .WithMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE")
                .WithHeaders("Content-Type", "Authorization", ApiHeaders.IdempotencyKey, "If-Match", "If-None-Match")
                .WithExposedHeaders("Retry-After", ApiHeaders.IdempotencyReplayed, "ETag", "Location")
                .AllowCredentials()
                .SetPreflightMaxAge(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10)));
        });
        return services;
    }

    /// The exception handler clears response headers, so CORS headers set earlier are lost on
    /// exception-based errors (404/403/409/500). Call this at the top of the handler to put them back.
    public static async Task ReapplyAsync(HttpContext ctx)
    {
        var sp = ctx.RequestServices;
        if (sp is null) return;                                   // bare DefaultHttpContext in unit tests: nothing to reapply
        var provider = sp.GetService<ICorsPolicyProvider>();
        var service = sp.GetService<ICorsService>();
        if (provider is null || service is null) return;          // CORS not registered
        var policy = await provider.GetPolicyAsync(ctx, CorsPolicies.Frontend);
        if (policy is null) return;
        service.ApplyResult(service.EvaluatePolicy(ctx, policy), ctx.Response);
    }
}

=== API/Web/RateLimitingSetup.cs
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;

namespace RondiTrack.Web;

public static class RateLimitingSetup
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddRondiRateLimiting(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddRateLimiter(_ => { });
        services.AddOptions<RateLimiterOptions>().Configure<IConfiguration>((o, cfg) =>
        {
            o.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;   // default is 503
            o.OnRejected = WriteRejectionAsync;

            var login = cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Login");
            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Login, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(ClientIp(ctx), _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                {
                    PermitLimit = login.GetValue("PermitLimit", 5),
                    Window = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(login.GetValue("WindowSeconds", 60.0)),
                    QueueLimit = 0,
                    AutoReplenishment = true
                }));

            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Contribution, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(UserKey(ctx), _ => Bucket(cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Contribution"))));

            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Payout, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(UserKey(ctx), _ => Bucket(cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Payout"))));
        });
        return services;
    }

    private static TokenBucketRateLimiterOptions Bucket(IConfigurationSection s) => new()
    {
        TokenLimit = s.GetValue("TokenLimit", 30),
        TokensPerPeriod = s.GetValue("TokensPerPeriod", 5),
        ReplenishmentPeriod = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(s.GetValue("ReplenishSeconds", 60.0)),
        QueueLimit = 0,              // reject, never hold a money request open
        AutoReplenishment = true
    };

    private static string ClientIp(HttpContext c) => "ip:" + (c.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown");

    // signed-in user id; falls back to IP only for unauthenticated callers (they'll get 401 afterwards)
    private static string UserKey(HttpContext c) =>
        c.User.FindFirstValue("sub") is { Length: > 0 } sub ? "user:" + sub : ClientIp(c);

    private static async ValueTask WriteRejectionAsync(OnRejectedContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var http = ctx.HttpContext;
        var seconds = 1;
        if (ctx.Lease.TryGetMetadata(MetadataName.RetryAfter, out var retry))
            seconds = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(retry.TotalSeconds));

        http.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
        http.Response.Headers.RetryAfter = seconds.ToString();

        var problem = new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails
        {
            Status = 429,
            Title = "Too many requests",
            Detail = $"Rate limit reached. Try again in {seconds} second(s).",
            Type = "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6585#section-4"
        };
        problem.Extensions["correlationId"] = CorrelationId.For(http);   // your 6.2 helper
        await http.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(problem, options: null, contentType: "application/problem+json", ct);
    }
}

=== API/Auth/AccessAttributes.cs ===
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;   // NEW 6.2

namespace RondiTrack.Auth;

// Base: runs BEFORE the action (before model binding), reads {stokvelId} from the route
public abstract class StokvelAccessFilterBase(string policy) : Attribute, IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
{
    public async Task OnAuthorizationAsync(AuthorizationFilterContext context)
    {
        // fail closed: no usable stokvel id means no access
        if (!Guid.TryParse(context.RouteData.Values["stokvelId"]?.ToString(), out var stokvelId))
            throw new DomainNotFoundException("Stokvel was not found.");

        var access = context.HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IStokvelAccess>();
        await access.EnsureAsync(context.HttpContext.User, stokvelId, policy);
    }
}

// Use on an endpoint: any member of the stokvel
public sealed class RequireStokvelMemberAttribute() : StokvelAccessFilterBase(Policies.StokvelMember);

// Use on an endpoint: Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel
public sealed class RequireStokvelOfficerAttribute() : StokvelAccessFilterBase(Policies.StokvelOfficer);

// Use on /api/users/{id} endpoints: your own account only
public sealed class RequireUserSelfAttribute : Attribute, IAsyncAuthorizationFilter
{
    public async Task OnAuthorizationAsync(AuthorizationFilterContext context)
    {
        var authorization = context.HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IAuthorizationService>();

        // an unreadable id becomes Guid.Empty, which matches nobody (fails closed)
        Guid.TryParse(context.RouteData.Values["id"]?.ToString(), out var userId);

        var result = await authorization.AuthorizeAsync(context.HttpContext.User, new UserResource(userId), Policies.UserSelf);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            RondiMetrics.AuthorizationRefused(RefusalResults.Forbidden);   // NEW 6.2: count the refusal
            throw new ForbiddenException("You can only access your own account.");   // 403 even if the id does not exist
        }
    }
}
=== API/Auth/AuthConstants.cs ===
namespace RondiTrack.Auth;

public static class AuthConstants
{
    public const string PlatformAdminRole = "PlatformAdmin";   // the ONLY role in the token (platform level)
    public const string RefreshCookieName = "rondi_refresh";   // name of the refresh cookie
    public const string RefreshCookiePath = "/api/auth";       // cookie is only sent to the auth endpoints
}

// Policy names live here, so controllers never contain role strings
public static class Policies
{
    public const string StokvelMember = "StokvelMember";           // any member of the stokvel
    public const string StokvelOfficer = "StokvelOfficer";         // Treasurer or Admin of the stokvel
    public const string RecordContribution = "RecordContribution"; // own contribution, or officer for others
    public const string UserSelf = "UserSelf";                     // your own account (or platform admin)
    public const string PlatformAdmin = "PlatformAdmin";           // platform admin claim
}

public sealed class InvalidCredentialsException() : Exception("Invalid email or password.");

// Used for a missing, unknown, used, revoked or expired refresh token

=== API/Auth/AuthService.cs ===
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Auth;

// What the controller needs after login or refresh
public sealed record AuthResult(
    string AccessToken,
    DateTime AccessTokenExpiresAtUtc,
    string RefreshToken,              // goes ONLY into the cookie
    DateTime RefreshTokenExpiresAtUtc,
    Guid RefreshTokenId);

public interface IAuthService
{
    Task<User> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request);
    Task<AuthResult> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request);
    Task<AuthResult> RefreshAsync(string? rawRefreshToken);
    Task LogoutAsync(string? rawRefreshToken);
}

public sealed class AuthService(
    IUserRepository users,
    IRefreshTokenRepository tokens,
    IPasswordHasher<User> hasher,
    ITokenService tokenService,
    JwtOptions jwt,
    ILogger<AuthService> logger) : IAuthService
{
    // A fake user and hash. Used when the email is unknown, so the time taken looks the same as a wrong password.
    private static readonly User DummyUser = new("Dummy", "dummy@example.com");
    private static readonly string DummyHash =
        new PasswordHasher<User>().HashPassword(DummyUser, "dummy-password-never-used");

    public async Task<User> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var user = new User(request.FullName, request.Email);   // trims + lower-cases the email

        if (await users.EmailExistsAsync(user.Email))
            throw new DomainConflictException("An account with this email already exists.");   // 409

        user.SetPasswordHash(hasher.HashPassword(user, request.Password));   // store the hash only
        await users.AddAsync(user);   // the unique index also catches two requests at the same moment

        logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} registered", user.Id);   // id only, never email or password
        return user;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResult> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        var user = await users.GetByEmailAsync(request.Email);

        // always run one password check (real or fake hash) so unknown email and wrong password look alike
        var hash = user?.PasswordHash ?? DummyHash;
        var outcome = hasher.VerifyHashedPassword(user ?? DummyUser, hash, request.Password);

        if (user is null || user.PasswordHash is null || outcome == PasswordVerificationResult.Failed)
        {
            // CHANGED 6.2: never the typed email. Our own user id when the account exists, so a guessing attack on one account is visible.
            if (user is null)
                logger.LogWarning("Login failed: no matching account");
            else
                logger.LogWarning("Login failed for user {UserId}", user.Id);
            throw new InvalidCredentialsException();   // same 401 message for both cases
        }

        var result = await IssueAsync(user, Guid.NewGuid());   // new login = new token family
        logger.LogInformation("Login succeeded for user {UserId}", user.Id);
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResult> RefreshAsync(string? rawRefreshToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawRefreshToken))
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var stored = await tokens.GetByHashAsync(tokenService.HashRefreshToken(rawRefreshToken))
            ?? throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();

        // REUSE DETECTION: this token was already used (or revoked) -> someone replayed it
        if (stored.UsedAtUtc.HasValue || stored.RevokedAtUtc.HasValue)
        {
            await tokens.RevokeFamilyAsync(stored.FamilyId, now);   // kill every token of this login
            logger.LogWarning("Refresh token reuse detected for user {UserId}. Session {FamilyId} revoked",
                stored.UserId, stored.FamilyId);
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();
        }

        if (stored.ExpiresAtUtc <= now)
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();

        // read the user again, so the new access token reflects their CURRENT platform flag
        var user = await users.GetByIdAsync(stored.UserId)
            ?? throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();

        var result = await IssueAsync(user, stored.FamilyId);   // ROTATION: new token, same family

        // mark the old one used. If another request got there first, this is a replay.
        if (!await tokens.TryMarkUsedAsync(stored.Id, result.RefreshTokenId, now))
        {
            await tokens.RevokeFamilyAsync(stored.FamilyId, now);
            logger.LogWarning("Refresh token reuse detected for user {UserId}. Session {FamilyId} revoked",
                stored.UserId, stored.FamilyId);
            throw new InvalidRefreshTokenException();
        }

        logger.LogInformation("Refresh token rotated for user {UserId}", user.Id);
        return result;
    }

    // Idempotent: unknown or missing token is fine, it just does nothing
    public async Task LogoutAsync(string? rawRefreshToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawRefreshToken)) return;

        var stored = await tokens.GetByHashAsync(tokenService.HashRefreshToken(rawRefreshToken));
        if (stored is null) return;

        await tokens.RevokeFamilyAsync(stored.FamilyId, DateTime.UtcNow);
        logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} logged out", stored.UserId);
    }

    // Makes the access token + a new refresh token (stored as a hash) for one family
    private async Task<AuthResult> IssueAsync(User user, Guid familyId)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var access = tokenService.CreateAccessToken(user.Id, user.IsPlatformAdmin);
        var (raw, hash) = tokenService.CreateRefreshToken();

        var refresh = new RefreshToken(user.Id, familyId, hash, now, now.AddDays(jwt.RefreshTokenDays));
        await tokens.AddAsync(refresh);

        return new AuthResult(access.Value, access.ExpiresAtUtc, raw, refresh.ExpiresAtUtc, refresh.Id);
    }
}
