----- FILE: API\Errors\RondiExceptionHandler.cs -----
using FluentValidation;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Npgsql;
using RondiTrack.Api.Common.Paging;
using RondiTrack.Auth;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;
using RondiTrack.Web;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace RondiTrack.Errors;

public sealed class RondiExceptionHandler(ILogger<RondiExceptionHandler> logger) : IExceptionHandler
{
    public async ValueTask<bool> TryHandleAsync(HttpContext httpContext, Exception exception, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // UseExceptionHandler wipes response headers (including CORS), so put them back
        await CorsSetup.ReapplyAsync(httpContext);

        var correlationId = CorrelationId.For(httpContext);

        var status = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
        var title = "Internal Server Error";
        var detail = "An unexpected error occurred.";
        Dictionary<string, string[]>? errors = null;   // field -> messages, validation only

        if (exception is ValidationException vex)
        {
            status = StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest;
            title = "Validation Failed";
            detail = "One or more fields are invalid.";
            errors = vex.Errors
                .GroupBy(e => JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(e.PropertyName))
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToArray());
        }
        else if (exception is DomainNotFoundException) { status = 404; title = "Not Found"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainConflictException) { status = 409; title = "Conflict"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainReferenceException) { status = 422; title = "Unprocessable Entity"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DomainValidationException) { status = 400; title = "Bad Request"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is ApiBadRequestException) { status = 400; title = "Bad Request"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is PreconditionRequiredException) { status = 428; title = "Precondition Required"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is InvalidCredentialsException or InvalidRefreshTokenException)
        {
            status = 401; title = "Unauthorized"; detail = exception.Message;
            httpContext.Response.Headers.WWWAuthenticate = "Bearer";
        }
        else if (exception is ForbiddenException) { status = 403; title = "Forbidden"; detail = exception.Message; }
        else if (exception is DbUpdateConcurrencyException)
        {
            if (httpContext.Request.Headers.ContainsKey("If-Match"))
            {
                status = 412; title = "Precondition Failed";
                detail = "This record was changed by someone else since you loaded it. Reload it and try again.";
            }
            else
            {
                status = 409; title = "Conflict";
                detail = "This record was changed by someone else at the same time. Reload it and try again.";
            }
        }
        else if (exception is DbUpdateException { InnerException: PostgresException { SqlState: PostgresErrorCodes.UniqueViolation } })
        {
            status = 409; title = "Conflict";
            detail = "That record already exists (it would break a uniqueness rule).";
        }

        if (status >= 500)
            logger.LogError(exception, "Request failed with status {Status}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}", status, correlationId);
        else
            logger.LogInformation("Request rejected with status {Status} ({ExceptionType}). CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}",
                status, exception.GetType().Name, correlationId);

        var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails { Status = status, Title = title, Detail = detail };
        problemDetails.Extensions["correlationId"] = correlationId;
        if (errors is not null) problemDetails.Extensions["errors"] = errors;

        httpContext.Response.StatusCode = status;
        httpContext.Response.ContentType = "application/problem+json";
        await httpContext.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(problemDetails), cancellationToken);
        return true;
    }
}


----- FILE: API\Jobs\CycleCloseJob.cs -----
using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;

namespace RondiTrack.Jobs;

// 6.4: all settings come from config "Jobs:CycleClose"
public sealed class CycleCloseOptions
{
    public bool Enabled { get; set; } = true;
    public int IntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 900;                  // how often the job wakes up
    public int MaxCatchUpCycles { get; set; } = 36;                  // safety cap per stokvel per run
    public string TimeZoneId { get; set; } = "Africa/Johannesburg";  // the stokvel calendar
}

public sealed record CycleCloseResult(int CyclesClosed, int ArrearsRecorded, int StokvelsFailed);

// 6.4: closes finished cycles, records arrears, opens the next cycle. Safe to run twice / on 2 replicas / after a crash.
public sealed class CycleCloseJob(
    IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
    TimeProvider time,                       // 6.4: "now" is injected. Never DateTime.Now
    IOptions<CycleCloseOptions> options,
    ILogger<CycleCloseJob> logger) : BackgroundService
{
    // 6.4: fails at startup if the zone id is wrong (tzdata missing), not at 02:00
    private readonly TimeZoneInfo _zone = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(options.Value.TimeZoneId);

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        var o = options.Value;
        if (!o.Enabled) { logger.LogInformation("Cycle-close job is disabled"); return; }

        using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(1, o.IntervalSeconds)), time);
        await SafeRunAsync(stoppingToken);                           // run once at startup (catches up after downtime)
        try { while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken)) await SafeRunAsync(stoppingToken); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { /* shutting down */ }
    }

    // 6.4: a failed run never takes the API down. The next tick simply tries again.
    private async Task SafeRunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try { await RunOnceAsync(null, ct); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { logger.LogError(ex, "Cycle-close run failed; will retry on the next tick"); }
    }

    // 6.4: tests call this directly. onlyStokvelIds lets a test touch only its own data.
    public async Task<CycleCloseResult> RunOnceAsync(IReadOnlyCollection<Guid>? onlyStokvelIds = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        using var run = RondiTelemetry.Source.StartActivity("cycles.close.run");   // 6.4: own trace span

        var nowUtc = time.GetUtcNow();
        // 6.4: "which day is it" = the day in SOUTH AFRICA. At 22:00 UTC the SAST date has already changed.
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTime(nowUtc, _zone).DateTime);

        List<Guid> due;
        using (var scope = scopes.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            var query = db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking().Where(c => c.ClosedAtUtc == null && c.EndsOn < today);
            if (onlyStokvelIds is not null)
            {
                var ids = onlyStokvelIds.ToArray();
                query = query.Where(c => ids.Contains(c.StokvelId));
            }
            due = await query.Select(c => c.StokvelId).Distinct().ToListAsync(ct);
        }

        int closed = 0, arrears = 0, failed = 0;
        foreach (var stokvelId in due)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            try
            {
                var (c, a) = await CloseStokvelAsync(stokvelId, nowUtc, today, ct);
                closed += c; arrears += a;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // 6.4: one stokvel's failure never stops the others. Log the stokvel id only (no names/phones/ID numbers: 6.2 rules).
                failed++;
                logger.LogError(ex, "Cycle close failed for stokvel {StokvelId}", stokvelId);
            }
        }

        // 6.4: metrics
        if (closed > 0) RondiMetrics.CyclesClosed(closed);
        if (arrears > 0) RondiMetrics.ArrearsRecorded(arrears);
        run?.SetTag("cycles.closed", closed);
        run?.SetTag("arrears.recorded", arrears);
        run?.SetTag("stokvels.failed", failed);
        logger.LogInformation("Cycle-close run finished: {Closed} closed, {Arrears} arrears, {Failed} stokvels failed", closed, arrears, failed);
        return new CycleCloseResult(closed, arrears, failed);
    }

    // 6.4: ONE transaction per stokvel. Crash halfway = nothing changed. Catch-up (several cycles behind) is in the same transaction.
    private async Task<(int Closed, int Arrears)> CloseStokvelAsync(Guid stokvelId, DateTimeOffset nowUtc, DateOnly today, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var span = RondiTelemetry.Source.StartActivity("cycles.close.stokvel");
        span?.SetTag("stokvel.id", stokvelId.ToString());

        using var scope = scopes.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        var max = Math.Max(1, options.Value.MaxCatchUpCycles);
        var closedAt = nowUtc.UtcDateTime;

        // retry-on-failure is on, so a manual transaction must run inside the execution strategy (same as PayoutService)
        var strategy = db.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
        var result = await strategy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
        {
            db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            await using var tx = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);

            var stokvel = await db.Stokvels.AsNoTracking().Where(s => s.Id == stokvelId)
                .Select(s => new { s.ContributionAmount, s.Frequency }).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
            if (stokvel is null) return (0, 0);

            var dueCents = (long)Math.Round(stokvel.ContributionAmount * 100m);
            var memberIds = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking().Where(m => m.StokvelId == stokvelId)
                .Select(m => m.UserId).ToListAsync(ct);

            var current = await db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId && c.ClosedAtUtc == null && c.EndsOn < today)
                .OrderBy(c => c.CycleNumber).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

            int cyclesClosed = 0, arrearsRecorded = 0;
            while (current is not null && cyclesClosed < max)
            {
                var cur = current;

                // 6.4: EXACTLY ONCE, enforced by the database. Only one runner can flip ClosedAtUtc from NULL.
                // A second runner waits for the first to commit, then matches 0 rows and does nothing.
                var won = await db.ContributionCycles
                    .Where(c => c.Id == cur.Id && c.ClosedAtUtc == null)
                    .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.ClosedAtUtc, (DateTime?)closedAt), ct);
                if (won == 0) break;   // someone else already closed it

                // what each member paid in this cycle, in cents
                var paid = await db.Contributions.AsNoTracking().Where(c => c.CycleId == cur.Id)
                    .GroupBy(c => c.UserId).Select(g => new { UserId = g.Key, Total = g.Sum(x => x.Amount) }).ToListAsync(ct);
                var paidByUser = paid.ToDictionary(p => p.UserId, p => (long)Math.Round(p.Total * 100m));

                foreach (var userId in memberIds)
                {
                    paidByUser.TryGetValue(userId, out var paidCents);
                    var shortfall = dueCents - paidCents;
                    if (shortfall > 0)   // paid in full = no arrear
                    {
                        db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(stokvelId, cur.Id, userId, shortfall, closedAt));
                        arrearsRecorded++;
                    }
                }

                // open the next cycle (end date = one period later, still a SAST calendar date)
                var next = new ContributionCycle(stokvelId, cur.CycleNumber + 1, cur.TargetAmount,
                    Advance(cur.EndsOn!.Value, stokvel.Frequency), closedAt);
                db.ContributionCycles.Add(next);

                await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
                cyclesClosed++;

                // CATCH-UP: if the new cycle is ALSO already over (server was down), close it too, in order
                current = next.EndsOn < today ? next : null;
            }

            await tx.CommitAsync(ct);   // 0 closed = nothing to commit (lost the race)
            return (cyclesClosed, arrearsRecorded);
        });

        span?.SetTag("cycles.closed", result.Item1);
        return result;
    }

    // 6.4: one period after a date, by the stokvel's frequency
    internal static DateOnly Advance(DateOnly d, ContributionFrequency f) => f switch
    {
        ContributionFrequency.Weekly => d.AddDays(7),
        ContributionFrequency.Fortnightly => d.AddDays(14),
        _ => d.AddMonths(1)
    };
}

----- FILE: API\Jobs\DemoSeed.cs -----
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace RondiTrack.Jobs;

// 6.4 + 7.2: demo accounts and demo data for the frontend developer. Only runs when Demo:Enabled=true.
public static class DemoSeed
{
    public static async Task RunAsync(RondiTrackDbContext db, IPasswordHasher<User> hasher, TimeProvider time, string password)
    {
        // 1) give the SEEDED users (only those) a password, taken from the .env file
        var seededIds = SeedData.Users.Select(u => u.Id).ToArray();
        var users = await db.Users.Where(u => seededIds.Contains(u.Id) && u.PasswordHash == null).ToListAsync();
        foreach (var u in users) u.SetPasswordHash(hasher.HashPassword(u, password));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        var thandi = SeedData.Users[0].Id;
        var sipho = SeedData.Users[1].Id;
        var lerato = SeedData.Users[2].Id;
        var kagiso = SeedData.Users[3].Id;
        var ubuntu = SeedData.Stokvels[0].Id;
        var grocery = SeedData.Stokvels[1].Id;

        // 2) Thandi is Treasurer in Ubuntu Savers and a plain Member in Festive Grocery Club
        await db.StokvelMembers.Where(m => m.UserId == thandi && m.StokvelId == ubuntu)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(m => m.Role, StokvelRole.Treasurer));

        var zone = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Africa/Johannesburg");
        var now = time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(now, zone));

        // small helper: add a contribution with a chosen status and time
        void Pay(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId, decimal amount, ContributionStatus status, DateTime recordedAtUtc)
        {
            var c = new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, amount);
            db.Contributions.Add(c);
            db.Entry(c).Property(nameof(Contribution.RecordedAtUtc)).CurrentValue = recordedAtUtc;
            db.Entry(c).Property(nameof(Contribution.Status)).CurrentValue = status;
        }

        // 3) NEW 7.2: Ubuntu Savers gets three cycles: #1 PaidOut, #2 Closed, #3 Open
        if (!await db.ContributionCycles.AnyAsync(c => c.StokvelId == ubuntu))
        {
            var u1 = new ContributionCycle(ubuntu, 1, 500m, today.AddDays(-61), now.AddDays(-91));
            u1.MarkPaidOut();
            var u2 = new ContributionCycle(ubuntu, 2, 500m, today.AddDays(-31), now.AddDays(-61));
            var u3 = new ContributionCycle(ubuntu, 3, 500m, today.AddDays(30), now.AddDays(-1));
            db.ContributionCycles.AddRange(u1, u2, u3);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();

            // cycles 1 and 2 are over: mark them closed so the cycle-close job leaves them alone
            await db.ContributionCycles.Where(c => c.Id == u1.Id || c.Id == u2.Id)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.ClosedAtUtc, (DateTime?)now));

            Pay(ubuntu, thandi, u1.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-80));
            Pay(ubuntu, sipho, u1.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-79));
            Pay(ubuntu, lerato, u1.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-78));

            Pay(ubuntu, thandi, u2.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-50));
            Pay(ubuntu, sipho, u2.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Paid, now.AddDays(-49));
            Pay(ubuntu, lerato, u2.Id, 0.10m, ContributionStatus.Paid, now.AddDays(-48));   // 10 cents
            db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(ubuntu, u2.Id, lerato, 49990, now));                  // Lerato was short by R499,90

            Pay(ubuntu, thandi, u3.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-3));            // Thandi is all paid up
            Pay(ubuntu, sipho, u3.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Paid,
                new DateTime(2026, 10, 31, 22, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));                              // the midnight case: 00:30 on 1 Nov in SA
            Pay(ubuntu, lerato, u3.Id, 500m, ContributionStatus.Pending, now.AddDays(-1));
        }

        // 4) NEW 7.2: Festive Grocery Club: Thandi (a plain Member) is in arrears and still owes this cycle
        if (!await db.ContributionCycles.AnyAsync(c => c.StokvelId == grocery))
        {
            var g1 = new ContributionCycle(grocery, 1, 250m, today.AddDays(-30), now.AddDays(-60));
            var g2 = new ContributionCycle(grocery, 2, 250m, today.AddDays(3), now.AddDays(-27));
            db.ContributionCycles.AddRange(g1, g2);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();

            await db.ContributionCycles.Where(c => c.Id == g1.Id)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.ClosedAtUtc, (DateTime?)now));

            Pay(grocery, kagiso, g1.Id, 250m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-40));
            db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(grocery, g1.Id, thandi, 25000, now));                 // Thandi paid nothing in cycle 1
            Pay(grocery, kagiso, g2.Id, 250m, ContributionStatus.Confirmed, now.AddDays(-2));
        }

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Jobs\HousekeepingJob.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace RondiTrack.Jobs;

// 6.4: N and M come from config "Jobs:Housekeeping" (never hard-coded)
public sealed class HousekeepingOptions
{
    public bool Enabled { get; set; } = true;
    public int IntervalMinutes { get; set; } = 60;
    public int RefreshTokenRetentionDays { get; set; } = 30;     // N: keep tokens this long AFTER they expire
    public int IdempotencyRetentionHours { get; set; } = 168;    // M: keep idempotency records this long (7 days)
}

public sealed record HousekeepingResult(int RefreshTokensDeleted, int IdempotencyEntriesDeleted);

// 6.4: deletes old rows. Deleting rows that are already gone does nothing, so it is safe to run twice.
public sealed class HousekeepingJob(
    IServiceScopeFactory scopes, TimeProvider time, IOptions<HousekeepingOptions> options,
    ILogger<HousekeepingJob> logger) : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        var o = options.Value;
        if (!o.Enabled) { logger.LogInformation("Housekeeping job is disabled"); return; }

        using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Math.Max(1, o.IntervalMinutes)), time);
        await SafeRunAsync(stoppingToken);
        try { while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken)) await SafeRunAsync(stoppingToken); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
    }

    private async Task SafeRunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try { await RunOnceAsync(ct); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { logger.LogError(ex, "Housekeeping run failed; will retry on the next tick"); }   // never takes the API down
    }

    public async Task<HousekeepingResult> RunOnceAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        using var activity = RondiTrack.Telemetry.RondiTelemetry.Source.StartActivity("housekeeping.run");
        var o = options.Value;
        var now = time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime;   // 6.4: TimeProvider, not DateTime.UtcNow

        using var scope = scopes.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();

        // 6.4: set-based deletes (ExecuteDeleteAsync): nothing is loaded into memory
        var tokenCutoff = now.AddDays(-Math.Max(1, o.RefreshTokenRetentionDays));
        var tokens = await db.RefreshTokens.Where(t => t.ExpiresAtUtc < tokenCutoff).ExecuteDeleteAsync(ct);

        var idemCutoff = now.AddHours(-Math.Max(1, o.IdempotencyRetentionHours));
        var idem = await db.IdempotencyEntries.Where(e => e.CreatedAtUtc < idemCutoff).ExecuteDeleteAsync(ct);

        logger.LogInformation("Housekeeping deleted {Tokens} refresh tokens and {Idem} idempotency records", tokens, idem);
        return new HousekeepingResult(tokens, idem);
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\ContributionPagingService.cs -----
using System.Globalization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Api.Common.Paging;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

// CHANGED 7.2: the rows now carry CycleId, integer cents and Status, and no email.
public sealed class ContributionPagingService(RondiTrackDbContext db)
{
    private static readonly string[] AllowedSorts = ["date", "-date", "amount", "-amount"];

    public async Task<PagedResponse<ContributionDetailResponse>> ListAsync(
        Guid cycleId, ContributionListQuery q, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var pageSize = PagingDefaults.Resolve(q.PageSize);

        var sort = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.Sort) ? "date" : q.Sort.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedSorts.Contains(sort))
            throw new ApiBadRequestException(
                $"Unknown sort '{q.Sort}'. Allowed: {string.Join(", ", AllowedSorts)}.");

        var from = ToUtc(q.DateFrom);
        var to = ToUtc(q.DateTo);
        if (from.HasValue && to.HasValue && from > to)
            throw new ApiBadRequestException("dateFrom cannot be after dateTo.");

        IQueryable<Contribution> query = db.Contributions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.CycleId == cycleId);

        if (q.UserId.HasValue)
        {
            var uid = q.UserId.Value;
            query = query.Where(c => c.UserId == uid);
        }
        if (from.HasValue)
        {
            var f = from.Value;
            query = query.Where(c => c.RecordedAtUtc >= f);
        }
        if (to.HasValue)
        {
            var t = to.Value;
            query = query.Where(c => c.RecordedAtUtc <= t);
        }

        var context = PageTokenCodec.ContextOf(
            sort, cycleId, q.UserId, from?.ToString("O"), to?.ToString("O"));

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.PageToken))
        {
            var cursor = PageTokenCodec.Decode(q.PageToken, context);
            query = ApplyAfterCursor(query, sort, cursor);
        }

        query = ApplyOrder(query, sort);

        // Ask for ONE extra row. If it comes back, there is a next page.
        var rows = await query
            .Take(pageSize + 1)
            .Select(c => new
            {
                c.Id, c.CycleId, c.UserId,
                MemberName = c.Member.User.FullName,
                c.Member.Role, c.Member.RotationPosition,
                c.Amount, c.Status, c.RecordedAtUtc
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var hasMore = rows.Count > pageSize;
        var pageRows = rows.Take(pageSize).ToList();

        var next = "";
        if (hasMore)
        {
            var last = pageRows[^1];
            var lastValue = sort.EndsWith("date")
                ? last.RecordedAtUtc.ToString("O", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                : last.Amount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            next = PageTokenCodec.Encode(new PageCursor(context, lastValue, last.Id));
        }

        // money becomes integer cents here
        var page = pageRows.Select(r => new ContributionDetailResponse(
            r.Id, r.CycleId, r.UserId, r.MemberName, r.Role, r.RotationPosition,
            Money.ToCents(r.Amount), r.Status, r.RecordedAtUtc)).ToList();

        return new PagedResponse<ContributionDetailResponse>(page, next);
    }

    private static IQueryable<Contribution> ApplyOrder(IQueryable<Contribution> q, string sort) => sort switch
    {
        "date"   => q.OrderBy(c => c.RecordedAtUtc).ThenBy(c => c.Id),
        "-date"  => q.OrderByDescending(c => c.RecordedAtUtc).ThenByDescending(c => c.Id),
        "amount" => q.OrderBy(c => c.Amount).ThenBy(c => c.Id),
        _        => q.OrderByDescending(c => c.Amount).ThenByDescending(c => c.Id),
    };

    private static IQueryable<Contribution> ApplyAfterCursor(
        IQueryable<Contribution> q, string sort, PageCursor cur)
    {
        var lastId = cur.LastId;

        if (sort.EndsWith("date"))
        {
            if (!DateTime.TryParse(cur.LastValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    DateTimeStyles.RoundtripKind, out var parsed))
                throw new ApiBadRequestException("pageToken is invalid.");

            var d = DateTime.SpecifyKind(parsed, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            return sort == "date"
                ? q.Where(c => c.RecordedAtUtc > d || (c.RecordedAtUtc == d && c.Id.CompareTo(lastId) > 0))
                : q.Where(c => c.RecordedAtUtc < d || (c.RecordedAtUtc == d && c.Id.CompareTo(lastId) < 0));
        }

        if (!decimal.TryParse(cur.LastValue, NumberStyles.Number, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var a))
            throw new ApiBadRequestException("pageToken is invalid.");

        return sort == "amount"
            ? q.Where(c => c.Amount > a || (c.Amount == a && c.Id.CompareTo(lastId) > 0))
            : q.Where(c => c.Amount < a || (c.Amount == a && c.Id.CompareTo(lastId) < 0));
    }

    private static DateTime? ToUtc(DateTime? value) => value is null ? null
        : value.Value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc ? value
        : value.Value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local ? value.Value.ToUniversalTime()
        : DateTime.SpecifyKind(value.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
}

----- FILE: API\Services\ContributionQueries.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// The naive N+1 version and the two fixes, side by side. CHANGED 7.2: all three now return the new DTO shape.
public interface IContributionQueries
{
    Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleNaiveAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId);
    Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleIncludeAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId);
    Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleProjectedAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId);
}

public sealed class ContributionQueries(RondiTrackDbContext db) : IContributionQueries
{
    // VERSION 1: deliberately NAIVE. 1 query for the rows, then 2 more queries PER ROW.
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleNaiveAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId)
    {
        var rows = await db.Contributions
            .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId && c.CycleId == cycleId)
            .OrderBy(c => c.RecordedAtUtc)
            .ToListAsync();

        var result = new List<ContributionDetailResponse>();
        foreach (var c in rows)
        {
            await db.Entry(c).Reference(x => x.Member).LoadAsync();
            await db.Entry(c.Member).Reference(m => m.User).LoadAsync();
            result.Add(ToDto(c));
        }
        return result;
    }

    // VERSION 2: FIX with eager loading.
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleIncludeAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId)
    {
        var rows = await db.Contributions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId && c.CycleId == cycleId)
            .Include(c => c.Member).ThenInclude(m => m.User)
            .OrderBy(c => c.RecordedAtUtc)
            .ToListAsync();

        return rows.Select(ToDto).ToList();
    }

    // VERSION 3: FIX with projection. One query, only the columns the response needs. THIS ONE SHIPS.
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionDetailResponse>> GetForCycleProjectedAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId)
    {
        var rows = await db.Contributions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId && c.CycleId == cycleId)
            .OrderBy(c => c.RecordedAtUtc)
            .Select(c => new
            {
                c.Id, c.CycleId, c.UserId,
                MemberName = c.Member.User.FullName,
                c.Member.Role, c.Member.RotationPosition,
                c.Amount, c.Status, c.RecordedAtUtc
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return rows.Select(r => new ContributionDetailResponse(
            r.Id, r.CycleId, r.UserId, r.MemberName, r.Role, r.RotationPosition,
            Money.ToCents(r.Amount), r.Status, r.RecordedAtUtc)).ToList();
    }

    private static ContributionDetailResponse ToDto(Contribution c) =>
        new(c.Id, c.CycleId, c.UserId, c.Member.User.FullName, c.Member.Role, c.Member.RotationPosition,
            Money.ToCents(c.Amount), c.Status, c.RecordedAtUtc);
}

----- FILE: API\Services\ContributionServices.cs -----
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;   // NEW 6.2

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

public interface IContributionService
{
    Task<(ContributionResponse Response, bool WasReplayed)> RecordContributionAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request, string idempotencyKey);
}

public sealed class ContributionService(
    IStokvelRepository stokvels,
    IUserRepository users,
    IContributionCycleRepository cycles,
    IContributionRepository contributions,
    IIdempotencyStore idempotencyStore) : IContributionService
{
    public async Task<(ContributionResponse Response, bool WasReplayed)> RecordContributionAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request, string idempotencyKey)
    {
        var requestHash = ComputeHash(stokvelId, request);

        var existing = await idempotencyStore.GetAsync(idempotencyKey);
        if (existing is not null)
        {
            if (existing.RequestHash != requestHash)
                throw new DomainConflictException("This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.");

            return (existing.Response, true);
        }

        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");

        var user = await users.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId)
            ?? throw new DomainReferenceException($"User {request.UserId} does not exist.");

        if (!stokvel.HasMember(user.Id))
            throw new DomainReferenceException("That user is not a member of this stokvel.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no name, no stokvel name

        var cycle = await cycles.GetByIdAsync(request.CycleId);
        if (cycle is null || cycle.StokvelId != stokvelId)
            throw new DomainReferenceException($"Cycle {request.CycleId} does not exist for this stokvel.");

        // NEW 7.4: a Closed or PaidOut cycle takes no more money. The form shows this detail if the cycle closes mid-edit.
        if (cycle.Status != CycleStatus.Open)
            throw new DomainConflictException("This cycle is no longer open, so contributions cannot be recorded.");

        if (await contributions.ExistsAsync(stokvelId, user.Id, request.CycleId))
            throw new DomainConflictException("This member has already contributed for this cycle.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no name

        var contribution = new Contribution(stokvelId, user.Id, request.CycleId, request.Amount);
        await contributions.AddAsync(contribution);
        RondiMetrics.ContributionRecorded();   // NEW 6.2: counted only after the row is really saved

        var response = contribution.ToResponse();
        await idempotencyStore.SaveAsync(idempotencyKey, new IdempotencyRecord(requestHash, response));

        return (response, false);
    }

    private static string ComputeHash(Guid stokvelId, ContributionRequest request)
    {
        var raw = $"{stokvelId}|{request.UserId}|{request.CycleId}|{request.Amount}";
        var bytes = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(raw));
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes);
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\CycleSummaryService.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

// NEW 7.2: the small cycle rules that /me/home and /cycles both need
public static class CycleRules
{
    // South Africa is UTC+2 all year (no daylight saving since 1944), so a fixed offset is safe
    private static readonly TimeSpan SaOffset = TimeSpan.FromHours(2);

    // Closed is not stored: a cycle is Closed once the job set ClosedAtUtc. PaidOut wins over Closed.
    public static CycleStatus Display(CycleStatus stored, DateTime? closedAtUtc) =>
        stored == CycleStatus.PaidOut ? CycleStatus.PaidOut
        : closedAtUtc is not null ? CycleStatus.Closed
        : CycleStatus.Open;

    // The due date as a UTC instant. EndsOn is a South African calendar date, so the cycle runs until 23:59:59 SAST that day.
    public static DateTime DueAtUtc(DateOnly? endsOn, DateTime createdAtUtc, ContributionFrequency frequency)
    {
        if (endsOn is DateOnly day)
            return new DateTimeOffset(day.ToDateTime(new TimeOnly(23, 59, 59)), SaOffset).UtcDateTime;
        return Advance(new DateTimeOffset(createdAtUtc, TimeSpan.Zero), frequency).UtcDateTime;
    }

    // one period after a date, by the stokvel's frequency
    public static DateTimeOffset Advance(DateTimeOffset from, ContributionFrequency f) => f switch
    {
        ContributionFrequency.Weekly => from.AddDays(7),
        ContributionFrequency.Fortnightly => from.AddDays(14),
        _ => from.AddMonths(1)
    };
}

public interface ICycleSummaryService
{
    Task<IReadOnlyList<CycleSummaryResponse>> ListAsync(Guid stokvelId, CancellationToken ct);
}

public sealed class CycleSummaryService(RondiTrackDbContext db) : ICycleSummaryService
{
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<CycleSummaryResponse>> ListAsync(Guid stokvelId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var stokvel = await db.Stokvels.AsNoTracking().Where(s => s.Id == stokvelId)
            .Select(s => new { s.ContributionAmount, s.Frequency }).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");

        var members = await db.StokvelMembers.CountAsync(m => m.StokvelId == stokvelId, ct);

        // newest cycle first (highest number)
        var cycles = await db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId)
            .OrderByDescending(c => c.CycleNumber)
            .Select(c => new { c.Id, c.CycleNumber, c.Status, c.CreatedAtUtc, c.EndsOn, c.ClosedAtUtc })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        // total collected per cycle, summed in the database
        var totals = await db.Contributions.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId)
            .GroupBy(c => c.CycleId)
            .Select(g => new { CycleId = g.Key, Total = g.Sum(x => x.Amount) })
            .ToListAsync(ct);
        var collected = totals.ToDictionary(t => t.CycleId, t => Money.ToCents(t.Total));

        // what the whole stokvel owes for one cycle (uses today's member count)
        var dueCents = Money.ToCents(stokvel.ContributionAmount) * members;

        return cycles.Select(c => new CycleSummaryResponse(
            c.Id,
            c.CycleNumber,
            CycleRules.Display(c.Status, c.ClosedAtUtc),
            DateTime.SpecifyKind(c.CreatedAtUtc, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            CycleRules.DueAtUtc(c.EndsOn, c.CreatedAtUtc, stokvel.Frequency),
            collected.GetValueOrDefault(c.Id),
            dueCents)).ToList();
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\HomeService.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Common;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

public interface IHomeService
{
    Task<HomeResponse> GetAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct);
}

public sealed class HomeService(RondiTrackDbContext db, TimeProvider time) : IHomeService
{
    public async Task<HomeResponse> GetAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var now = time.GetUtcNow();   // never DateTime.Now: tests can fake it

        // 1. every stokvel this user is in, with THEIR role in each
        var mine = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => m.UserId == userId)
            .Select(m => new { m.StokvelId, m.Role, m.Stokvel.Name, m.Stokvel.ContributionAmount, m.Stokvel.Frequency })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (mine.Count == 0) return new HomeResponse([]);   // empty list, never 404

        var ids = mine.Select(x => x.StokvelId).ToList();

        // 2. the open cycles. CHANGED 7.2: a cycle the job already closed is not "current"
        var openCycles = await db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => ids.Contains(c.StokvelId) && c.Status == Domain.CycleStatus.Open && c.ClosedAtUtc == null)
            .OrderByDescending(c => c.CycleNumber)
            .Select(c => new { c.Id, c.StokvelId, c.CycleNumber, c.CreatedAtUtc, c.EndsOn })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var cycleIds = openCycles.Select(c => c.Id).ToList();
        // only the caller's own contributions: other members' amounts never leave the server
        var paid = await db.Contributions.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.UserId == userId && cycleIds.Contains(c.CycleId))
            .Select(c => new { c.CycleId, c.Amount })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        // NEW 7.2: the caller's OWN arrears per stokvel, added up in cents by the database
        var arrears = await db.Arrears.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(a => a.UserId == userId && ids.Contains(a.StokvelId))
            .GroupBy(a => a.StokvelId)
            .Select(g => new { StokvelId = g.Key, Cents = g.Sum(a => a.ShortfallCents) })
            .ToListAsync(ct);
        var arrearsByStokvel = arrears.ToDictionary(a => a.StokvelId, a => a.Cents);

        var items = mine.Select(s =>
        {
            long? arrearsCents = arrearsByStokvel.TryGetValue(s.StokvelId, out var owedBefore) && owedBefore > 0 ? owedBefore : null;

            var cycle = openCycles.FirstOrDefault(c => c.StokvelId == s.StokvelId);   // newest open one
            if (cycle is null)
                return new HomeStokvelDto(s.StokvelId, s.Name, s.Role, null, 0, 0, null, arrearsCents);

            var start = DateTime.SpecifyKind(cycle.CreatedAtUtc, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            var due = CycleRules.DueAtUtc(cycle.EndsOn, cycle.CreatedAtUtc, s.Frequency);   // CHANGED 7.2: the real due date

            // next payout: unchanged rule, always in the future
            var payout = CycleRules.Advance(new DateTimeOffset(start), s.Frequency);
            while (payout <= now) payout = CycleRules.Advance(payout, s.Frequency);

            // money as integer cents
            var paidCents = Money.ToCents(paid.Where(p => p.CycleId == cycle.Id).Sum(p => p.Amount));
            var dueCents = Money.ToCents(s.ContributionAmount);

            return new HomeStokvelDto(
                s.StokvelId, s.Name, s.Role,
                new HomeCycleDto(cycle.Id, cycle.CycleNumber, Domain.CycleStatus.Open, start, due),
                paidCents, Math.Max(0, dueCents - paidCents), payout.UtcDateTime, arrearsCents);
        }).ToList();

        return new HomeResponse(items);
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\IdempotencyStore.cs -----
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

public sealed record IdempotencyRecord(string RequestHash, ContributionResponse Response);

public interface IIdempotencyStore
{
    Task<IdempotencyRecord?> GetAsync(string key);
    Task SaveAsync(string key, IdempotencyRecord record);
}

public sealed class InMemoryIdempotencyStore : IIdempotencyStore
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, IdempotencyRecord> _records = new();

    public Task<IdempotencyRecord?> GetAsync(string key)
    {
        _records.TryGetValue(key, out var record);
        return Task.FromResult(record);
    }

    public Task SaveAsync(string key, IdempotencyRecord record)
    {
        _records[key] = record;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\MemberPagingService.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Api.Common.Paging;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

// NEW: second paged endpoint. Members of a stokvel, in rotation order.
// RotationPosition is unique per stokvel (unique index from 5.2), so it is its own tiebreaker.
public sealed class MemberPagingService(RondiTrackDbContext db)
{
    // Returns null when the stokvel does not exist (controller turns that into 404).
    public async Task<PagedResponse<UserResponse>?> ListAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, int? pageSizeRequested, string? pageToken, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var pageSize = PagingDefaults.Resolve(pageSizeRequested);

        if (!await db.Stokvels.AnyAsync(s => s.Id == stokvelId, ct)) return null;

        var context = PageTokenCodec.ContextOf("rotation", stokvelId);

        var query = db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking().Where(m => m.StokvelId == stokvelId);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageToken))
        {
            var cursor = PageTokenCodec.Decode(pageToken, context);
            if (!int.TryParse(cursor.LastValue, out var lastPosition))
                throw new ApiBadRequestException("pageToken is invalid.");
            query = query.Where(m => m.RotationPosition > lastPosition);   // keyset
        }

        var rows = await query
            .OrderBy(m => m.RotationPosition)
            .Take(pageSize + 1)
            .Select(m => new
            {
                m.RotationPosition,
                m.User.Id,
                m.User.FullName,
                m.User.Email,
                m.User.CreatedAtUtc
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var hasMore = rows.Count > pageSize;
        var page = rows.Take(pageSize).ToList();

        var next = hasMore
            ? PageTokenCodec.Encode(new PageCursor(context, page[^1].RotationPosition.ToString(), Guid.Empty))
            : "";

        var items = page.Select(r => new UserResponse(r.Id, r.FullName, r.Email, r.CreatedAtUtc)).ToList();
        return new PagedResponse<UserResponse>(items, next);
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\MyStokvelsService.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

// NEW 8.1: builds "my stokvels" and the stokvel detail. A fixed number of queries, never one per stokvel.
public sealed class MyStokvelsService(RondiTrackDbContext db)
{
    // Every stokvel the user belongs to, with their role in each (empty list if none)
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<MyStokvelResponse>> ListMineAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // query 1: my memberships with the stokvel's basic facts
        var memberships = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => m.UserId == userId)
            .OrderBy(m => m.Stokvel.Name)
            .Select(m => new
            {
                m.StokvelId,
                m.Stokvel.Name,
                m.Stokvel.ContributionAmount,
                m.Stokvel.Frequency,
                m.Role,
                MemberCount = m.Stokvel.Memberships.Count
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (memberships.Count == 0) return [];   // no stokvels is still a normal 200 with an empty list

        // queries 2 and 3: current cycle + sums for all those stokvels at once
        var frequencies = memberships.ToDictionary(m => m.StokvelId, m => m.Frequency);
        var cycles = await LoadCurrentCyclesAsync(frequencies, userId, ct);

        return memberships.Select(m =>
        {
            cycles.TryGetValue(m.StokvelId, out var found);
            var summary = cycles.ContainsKey(m.StokvelId) ? found.Summary : null;
            var paid = cycles.ContainsKey(m.StokvelId) ? found.MyPaid : 0m;
            var owed = summary is null ? 0m : Math.Max(m.ContributionAmount - paid, 0m);   // what I still owe this cycle

            return new MyStokvelResponse(
                m.StokvelId, m.Name, m.ContributionAmount, m.Frequency, m.MemberCount, m.Role,
                paid, owed, summary?.NextPayoutDateUtc, summary);
        }).ToList();
    }

    // Detail of ONE stokvel (the controller already checked the caller may see it)
    public async Task<StokvelDetailResponse> GetDetailAsync(Stokvel stokvel, Guid? userId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        StokvelRole? role = null;
        if (userId is Guid uid)
        {
            role = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(m => m.UserId == uid && m.StokvelId == stokvel.Id)
                .Select(m => (StokvelRole?)m.Role)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
        }

        var cycles = await LoadCurrentCyclesAsync(
            new Dictionary<Guid, ContributionFrequency> { [stokvel.Id] = stokvel.Frequency }, userId, ct);
        var summary = cycles.TryGetValue(stokvel.Id, out var found) ? found.Summary : null;

        return new StokvelDetailResponse(
            stokvel.Id, stokvel.Name, stokvel.ContributionAmount, stokvel.Frequency, stokvel.MaxMembers,
            stokvel.Members.Count, stokvel.IsFull, stokvel.PayoutPerCycle, stokvel.CreatedAtUtc,
            role, summary);
    }

    // For each stokvel: its newest OPEN cycle, how much was collected, and how much THIS user paid
    private async Task<Dictionary<Guid, (CurrentCycleSummaryResponse Summary, decimal MyPaid)>> LoadCurrentCyclesAsync(
        Dictionary<Guid, ContributionFrequency> frequencies, Guid? userId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var stokvelIds = frequencies.Keys.ToList();

        var open = await db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => stokvelIds.Contains(c.StokvelId) && c.Status == CycleStatus.Open)
            .Select(c => new { c.Id, c.StokvelId, c.CycleNumber, c.TargetAmount, c.CreatedAtUtc })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        // newest open cycle per stokvel
        var latest = open.GroupBy(c => c.StokvelId)
            .Select(g => g.OrderByDescending(c => c.CycleNumber).First())
            .ToList();

        var result = new Dictionary<Guid, (CurrentCycleSummaryResponse, decimal)>();
        if (latest.Count == 0) return result;

        var cycleIds = latest.Select(c => c.Id).ToList();
        var me = userId ?? Guid.Empty;

        // one grouped query: total collected and my share, per cycle (runs in PostgreSQL)
        var sums = (await db.Contributions.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => cycleIds.Contains(c.CycleId))
            .GroupBy(c => c.CycleId)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                CycleId = g.Key,
                Total = g.Sum(x => x.Amount),
                Mine = g.Sum(x => x.UserId == me ? x.Amount : 0m)
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct)).ToDictionary(s => s.CycleId);

        foreach (var c in latest)
        {
            sums.TryGetValue(c.Id, out var s);
            var collected = s?.Total ?? 0m;
            var mine = s?.Mine ?? 0m;
            var next = NextPayout(c.CreatedAtUtc, frequencies[c.StokvelId]);
            result[c.StokvelId] = (
                new CurrentCycleSummaryResponse(c.Id, c.CycleNumber, c.TargetAmount, collected, c.CreatedAtUtc, next),
                mine);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // The model has no payout schedule, so the next payout is the cycle start plus one period
    private static DateTime NextPayout(DateTime start, ContributionFrequency frequency) => frequency switch
    {
        ContributionFrequency.Weekly => start.AddDays(7),
        ContributionFrequency.Fortnightly => start.AddDays(14),
        _ => start.AddMonths(1)
    };
}


----- FILE: API\Services\PayoutServices.cs -----
using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

// Lets a test force a failure between the two writes. Does nothing in production.
public interface IPayoutFaultHook
{
    void AfterPayoutInserted();
}

public sealed class NoOpPayoutFaultHook : IPayoutFaultHook
{
    public void AfterPayoutInserted() { }
}

public interface IPayoutService
{
    Task<PayoutResponse> ProcessNextPayoutAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId, CancellationToken ct = default);
}

// EDIT 5.2: now also receives IStokvelMemberRepository (members are no longer read straight from the DbContext)
public sealed class PayoutService(
    RondiTrackDbContext db,
    IPayoutFaultHook faultHook,
    IStokvelMemberRepository members) : IPayoutService
{
    // NEW 6.2: the public method only adds the span and the metric. The money logic is unchanged (below).
    public async Task<PayoutResponse> ProcessNextPayoutAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // our own span, named for the business operation. The SQL spans start INSIDE it, so they nest under it.
        using var activity = RondiTelemetry.Source.StartActivity("payout.process");

        try
        {
            var result = await ProcessAsync(stokvelId, cycleId, activity, ct);

            activity?.SetTag("payout.outcome", PayoutOutcomes.Success);   // safe: fixed label
            RondiMetrics.PayoutProcessed(PayoutOutcomes.Success);         // counter, tagged by outcome
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // a rule said no = "rejected"; anything else (database, bug) = "error"
            var outcome = ex is DomainException ? PayoutOutcomes.Rejected : PayoutOutcomes.Error;

            activity?.SetTag("payout.outcome", outcome);
            activity?.SetTag("error.type", ex.GetType().Name);            // class name only, never the message
            activity?.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Error);                // a failed payout = error span (no description on purpose)
            RondiMetrics.PayoutProcessed(outcome);
            throw;                                                        // the exception handler still turns it into a response
        }
    }

    // The original 5.x logic, moved here unchanged except for the one cycle-number tag
    private async Task<PayoutResponse> ProcessAsync(
        Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId, Activity? activity, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // Retry-on-failure is enabled, so a manual transaction must run inside the execution strategy.
        var strategy = db.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();

        return await strategy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
        {
            db.ChangeTracker.Clear(); // clean slate if the strategy retries

            await using var tx = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
            try
            {
                // Stays TRACKED on purpose, because we change its status and save below
                var cycle = await db.ContributionCycles
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == cycleId && c.StokvelId == stokvelId, ct)
                    ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException(
                        $"Cycle {cycleId} was not found for stokvel {stokvelId}.");

                activity?.SetTag("payout.cycle_number", cycle.CycleNumber);   // safe: a sequence number (1, 2, 3...)

                if (cycle.Status != CycleStatus.Open)
                    throw new DomainConflictException("This cycle has already been paid out.");

                // Payouts now record the recipient's UserId (not a StokvelMember.Id)
                var paidUserIds = await db.Payouts
                    .Where(p => p.StokvelId == stokvelId)
                    .Select(p => p.RecipientUserId)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                // EDIT 5.2: read-only (untracked) through the dedicated repository, already ordered by rotation
                var next = (await members.GetByStokvelAsync(stokvelId))
                    .FirstOrDefault(m => !paidUserIds.Contains(m.UserId))
                    ?? throw new DomainConflictException("Every member has already been paid in this rotation.");

                var total = await db.Contributions
                    .Where(c => c.CycleId == cycleId)
                    .SumAsync(c => c.Amount, ct);

                if (total <= 0)
                    throw new DomainConflictException("No contributions have been recorded for this cycle.");

                var payout = new Payout(stokvelId, cycleId, next.UserId, total);   // EDIT 5.2: next.UserId
                db.Payouts.Add(payout);
                await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);          // write 1: the payout

                faultHook.AfterPayoutInserted();        // a test can throw here

                cycle.MarkPaidOut();
                await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);          // write 2: the cycle status

                await tx.CommitAsync(ct);

                return new PayoutResponse(
                    payout.Id, payout.StokvelId, payout.CycleId,
                    payout.RecipientUserId, payout.Amount, payout.PaidAtUtc);   // EDIT 5.2
            }
            catch
            {
                await tx.RollbackAsync(ct);
                throw;
            }
        });
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Services\StokvelMembershipService.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Services;

public interface IStokvelMembershipService
{
    Task<User> AddMemberAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId);
    Task RemoveMemberAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId);
}

public sealed class StokvelMembershipService(IStokvelRepository stokvels, IUserRepository users)
    : IStokvelMembershipService
{
    public async Task<User> AddMemberAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId)
    {
        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");

        var user = await users.GetByIdAsync(userId)
            ?? throw new DomainReferenceException($"User {userId} does not exist.");

        stokvel.AddMember(user); // still Stokvel's own rule: no duplicates, no exceeding capacity
        await stokvels.UpdateAsync(stokvel);
        return user;
    }

    public async Task RemoveMemberAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId)
    {
        var stokvel = await stokvels.GetByIdAsync(stokvelId)
            ?? throw new DomainNotFoundException($"Stokvel {stokvelId} was not found.");

        if (!stokvel.RemoveMember(userId))
            throw new DomainNotFoundException($"User {userId} is not a member of this stokvel.");

        await stokvels.UpdateAsync(stokvel);
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features;

namespace RondiTrack.Telemetry;

// The ONE correlation id: the W3C trace id of the request
public static class CorrelationId
{
    public static string For(HttpContext context)
    {
        // the request's own activity (carries the caller's traceparent if they sent one)
        var activity = context.Features.Get<IHttpActivityFeature>()?.Activity ?? Activity.Current;

        return activity is { IdFormat: ActivityIdFormat.W3C }
            ? activity.TraceId.ToString()        // 32 hex characters
            : context.TraceIdentifier;           // fallback if there is no activity (e.g. unit tests)
    }
}

// Static on purpose: services stay constructible by hand in unit tests
public static class RondiMetrics
{
    public const string ContributionsRecordedName = "ronditrack.contributions.recorded";
    public const string PayoutsProcessedName = "ronditrack.payouts.processed";
    public const string AuthorizationRefusalsName = "ronditrack.authorization.refusals";
    public const string CyclesClosedName = "ronditrack.cycles.closed";       // 6.4
    public const string ArrearsRecordedName = "ronditrack.arrears.recorded"; // 6.4

    // MUST be first: static fields are initialised top to bottom, and every counter below needs it
    private static readonly Meter AppMeter = new(RondiTelemetry.MeterName);

    private static readonly Counter<long> Contributions =
        AppMeter.CreateCounter<long>(ContributionsRecordedName, description: "Contributions recorded");   // no tags

    private static readonly Counter<long> Payouts =
        AppMeter.CreateCounter<long>(PayoutsProcessedName, description: "Payouts processed, by outcome");

    private static readonly Counter<long> Refusals =
        AppMeter.CreateCounter<long>(AuthorizationRefusalsName, description: "Authorization refusals, by result");

    private static readonly Counter<long> CyclesClosedCounter =
        AppMeter.CreateCounter<long>(CyclesClosedName, description: "Cycles closed by the job");      // 6.4, no tags

    private static readonly Counter<long> ArrearsCounter =
        AppMeter.CreateCounter<long>(ArrearsRecordedName, description: "Arrears recorded by the job"); // 6.4, no tags

    public static void ContributionRecorded() => Contributions.Add(1);

    // tag "outcome": success | rejected | error  (3 values)
    public static void PayoutProcessed(string outcome) =>
        Payouts.Add(1, new KeyValuePair<string, object?>("outcome", outcome));

    // tag "result": not_found | forbidden  (2 values)
    public static void AuthorizationRefused(string result) =>
        Refusals.Add(1, new KeyValuePair<string, object?>("result", result));

    public static void CyclesClosed(long n) => CyclesClosedCounter.Add(n);      // 6.4
    public static void ArrearsRecorded(long n) => ArrearsCounter.Add(n);        // 6.4
}

----- FILE: API\Validation\ValidationFilter.cs -----
using FluentValidation;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace RondiTrack.Validation;

public sealed class ValidationFilter(IServiceProvider serviceProvider) : IAsyncActionFilter
{
    public async Task OnActionExecutionAsync(ActionExecutingContext context, ActionExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        foreach (var arg in context.ActionArguments.Values)
        {
            if (arg is null) continue;

            var validatorType = typeof(IValidator<>).MakeGenericType(arg.GetType());
            if (serviceProvider.GetService(validatorType) is IValidator validator)
            {
                var validationContext = new ValidationContext<object>(arg);
                var result = await validator.ValidateAsync(validationContext);
                if (!result.IsValid)
                    throw new ValidationException(result.Errors);
            }
        }

        await next();
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Web\CorsSetup.cs -----
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors.Infrastructure;

namespace RondiTrack.Web;

public static class CorsSetup
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddFrontendCors(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddCors();
        // Options pattern = read lazily, so test UseSetting overrides are always seen
        services.AddOptions<CorsOptions>().Configure<IConfiguration>((o, config) =>
        {
            var origins = config.GetSection("Cors:AllowedOrigins").Get<string[]>() ?? [];
            if (origins.Any(x => x.Contains('*') || x.EndsWith('/')))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Cors:AllowedOrigins must be exact origins: no '*', no trailing slash.");

            o.AddPolicy(CorsPolicies.Frontend, p => p
                .WithOrigins(origins)                                   // empty list = nobody allowed
                .WithMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE")
                .WithHeaders("Content-Type", "Authorization", ApiHeaders.IdempotencyKey, "If-Match", "If-None-Match")
                .WithExposedHeaders("Retry-After", ApiHeaders.IdempotencyReplayed, "ETag", "Location")
                .AllowCredentials()
                .SetPreflightMaxAge(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10)));
        });
        return services;
    }

    /// The exception handler clears response headers, so CORS headers set earlier are lost on
    /// exception-based errors (404/403/409/500). Call this at the top of the handler to put them back.
    public static async Task ReapplyAsync(HttpContext ctx)
    {
        var sp = ctx.RequestServices;
        if (sp is null) return;                                   // bare DefaultHttpContext in unit tests: nothing to reapply
        var provider = sp.GetService<ICorsPolicyProvider>();
        var service = sp.GetService<ICorsService>();
        if (provider is null || service is null) return;          // CORS not registered
        var policy = await provider.GetPolicyAsync(ctx, CorsPolicies.Frontend);
        if (policy is null) return;
        service.ApplyResult(service.EvaluatePolicy(ctx, policy), ctx.Response);
    }
}

----- FILE: API\Web\RateLimitingSetup.cs -----
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;

namespace RondiTrack.Web;

public static class RateLimitingSetup
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddRondiRateLimiting(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddRateLimiter(_ => { });
        services.AddOptions<RateLimiterOptions>().Configure<IConfiguration>((o, cfg) =>
        {
            o.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;   // default is 503
            o.OnRejected = WriteRejectionAsync;

            var login = cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Login");
            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Login, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(ClientIp(ctx), _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                {
                    PermitLimit = login.GetValue("PermitLimit", 5),
                    Window = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(login.GetValue("WindowSeconds", 60.0)),
                    QueueLimit = 0,
                    AutoReplenishment = true
                }));

            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Contribution, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(UserKey(ctx), _ => Bucket(cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Contribution"))));

            o.AddPolicy(RateLimitPolicies.Payout, ctx =>
                RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(UserKey(ctx), _ => Bucket(cfg.GetSection("RateLimiting:Payout"))));
        });
        return services;
    }

    private static TokenBucketRateLimiterOptions Bucket(IConfigurationSection s) => new()
    {
        TokenLimit = s.GetValue("TokenLimit", 30),
        TokensPerPeriod = s.GetValue("TokensPerPeriod", 5),
        ReplenishmentPeriod = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(s.GetValue("ReplenishSeconds", 60.0)),
        QueueLimit = 0,              // reject, never hold a money request open
        AutoReplenishment = true
    };

    private static string ClientIp(HttpContext c) => "ip:" + (c.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown");

    // signed-in user id; falls back to IP only for unauthenticated callers (they'll get 401 afterwards)
    private static string UserKey(HttpContext c) =>
        c.User.FindFirstValue("sub") is { Length: > 0 } sub ? "user:" + sub : ClientIp(c);

    private static async ValueTask WriteRejectionAsync(OnRejectedContext ctx, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var http = ctx.HttpContext;
        var seconds = 1;
        if (ctx.Lease.TryGetMetadata(MetadataName.RetryAfter, out var retry))
            seconds = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(retry.TotalSeconds));

        http.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
        http.Response.Headers.RetryAfter = seconds.ToString();

        var problem = new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails
        {
            Status = 429,
            Title = "Too many requests",
            Detail = $"Rate limit reached. Try again in {seconds} second(s).",
            Type = "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6585#section-4"
        };
        problem.Extensions["correlationId"] = CorrelationId.For(http);   // your 6.2 helper
        await http.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(problem, options: null, contentType: "application/problem+json", ct);
    }
}

namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

// 6.4: money a member still owed when a cycle closed. A financial record, so it is never deleted by the jobs.
public sealed class Arrear
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid StokvelId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CycleId { get; private set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; private set; }
    public long ShortfallCents { get; private set; }   // integer cents, exact
    public DateTime RecordedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    private Arrear() { }   // for EF only

    // 6.4: time comes in as a parameter (TimeProvider), never DateTime.UtcNow
    public Arrear(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId, Guid userId, long shortfallCents, DateTime recordedAtUtc)
    {
        if (shortfallCents <= 0) throw new DomainValidationException("Shortfall must be greater than zero.");
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        StokvelId = stokvelId;
        CycleId = cycleId;
        UserId = userId;
        ShortfallCents = shortfallCents;
        RecordedAtUtc = recordedAtUtc;
    }
}

----- FILE: Domain\Contribution.cs -----
namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

public sealed class Contribution
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid StokvelId { get; private set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; private set; }
    public Guid CycleId { get; private set; }   // stays a bare Guid on purpose (a stated "not yet")
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public DateTime RecordedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    // NEW 7.2: Paid by default (a member recorded it). The treasurer's check moves it to Confirmed.
    public ContributionStatus Status { get; private set; } = ContributionStatus.Paid;

    // Points at ONE specific membership (composite foreign key UserId + StokvelId)
    public StokvelMember Member { get; private set; } = null!;

    private Contribution() { } // for EF Core only

    public Contribution(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId, decimal amount)
    {
        if (amount <= 0)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Contribution amount must be greater than zero.");

        if (decimal.Round(amount, 2) != amount)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Amount cannot have more than 2 decimal places.");

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        StokvelId = stokvelId;
        UserId = userId;
        CycleId = cycleId;
        Amount = amount;
        RecordedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

----- FILE: Domain\ContributionCycle.cs -----
namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

public sealed class ContributionCycle
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid StokvelId { get; private set; }
    public int CycleNumber { get; private set; }
    public decimal TargetAmount { get; private set; }
    public CycleStatus Status { get; private set; } = CycleStatus.Open;
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    // ADDED 5.3: PostgreSQL's built-in row version (xmin). Not a real column.
    public uint Version { get; private set; }

    // 6.4: last day of the cycle, as a calendar date in the stokvel's time zone (Africa/Johannesburg). null = no end date, job ignores it
    // CHANGED: moved up inside the class (it was outside the class before, which broke the build)
    public DateOnly? EndsOn { get; private set; }

    // 6.4: set ONCE by a conditional UPDATE ... WHERE ClosedAtUtc IS NULL. This is the "exactly once" marker.
    // CHANGED: moved up inside the class
    public DateTime? ClosedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    // Real navigation (the second one-to-many: Stokvel -> ContributionCycle)
    public Stokvel Stokvel { get; private set; } = null!;

    private ContributionCycle() { } // for EF Core only

    public ContributionCycle(Guid stokvelId, int cycleNumber, decimal targetAmount)
    {
        if (cycleNumber < 1)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Cycle number must be 1 or greater.");
        if (targetAmount <= 0)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Target amount must be greater than zero.");

        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        StokvelId = stokvelId;
        CycleNumber = cycleNumber;
        TargetAmount = targetAmount;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    // 6.4: constructor for the job. Time is passed in, so nothing here touches DateTime.UtcNow
    // CHANGED: moved up inside the class
    public ContributionCycle(Guid stokvelId, int cycleNumber, decimal targetAmount, DateOnly endsOn, DateTime createdAtUtc)
    {
        if (cycleNumber < 1) throw new DomainValidationException("Cycle number must be 1 or greater.");
        if (targetAmount <= 0) throw new DomainValidationException("Target amount must be greater than zero.");
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        StokvelId = stokvelId;
        CycleNumber = cycleNumber;
        TargetAmount = targetAmount;
        EndsOn = endsOn;
        CreatedAtUtc = createdAtUtc;
    }

    // ADDED 5.3: "the client last saw THIS version". Called before saving an update from a PUT.
    public void SetExpectedVersion(uint version) => Version = version;

    public void UpdateDetails(int cycleNumber, decimal targetAmount)
    {
        if (cycleNumber < 1)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Cycle number must be 1 or greater.");
        if (targetAmount <= 0)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Target amount must be greater than zero.");

        CycleNumber = cycleNumber;
        TargetAmount = targetAmount;
    }

    public void MarkPaidOut()
    {
        if (Status != CycleStatus.Open)
            throw new DomainConflictException("This cycle has already been paid out.");

        Status = CycleStatus.PaidOut;
    }
}

namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

// NEW 6.1: one refresh token. Every token from ONE login shares a FamilyId,
// so one reuse can revoke the whole chain.
public sealed class RefreshToken
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; private set; }
    public Guid FamilyId { get; private set; }                 // one login = one family
    public string TokenHash { get; private set; } = null!;     // only the hash is stored
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime ExpiresAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? UsedAtUtc { get; private set; }           // set when it was rotated
    public DateTime? RevokedAtUtc { get; private set; }        // set on logout or reuse
    public Guid? ReplacedByTokenId { get; private set; }       // the token that replaced it

    private RefreshToken() { } // for EF Core only

    public RefreshToken(Guid userId, Guid familyId, string tokenHash, DateTime nowUtc, DateTime expiresAtUtc)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        UserId = userId;
        FamilyId = familyId;
        TokenHash = tokenHash;
        CreatedAtUtc = nowUtc;
        ExpiresAtUtc = expiresAtUtc;
    }
}

----- FILE: Domain\Stokvel.cs -----
namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

public sealed class Stokvel
{
    public const int MaxNameLength = 100;
    public const int MinMembers = 2;
    public const int MaxMembersLimit = 50;
    public const decimal MaxContribution = 1_000_000m;

    private readonly List<User> _members = [];

    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public decimal ContributionAmount { get; private set; }
    public ContributionFrequency Frequency { get; private set; }
    public int MaxMembers { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    // ADDED 5.3: PostgreSQL's built-in row version (xmin). Not a real column.
    public uint Version { get; private set; }

    public IReadOnlyCollection<User> Members => _members.AsReadOnly();
    public decimal PayoutPerCycle => ContributionAmount * _members.Count;
    public bool IsFull => _members.Count >= MaxMembers;

    // The real EF Core navigations (Members above stays for the business rules)
    public List<StokvelMember> Memberships { get; } = [];
    public List<ContributionCycle> Cycles { get; } = [];

    private Stokvel() { Name = null!; } // for EF Core only

    public Stokvel(string name, decimal contributionAmount, ContributionFrequency frequency, int maxMembers)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Name = ValidateName(name);
        ContributionAmount = ValidateAmount(contributionAmount);
        Frequency = ValidateFrequency(frequency);
        MaxMembers = ValidateMaxMembers(maxMembers);
    }

    // CHANGED 5.4: internal -> public, because SeedData now lives in the Infrastructure project
    public Stokvel(Guid id, string name, decimal contributionAmount,
        ContributionFrequency frequency, int maxMembers)
        : this(name, contributionAmount, frequency, maxMembers)
    {
        Id = id;
    }

    // CHANGED 5.4: internal -> public, because EfStokvelRepository now lives in the Infrastructure project
    public void LoadMembers(IEnumerable<User> users)
    {
        _members.Clear();
        _members.AddRange(users);
    }

    // ADDED 5.3: "the client last saw THIS version". Called before saving an update from a PUT.
    public void SetExpectedVersion(uint version) => Version = version;

    public void UpdateDetails(string name, decimal contributionAmount,
        ContributionFrequency frequency, int maxMembers)
    {
        var validName = ValidateName(name);
        var validAmount = ValidateAmount(contributionAmount);
        var validFrequency = ValidateFrequency(frequency);
        var validMax = ValidateMaxMembers(maxMembers);

        if (validMax < _members.Count)
            throw new DomainConflictException(
                $"Cannot reduce capacity to {validMax}: this stokvel already has {_members.Count} members.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no stokvel name

        Name = validName;
        ContributionAmount = validAmount;
        Frequency = validFrequency;
        MaxMembers = validMax;
    }

    public void AddMember(User user)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(user);

        if (HasMember(user.Id))
            throw new DomainConflictException("That user is already a member of this stokvel.");   // CHANGED 6.2: no name

        if (IsFull)
            throw new DomainConflictException($"This stokvel is full ({MaxMembers} members).");   // CHANGED 6.2: no stokvel name

        _members.Add(user);
    }

    public bool RemoveMember(Guid userId) => _members.RemoveAll(m => m.Id == userId) > 0;

    public bool HasMember(Guid userId) => _members.Any(m => m.Id == userId);

    public User? FindMember(Guid userId) => _members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.Id == userId);

    private static string ValidateName(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Stokvel name is required.");

        var trimmed = name.Trim();
        if (trimmed.Length > MaxNameLength)
            throw new DomainValidationException($"Stokvel name cannot exceed {MaxNameLength} characters.");

        return trimmed;
    }

    private static decimal ValidateAmount(decimal amount)
    {
        if (amount <= 0)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Contribution amount must be greater than zero.");

        if (amount > MaxContribution)
            throw new DomainValidationException($"Contribution amount cannot exceed R{MaxContribution:N0}.");

        if (decimal.Round(amount, 2) != amount)
            throw new DomainValidationException("Contribution amount cannot have more than 2 decimal places.");

        return amount;
    }

    private static ContributionFrequency ValidateFrequency(ContributionFrequency frequency)
    {
        if (!Enum.IsDefined(frequency))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Frequency must be Weekly, Fortnightly or Monthly.");

        return frequency;
    }

    private static int ValidateMaxMembers(int maxMembers)
    {
        if (maxMembers < MinMembers || maxMembers > MaxMembersLimit)
            throw new DomainValidationException(
                $"Max members must be between {MinMembers} and {MaxMembersLimit}.");

        return maxMembers;
    }
}
