----- FILE: Domain\User.cs -----
using System.Net.Mail;

namespace RondiTrack.Domain;

public sealed class User
{
    public const int MaxNameLength = 100;

    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public string FullName { get; private set; }
    public string Email { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }

    // NEW 6.1: the password HASH (never the password). Null for users created without a password.
    public string? PasswordHash { get; private set; }

    // NEW 6.1: platform-level flag (not per stokvel). Becomes a role claim in the token.
    public bool IsPlatformAdmin { get; private set; }

    // ADDED 5.3: PostgreSQL's built-in row version (xmin). Not a real column.
    public uint Version { get; private set; }

    // Real navigation, one user has many memberships
    public List<StokvelMember> Memberships { get; } = [];

    private User() { FullName = null!; Email = null!; } // for EF Core only

    public User(string fullName, string email)
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        FullName = ValidateName(fullName);
        Email = ValidateEmail(email);
    }

    // CHANGED 5.4: internal -> public, because SeedData now lives in the Infrastructure project
    public User(Guid id, string fullName, string email) : this(fullName, email)
    {
        Id = id;
    }

    // ADDED 5.3: "the client last saw THIS version". Called before saving an update from a PUT.
    public void SetExpectedVersion(uint version) => Version = version;

    // NEW 6.1: stores the hash made by PasswordHasher<User>
    public void SetPasswordHash(string passwordHash)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(passwordHash))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Password hash is required.");

        PasswordHash = passwordHash;
    }

    public void UpdateDetails(string fullName, string email)
    {
        var validName = ValidateName(fullName);
        var validEmail = ValidateEmail(email);
        FullName = validName;
        Email = validEmail;
    }

    private static string ValidateName(string? fullName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fullName))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Full name is required.");

        var trimmed = fullName.Trim();
        if (trimmed.Length > MaxNameLength)
            throw new DomainValidationException($"Full name cannot exceed {MaxNameLength} characters.");

        return trimmed;
    }

    // Emails are trimmed and lower-cased here, so Lerato@X.com and lerato@x.com become the same value
    private static string ValidateEmail(string? email)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Email is required.");

        var trimmed = email.Trim();
        if (!MailAddress.TryCreate(trimmed, out var parsed)
            || parsed.Address != trimmed
            || !parsed.Host.Contains('.'))
            throw new DomainValidationException("Email address is not valid.");

        return trimmed.ToLowerInvariant();
    }
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using RondiTrack.Domain;   // IContributionCycleRepository now comes from Domain

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// interface removed: it now lives in Domain/Interfaces/IContributionCycleRepository.cs
public sealed class InMemoryContributionCycleRepository : IContributionCycleRepository
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, ContributionCycle> _cycles = new();

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<ContributionCycle>> GetByStokvelAsync(Guid stokvelId) =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<ContributionCycle>>(
            _cycles.Values.Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId).OrderBy(c => c.CycleNumber).ToList());

    public Task<ContributionCycle?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _cycles.TryGetValue(id, out var cycle);
        return Task.FromResult<ContributionCycle?>(cycle);
    }

    public Task AddAsync(ContributionCycle cycle)
    {
        _cycles[cycle.Id] = cycle;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task UpdateAsync(ContributionCycle cycle)
    {
        _cycles[cycle.Id] = cycle;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id) => Task.FromResult(_cycles.TryRemove(id, out _));
}

----- FILE: Infrastructure\Data\EfRefreshTokenRepository.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// NEW 6.1: refresh tokens in PostgreSQL
public sealed class EfRefreshTokenRepository(RondiTrackDbContext db) : IRefreshTokenRepository
{
    public async Task AddAsync(RefreshToken token)
    {
        db.RefreshTokens.Add(token);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    // pure read, so not tracked
    public async Task<RefreshToken?> GetByHashAsync(string tokenHash) =>
        await db.RefreshTokens.AsNoTracking().FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TokenHash == tokenHash);

    // One UPDATE with a WHERE that only matches an unused, unrevoked token.
    // If two requests race, only one gets "1 row changed"; the other gets 0 and is treated as reuse.
    public async Task<bool> TryMarkUsedAsync(Guid tokenId, Guid replacedByTokenId, DateTime nowUtc)
    {
        var rows = await db.RefreshTokens
            .Where(t => t.Id == tokenId && t.UsedAtUtc == null && t.RevokedAtUtc == null)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s
                .SetProperty(t => t.UsedAtUtc, (DateTime?)nowUtc)
                .SetProperty(t => t.ReplacedByTokenId, (Guid?)replacedByTokenId));
        return rows == 1;
    }

    // Revokes every not-yet-revoked token of this login (the whole family)
    public async Task RevokeFamilyAsync(Guid familyId, DateTime nowUtc) =>
        await db.RefreshTokens
            .Where(t => t.FamilyId == familyId && t.RevokedAtUtc == null)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(t => t.RevokedAtUtc, (DateTime?)nowUtc));
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// New file. Users, Stokvels and cycles move from in-memory to Postgres,
// because the new foreign keys need real rows on both sides.

public sealed class EfUserRepository(RondiTrackDbContext db) : IUserRepository
{
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<User>> GetAllAsync() =>
        await db.Users.AsNoTracking().OrderBy(u => u.FullName).ToListAsync();

    public async Task<User?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id) =>
        await db.Users.AsNoTracking().FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == id);

    // NEW 6.1: login looks the user up by the normalised (trimmed, lower-case) email
    public async Task<User?> GetByEmailAsync(string email)
    {
        var normalized = email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        return await db.Users.AsNoTracking().FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == normalized);
    }

    public Task<bool> EmailExistsAsync(string email, Guid? excludingUserId = null)
    {
        var normalized = email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        var query = db.Users.Where(u => u.Email == normalized);
        if (excludingUserId is Guid excluded)
            query = query.Where(u => u.Id != excluded);
        return query.AnyAsync();
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(User user)
    {
        db.Users.Add(user);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    // Reads are untracked, so a write attaches the changed object explicitly with Update()
    public async Task UpdateAsync(User user)
    {
        db.Users.Update(user);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id) =>
        await db.Users.Where(u => u.Id == id).ExecuteDeleteAsync() > 0;
}

public sealed class EfStokvelRepository(RondiTrackDbContext db) : IStokvelRepository
{
    // Eager loading: 2 queries in total, however many stokvels there are
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Stokvel>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var stokvels = await db.Stokvels.AsNoTracking().OrderBy(s => s.Name).ToListAsync();
        var memberships = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking()
            .Include(m => m.User)
            .OrderBy(m => m.RotationPosition)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var s in stokvels)
            s.LoadMembers(memberships.Where(m => m.StokvelId == s.Id).Select(m => m.User));

        return stokvels;
    }

    // Explicit loading: the stokvel first, then its members in a second, deliberate query
    public async Task<Stokvel?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var stokvel = await db.Stokvels.AsNoTracking().FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.Id == id);
        if (stokvel is null) return null;

        var users = await db.StokvelMembers.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => m.StokvelId == id)
            .OrderBy(m => m.RotationPosition)
            .Select(m => m.User)
            .ToListAsync();

        stokvel.LoadMembers(users);
        return stokvel;
    }

    public Task<bool> AnyWithMemberAsync(Guid userId) =>
        db.StokvelMembers.AnyAsync(m => m.UserId == userId);

    public async Task AddAsync(Stokvel stokvel)
    {
        db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    // Saves the stokvel's own columns AND turns the in-memory member list into StokvelMember rows
    public async Task UpdateAsync(Stokvel stokvel)
    {
        db.Stokvels.Update(stokvel);

        var existing = await db.StokvelMembers.Where(m => m.StokvelId == stokvel.Id).ToListAsync();
        var wantedIds = stokvel.Members.Select(u => u.Id).ToHashSet();

        foreach (var gone in existing.Where(m => !wantedIds.Contains(m.UserId)))
            db.StokvelMembers.Remove(gone);

        var haveIds = existing.Select(m => m.UserId).ToHashSet();
        var nextPosition = existing.Count == 0 ? 1 : existing.Max(m => m.RotationPosition) + 1;

        foreach (var user in stokvel.Members.Where(u => !haveIds.Contains(u.Id)))
            db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, user.Id, nextPosition++));

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id) =>
        await db.Stokvels.Where(s => s.Id == id).ExecuteDeleteAsync() > 0;
}

----- FILE: Infrastructure\Data\RondiTrackDbContext.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

public class RondiTrackDbContext : DbContext
{
    public RondiTrackDbContext(DbContextOptions<RondiTrackDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Stokvel> Stokvels => Set<Stokvel>();
    public DbSet<StokvelMember> StokvelMembers => Set<StokvelMember>();
    public DbSet<ContributionCycle> ContributionCycles => Set<ContributionCycle>();
    public DbSet<Contribution> Contributions => Set<Contribution>();
    public DbSet<Payout> Payouts => Set<Payout>();
    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();   // NEW 6.1
        public DbSet<Arrear> Arrears => Set<Arrear>();                              // 6.4
    public DbSet<IdempotencyEntry> IdempotencyEntries => Set<IdempotencyEntry>();   // 6.4
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder b)
    {
        b.Entity<User>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(u => u.Id);
            e.Property(u => u.FullName).HasMaxLength(User.MaxNameLength).IsRequired();
            e.Property(u => u.Email).HasMaxLength(320).IsRequired();
            e.Property(u => u.PasswordHash).HasMaxLength(500);   // NEW 6.1: nullable on purpose
            e.HasIndex(u => u.Email).IsUnique();                 // NEW 6.1: database-level "one account per email"
            e.Property(u => u.Version).IsRowVersion();   // ADDED 5.3: xmin concurrency token
        });

        b.Entity<Stokvel>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(s => s.Id);
            e.Property(s => s.Name).HasMaxLength(Stokvel.MaxNameLength).IsRequired();
            e.Property(s => s.ContributionAmount).HasPrecision(18, 2);
            e.Property(s => s.Frequency).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20);
            e.Property(s => s.Version).IsRowVersion();   // ADDED 5.3: xmin concurrency token

            // Members is a read-only wrapper over a private list of Users, so EF Core cannot fill it.
            // Membership is persisted through StokvelMember (the Memberships navigation) instead.
            e.Ignore(s => s.Members);
            e.Ignore(s => s.PayoutPerCycle); // calculated
            e.Ignore(s => s.IsFull);         // calculated
        });

        // StokvelMember now has a COMPOSITE primary key and two real relationships
        b.Entity<StokvelMember>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(m => new { m.UserId, m.StokvelId });   // composite natural key
            e.Property(m => m.Role).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20);
            // the old unique index on (StokvelId, UserId) is removed: the primary key does that job now
            e.HasIndex(m => new { m.StokvelId, m.RotationPosition }).IsUnique();

            e.HasOne(m => m.User)
             .WithMany(u => u.Memberships)
             .HasForeignKey(m => m.UserId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            e.HasOne(m => m.Stokvel)
             .WithMany(s => s.Memberships)
             .HasForeignKey(m => m.StokvelId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        b.Entity<ContributionCycle>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(c => c.Id);
            e.Property(c => c.TargetAmount).HasPrecision(18, 2);
            e.Property(c => c.Status).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20);
            e.Property(c => c.Version).IsRowVersion();   // ADDED 5.3: xmin concurrency token
            // NOTE 5.3: NOT unique on purpose. "One cycle number per stokvel" is not checked in C# today,
            // so it is written up as a gap in the README instead of being added as a new rule.
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.StokvelId, c.CycleNumber });

            // The second one-to-many (Stokvel -> ContributionCycle)
            e.HasOne(c => c.Stokvel)
             .WithMany(s => s.Cycles)
             .HasForeignKey(c => c.StokvelId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

                         // 6.4: lets the job find "open cycles that have an end date" without scanning every cycle
            e.HasIndex(c => c.EndsOn).HasFilter("\"ClosedAtUtc\" IS NULL").HasDatabaseName("IX_ContributionCycles_EndsOn_Open");

        });

        b.Entity<Contribution>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(c => c.Id);
            e.Property(c => c.Amount).HasPrecision(18, 2);
            e.Property(c => c.Status).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20).HasDefaultValue(ContributionStatus.Paid);   // 7.2

            // CHANGED 5.3: now UNIQUE. Database-level version of the C# rule
            // "a member contributes once per cycle" (ContributionService -> ExistsAsync).
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.CycleId, c.UserId }).IsUnique();

            // ADDED 5.3 (stage 2): composite index for the paged contributions query.
            // CycleId first (equality filter), then RecordedAtUtc (the sort), then Id (the tiebreaker),
            // so Postgres reads one cycle's rows already in order and can stop after LIMIT.
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.CycleId, c.RecordedAtUtc, c.Id })
             .HasDatabaseName("IX_Contributions_CycleId_RecordedAtUtc_Id");

            // Composite foreign key to ONE specific membership (same order as the primary key)
            e.HasOne(c => c.Member)
             .WithMany(m => m.Contributions)
             .HasForeignKey(c => new { c.UserId, c.StokvelId })
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        b.Entity<Payout>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(p => p.Id);
            e.Property(p => p.Amount).HasPrecision(18, 2);
            e.Property(p => p.Version).IsRowVersion();   // ADDED 5.3: xmin concurrency token
            e.HasIndex(p => p.CycleId).IsUnique(); // a cycle can only be paid out once

            // ADDED 5.3: a member is paid at most once per stokvel rotation.
            // Database-level version of the C# rule in PayoutService ("Every member has already been paid").
            e.HasIndex(p => new { p.StokvelId, p.RecipientUserId }).IsUnique();

            // EDIT 5.2: the recipient is one specific membership (composite foreign key, no navigation property)
            e.HasOne<StokvelMember>()
             .WithMany()
             .HasForeignKey(p => new { p.RecipientUserId, p.StokvelId })
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // NEW 6.1: refresh tokens
        b.Entity<RefreshToken>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(t => t.Id);
            e.Property(t => t.TokenHash).HasMaxLength(64).IsRequired();   // SHA-256 as 64 hex characters
            e.HasIndex(t => t.TokenHash).IsUnique();                      // lookup by hash, and no duplicates
            e.HasIndex(t => t.FamilyId);       
            e.HasIndex(t => t.ExpiresAtUtc);   // 6.4: housekeeping deletes by expiry                           // revoke a whole family fast

            // deleting a user also deletes their sessions (no navigation property needed)
            e.HasOne<User>()
             .WithMany()
             .HasForeignKey(t => t.UserId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

                     // 6.4: arrears. UNIQUE (cycle, member) = the database refuses a second arrear for the same member and cycle
        b.Entity<Arrear>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(a => a.Id);
            e.HasIndex(a => new { a.CycleId, a.UserId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne<ContributionCycle>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(a => a.CycleId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // 6.4: idempotency records in the database
        b.Entity<IdempotencyEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasKey(x => x.Key);
            e.Property(x => x.RequestHash).HasMaxLength(64).IsRequired();
            e.Property(x => x.ResponseJson).IsRequired();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CreatedAtUtc);   // housekeeping deletes by age
        });
        });
    }
}

----- FILE: Infrastructure\Data\SeedData.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

public static class SeedData
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<User> Users { get; }
    public static IReadOnlyList<Stokvel> Stokvels { get; }

    static SeedData()
    {
        var thandi  = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"), "Thandi Nkosi",   "thandi.nkosi@example.com");
        var sipho   = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"), "Sipho Dlamini",  "sipho.dlamini@example.com");
        var lerato  = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"), "Lerato Mokoena", "lerato.mokoena@example.com");
        var kagiso  = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004"), "Kagiso Molefe",  "kagiso.molefe@example.com");
        var naledi  = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005"), "Naledi Khumalo", "naledi.khumalo@example.com");
        var bongani = new User(Guid.Parse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006"), "Bongani Zulu",   "bongani.zulu@example.com");

        var ubuntu = new Stokvel(Guid.Parse("20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
            "Ubuntu Savers", 500m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 6);
        ubuntu.AddMember(thandi);
        ubuntu.AddMember(sipho);
        ubuntu.AddMember(lerato);

        var grocery = new Stokvel(Guid.Parse("20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"),
            "Festive Grocery Club", 250m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 3);
        grocery.AddMember(thandi);
        grocery.AddMember(kagiso);
        grocery.AddMember(naledi);

        Users = [thandi, sipho, lerato, kagiso, naledi, bongani];
        Stokvels = [ubuntu, grocery];
    }

    // New method. Puts the demo data into Postgres once (Development only)
    public static async Task EnsureSeededAsync(RondiTrackDbContext db)
    {
        if (await db.Users.AnyAsync()) return;

        try
        {
            // Fresh objects, so parallel hosts never share tracked instances
            var users = Users.Select(u => new User(u.Id, u.FullName, u.Email)).ToList();
            var stokvels = Stokvels
                .Select(s => new Stokvel(s.Id, s.Name, s.ContributionAmount, s.Frequency, s.MaxMembers))
                .ToList();

            db.Users.AddRange(users);
            db.Stokvels.AddRange(stokvels);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync(); // parents first

            foreach (var s in Stokvels)
            {
                var position = 1;
                foreach (var member in s.Members)
                    db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(s.Id, member.Id, position++));
            }
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            // another test host seeded at the same moment, nothing to do
        }
    }
}

            .ToListAsync();

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        db.StokvelMembers.Remove(member);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

public sealed class InMemoryStokvelRepository : IStokvelRepository
{

    {
        foreach (var stokvel in SeedData.Stokvels)

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<Stokvel>> GetAllAsync() =>

    {
        _stokvels.TryGetValue(id, out var stokvel);
        return Task.FromResult<Stokvel?>(stokvel);

        Task.FromResult(_stokvels.Values.Any(s => s.HasMember(userId)));

    public Task AddAsync(Stokvel stokvel)
    {
        _stokvels[stokvel.Id] = stokvel;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task UpdateAsync(Stokvel stokvel)
    {
        _stokvels[stokvel.Id] = stokvel;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id) => Task.FromResult(_stokvels.TryRemove(id, out _));
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using RondiTrack.Domain;   // IUserRepository now comes from Domain

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// interface removed: it now lives in Domain/Interfaces/IUserRepository.cs
public sealed class InMemoryUserRepository : IUserRepository
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, User> _users = new();

    public InMemoryUserRepository()
    {
        foreach (var user in SeedData.Users)
            _users[user.Id] = user;
    }

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<User>> GetAllAsync() =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<User>>(_users.Values.OrderBy(u => u.FullName).ToList());

    public Task<User?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        _users.TryGetValue(id, out var user);
        return Task.FromResult<User?>(user);
    }

    // NEW 6.1: needed because the interface has a new method
    public Task<User?> GetByEmailAsync(string email)
    {
        var normalized = email.Trim();
        var user = _users.Values.FirstOrDefault(u =>
            string.Equals(u.Email, normalized, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        return Task.FromResult<User?>(user);
    }

    public Task<bool> EmailExistsAsync(string email, Guid? excludingUserId = null)
    {
        var normalized = email.Trim();
        var exists = _users.Values.Any(u =>
            u.Id != excludingUserId &&
            string.Equals(u.Email, normalized, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        return Task.FromResult(exists);
    }

    public Task AddAsync(User user)
    {
        _users[user.Id] = user;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task UpdateAsync(User user)
    {
        _users[user.Id] = user;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public Task<bool> DeleteAsync(Guid id) => Task.FromResult(_users.TryRemove(id, out _));
}

----- FILE: Infrastructure\Data\VolumeSeeder.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Data;

// NEW 5.3: creates 3 stokvels x 100 members x 60 cycles = 18 000 contributions (100 per cycle).
// It NEVER runs on startup. Only when you start the app with:  dotnet run -- --seed-volume
// Members are added as StokvelMember rows directly (the 50-member cap is a rule inside the Stokvel class,
// the database does not enforce it), so each cycle gets 100 contributions.
public static class VolumeSeeder
{
    private const int StokvelCount = 3;
    private const int MembersPerStokvel = 100;
    private const int CyclesPerStokvel = 60;

    public static async Task RunAsync(RondiTrackDbContext db)
    {
        if (await db.Stokvels.AnyAsync(s => s.Name == "Volume Stokvel 1"))
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Volume data already exists. Nothing to do.");
            return;
        }

        var rnd = new Random(42);   // fixed seed: same data every time
        var start = new DateTime(2023, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        for (var s = 1; s <= StokvelCount; s++)
        {
            var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Volume Stokvel {s}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 50);
            var users = Enumerable.Range(1, MembersPerStokvel)
                .Select(i => new User($"Volume User {s}-{i}", $"vol{s}-{i}@volume.example.com"))
                .ToList();

            db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
            db.Users.AddRange(users);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();                         // parents first

            db.StokvelMembers.AddRange(users.Select((u, i) => new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, u.Id, i + 1)));
            var cycles = Enumerable.Range(1, CyclesPerStokvel)
                .Select(n => new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, n, 10_000m))
                .ToList();
            db.ContributionCycles.AddRange(cycles);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();                         // then members and cycles

            foreach (var cycle in cycles)
                foreach (var user in users)
                {
                    var c = new Contribution(stokvel.Id, user.Id, cycle.Id, rnd.Next(10, 100) * 10m);
                    db.Contributions.Add(c);
                    // RecordedAtUtc has a private setter, so set it through EF. Only 6 distinct hours per cycle,
                    // so many rows share the same date on purpose (that is what makes the tiebreaker matter).
                    db.Entry(c).Property(nameof(Contribution.RecordedAtUtc)).CurrentValue =
                        start.AddDays(cycle.CycleNumber * 30).AddHours(rnd.Next(0, 6));
                }

            await db.SaveChangesAsync();                         // then contributions
            db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            Console.WriteLine($"Seeded Volume Stokvel {s}.");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("Done: 3 stokvels, 300 users, 180 cycles, 18 000 contributions.");
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\AuthenticationTests.cs -----
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.1: register, login, refresh rotation, reuse detection, logout
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class AuthenticationTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private const string TestPassword = "a-long-test-password-123";   // throwaway test value, not a real secret
    private const string CookieName = "rondi_refresh";

    private readonly HttpClient _client = factory.CreateAnonymousClient();

    // ---- helpers ----

    private async Task<(string Email, Guid UserId)> RegisterAsync(string? email = null)
    {
        email ??= $"auth{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com";
        var response = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register",
            new { FullName = "Auth Tester", Email = email, Password = TestPassword });
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.StatusCode);

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        return (email, doc.RootElement.GetProperty("id").GetGuid());
    }

    private Task<HttpResponseMessage> LoginAsync(string email, string password = TestPassword) =>
        _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", new { Email = email, Password = password });

    // POST with the refresh cookie set by hand
    private Task<HttpResponseMessage> PostWithCookieAsync(string url, string? cookie)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url);
        if (cookie is not null) request.Headers.Add("Cookie", $"{CookieName}={cookie}");
        return _client.SendAsync(request);
    }

    private static string? CookieValue(HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        if (!response.Headers.TryGetValues("Set-Cookie", out var values)) return null;
        var line = values.FirstOrDefault(v => v.StartsWith($"{CookieName}="));
        return line?.Split(';')[0][(CookieName.Length + 1)..];
    }

    private static async Task<string> AccessTokenAsync(HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        return doc.RootElement.GetProperty("accessToken").GetString()!;
    }

    // ---- registration ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Register_With_Short_Password_Returns_400_Problem()
    {
        var response = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register",
            new { FullName = "Short Pass", Email = $"short{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com", Password = "tooshort" });

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Register_Same_Email_With_Different_Casing_Returns_409()
    {
        var email = $"Lerato{Guid.NewGuid():N}@X.com";
        await RegisterAsync(email);

        var second = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register",
            new { FullName = "Lerato Again", Email = email.ToLowerInvariant(), Password = TestPassword });

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Conflict, second.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", second.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    // ---- login ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_Returns_Access_Token_In_Body_And_Refresh_Token_Only_In_Cookie()
    {
        var (email, userId) = await RegisterAsync();

        var response = await LoginAsync(email);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);

        var cookie = CookieValue(response);
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(cookie));

        // the refresh token must NOT be in the body
        var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        Assert.DoesNotContain(cookie!, body);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("refreshToken", body, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        // cookie flags
        var setCookie = response.Headers.GetValues("Set-Cookie").First(v => v.StartsWith($"{CookieName}=")).ToLowerInvariant();
        Assert.Contains("httponly", setCookie);
        Assert.Contains("secure", setCookie);
        Assert.Contains("samesite=strict", setCookie);
        Assert.Contains("path=/api/v1/auth", setCookie);

        // the access token really works: own account 200, someone else's 403
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
        var token = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("accessToken").GetString()!;

        var own = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, $"/api/v1/users/{userId}");
        own.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await _client.SendAsync(own)).StatusCode);

        var other = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, $"/api/v1/users/{Guid.NewGuid()}");
        other.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, (await _client.SendAsync(other)).StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Wrong_Password_And_Unknown_Email_Return_Identical_Problem_Details()
    {
        var (email, _) = await RegisterAsync();

        var wrongPassword = await LoginAsync(email, "totally-wrong-password-1");
        var unknownEmail = await LoginAsync($"nobody{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, wrongPassword.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, unknownEmail.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", wrongPassword.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);

        // same status, title and detail (only the correlationId differs)
        Assert.Equal(await ProblemJson.ReadAsync(wrongPassword), await ProblemJson.ReadAsync(unknownEmail));
    }

    // ---- refresh ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_Rotates_The_Token()
    {
        var (email, _) = await RegisterAsync();
        var login = await LoginAsync(email);
        var first = CookieValue(login)!;

        var refreshed = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", first);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, refreshed.StatusCode);

        var second = CookieValue(refreshed)!;
        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);                         // a NEW refresh token
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(await AccessTokenAsync(refreshed)));

        // the new token works too
        var again = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", second);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, again.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Replaying_An_Old_Refresh_Token_Returns_401_And_Kills_The_Newer_Token()
    {
        var (email, _) = await RegisterAsync();
        var oldToken = CookieValue(await LoginAsync(email))!;

        var rotated = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", oldToken);
        var newToken = CookieValue(rotated)!;

        // replay the OLD token: 401
        var replay = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", oldToken);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, replay.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", replay.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);

        // the NEWER token is now dead as well (whole family revoked)
        var afterReuse = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", newToken);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, afterReuse.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_Without_A_Cookie_Returns_401()
    {
        var response = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", null);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    // ---- logout ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task After_Logout_Refreshing_Returns_401()
    {
        var (email, _) = await RegisterAsync();
        var token = CookieValue(await LoginAsync(email))!;

        var logout = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/logout", token);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NoContent, logout.StatusCode);

        var refresh = await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/refresh", token);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, refresh.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Logout_Is_Idempotent()
    {
        var (email, _) = await RegisterAsync();
        var token = CookieValue(await LoginAsync(email))!;

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NoContent, (await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/logout", token)).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NoContent, (await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/logout", token)).StatusCode);     // same token again
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NoContent, (await PostWithCookieAsync("/api/v1/auth/logout", null)).StatusCode);      // no cookie at all
    }

    // ---- secure by default ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task OpenApi_And_Scalar_Load_Without_A_Token()
    {
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await _client.GetAsync("/openapi/v1.json")).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await _client.GetAsync("/scalar/v1")).StatusCode);
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\ConcurrencyAndConstraintTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Npgsql;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Errors;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class ConcurrencyAndConstraintTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private readonly HttpClient _client = factory.CreateClient();

    // ---------- xmin concurrency ----------

    [Fact]
    public async Task Two_contexts_editing_the_same_payout_raise_DbUpdateConcurrencyException()
    {
        var payoutId = await TestDb.SeedPayoutAsync();

        // TWO contexts are required. Each context remembers the xmin it loaded. With ONE context there is
        // only one copy of the row in memory, and after our own save EF adopts the new xmin, so the context
        // can never see "someone else changed it". Conflicts only exist between two separate views of the row.
        await using var ctxA = TestDb.NewDb();
        await using var ctxB = TestDb.NewDb();

        var a = await ctxA.Payouts.SingleAsync(p => p.Id == payoutId);
        var b = await ctxB.Payouts.SingleAsync(p => p.Id == payoutId);   // both loaded the same version

        ctxA.Entry(a).Property(p => p.Amount).CurrentValue = 200m;
        await ctxA.SaveChangesAsync();                                    // first save wins and moves xmin forward

        ctxB.Entry(b).Property(p => p.Amount).CurrentValue = 300m;
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DbUpdateConcurrencyException>(() => ctxB.SaveChangesAsync());   // second is stale
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Http_update_with_a_stale_etag_returns_412_problem()
    {
        // Stokvel is used for the HTTP test because it is one of the entities that has an edit endpoint.
        // Payout has no edit endpoint in RondiTrack, and adding one would be a new feature.
        var created = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/stokvels",
            new { Name = $"Etag {Guid.NewGuid()}", ContributionAmount = 100m, Frequency = 1, MaxMembers = 5 });
        var location = created.Headers.Location!;

        var get = await _client.GetAsync(location);                      // GET: read the ETag
        var etag = get.Headers.ETag!.Tag;

        // First update with the token from the GET: must succeed.
        var first = await PutStokvelAsync(location, "First Name", etag);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, first.StatusCode);

        // Second update with the SAME (now stale) token: must be 412 as a problem response.
        var second = await PutStokvelAsync(location, "Second Name", etag);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.PreconditionFailed, second.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", second.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Http_update_without_if_match_returns_428_problem()
    {
        var created = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/stokvels",
            new { Name = $"NoEtag {Guid.NewGuid()}", ContributionAmount = 100m, Frequency = 1, MaxMembers = 5 });

        var response = await _client.PutAsJsonAsync(created.Headers.Location!,
            new { Name = "x", ContributionAmount = 100m, Frequency = 1, MaxMembers = 5 });

        Assert.Equal((HttpStatusCode)428, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    private Task<HttpResponseMessage> PutStokvelAsync(Uri url, string name, string etag)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, url)
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(new { Name = name, ContributionAmount = 100m, Frequency = 1, MaxMembers = 5 })
        };
        request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("If-Match", etag);
        return _client.SendAsync(request);
    }

    // ---------- unique constraints (straight to the database, no service check) ----------

    [Fact]
    public async Task Database_rejects_a_second_contribution_for_the_same_member_and_cycle()
    {
        var (stokvelId, userId, cycleId) = await TestDb.SeedMemberAndCycleAsync();

        await using (var db = TestDb.NewDb())
        {
            db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, 100m));
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        // Straight to the DbContext: ContributionService.ExistsAsync is bypassed, only the constraint is left.
        await using var db2 = TestDb.NewDb();
        db2.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, 100m));

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DbUpdateException>(() => db2.SaveChangesAsync());
        Assert.Equal(PostgresErrorCodes.UniqueViolation, Assert.IsType<PostgresException>(ex.InnerException).SqlState);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Database_rejects_paying_the_same_member_twice_in_one_stokvel()
    {
        var (stokvelId, userId, cycleId) = await TestDb.SeedMemberAndCycleAsync();

        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        var cycle2 = new ContributionCycle(stokvelId, 2, 100m);
        db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle2);
        db.Payouts.Add(new Payout(stokvelId, cycleId, userId, 100m));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        // Different cycle, same recipient, same stokvel: PayoutService would refuse, now the database does too.
        await using var db2 = TestDb.NewDb();
        db2.Payouts.Add(new Payout(stokvelId, cycle2.Id, userId, 100m));

        var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DbUpdateException>(() => db2.SaveChangesAsync());
        Assert.Equal(PostgresErrorCodes.UniqueViolation, Assert.IsType<PostgresException>(ex.InnerException).SqlState);
    }

    // ---------- the central handler turns 23505 into 409 ----------

    [Fact]
    public async Task Exception_handler_maps_a_unique_violation_to_409()
    {
        var handler = new RondiExceptionHandler(NullLogger<RondiExceptionHandler>.Instance);
        var context = new DefaultHttpContext();
        context.Response.Body = new MemoryStream();

        var postgres = new PostgresException("duplicate key", "ERROR", "ERROR", PostgresErrorCodes.UniqueViolation);
        var handled = await handler.TryHandleAsync(context, new DbUpdateException("dup", postgres), CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.True(handled);
        Assert.Equal(StatusCodes.Status409Conflict, context.Response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", context.Response.ContentType);
    }
}


----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\ContributionUnitTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

public class ContributionServiceTests
{
    private static (ContributionService service, IStokvelRepository stokvels, IUserRepository users, IContributionCycleRepository cycles) Build()
    {
        var stokvels = new InMemoryStokvelRepository();
        var users = new InMemoryUserRepository();
        var cycles = new InMemoryContributionCycleRepository();
        var contributions = new InMemoryContributionRepository();
        var idempotency = new InMemoryIdempotencyStore();
        var service = new ContributionService(stokvels, users, cycles, contributions, idempotency);
        return (service, stokvels, users, cycles);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RecordContribution_Throws_When_Same_User_Pays_Same_Cycle_Twice()

        await built.stokvels.AddAsync(stokvel);
        await built.users.AddAsync(user);

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\CycleCloseTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Time.Testing;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Jobs;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// 6.4: cycle-close job. Every test builds its own stokvel and passes ITS id to RunOnceAsync, so tests never touch each other's data.
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class CycleCloseTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    // SAST = UTC+2 all year (no daylight saving)
    private static DateTimeOffset Sast(int y, int m, int d, int h, int min) =>
        new(new DateTime(y, m, d, h, min, 0), TimeSpan.FromHours(2));

    private (CycleCloseJob Job, FakeTimeProvider Clock) MakeJob(DateTimeOffset now)
    {
        var clock = new FakeTimeProvider(now);
        var f = factory.WithWebHostBuilder(b => b.ConfigureServices(s =>
        {
            s.RemoveAll<TimeProvider>();
            s.AddSingleton<TimeProvider>(clock);
        }));
        return (f.Services.GetRequiredService<CycleCloseJob>(), clock);
    }

    private async Task<Guid[]> UsersAsync(int n)
    {
        var ids = new Guid[n];
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) ids[i] = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        return ids;
    }

    private async Task PayAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId, decimal amount)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, amount));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private async Task<(List<ContributionCycle> Cycles, List<Arrear> Arrears)> StateAsync(Guid stokvelId)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        var cycles = await db.ContributionCycles.AsNoTracking().Where(c => c.StokvelId == stokvelId).OrderBy(c => c.CycleNumber).ToListAsync();
        var arrears = await db.Arrears.AsNoTracking().Where(a => a.StokvelId == stokvelId).ToListAsync();
        return (cycles, arrears);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Ended_cycle_is_closed_underpayers_get_arrears_in_cents_and_next_cycle_exists()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(3);
        var endsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 3, 25);
        var (stokvelId, cycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member), (u[2], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, endsOn);
        await PayAsync(stokvelId, u[0], cycles[0], 500m);   // paid in full
        await PayAsync(stokvelId, u[1], cycles[0], 200m);   // short by R300
        // u[2] paid nothing: short by R500

        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 26, 0, 0));
        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);

        var (all, arrears) = await StateAsync(stokvelId);
        Assert.Equal(2, all.Count);
        Assert.NotNull(all[0].ClosedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(2, all[1].CycleNumber);
        Assert.Null(all[1].ClosedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(endsOn.AddMonths(1), all[1].EndsOn);
        Assert.Equal(2, arrears.Count);
        Assert.Equal(30000, arrears.Single(a => a.UserId == u[1]).ShortfallCents);
        Assert.Equal(50000, arrears.Single(a => a.UserId == u[2]).ShortfallCents);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(arrears, a => a.UserId == u[0]);   // paid in full = no arrear
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Cycle_that_ends_tomorrow_is_not_touched()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(2);
        var (stokvelId, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, new DateOnly(2026, 3, 26));

        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 25, 12, 0));   // "today" is the 25th, cycle ends on the 26th
        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);

        var (all, arrears) = await StateAsync(stokvelId);
        Assert.Single(all);
        Assert.Null(all[0].ClosedAtUtc);
        Assert.Empty(arrears);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Time_zone_boundary_stays_open_at_2359_SAST_and_closes_at_0000_SAST()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(2);
        var (stokvelId, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, new DateOnly(2026, 3, 25));

        var (job, clock) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 25, 23, 59));   // = 21:59 UTC
        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);
        Assert.Null((await StateAsync(stokvelId)).Cycles[0].ClosedAtUtc);   // still open

        clock.SetUtcNow(Sast(2026, 3, 26, 0, 0));                // = 22:00 UTC on the 25th
        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);
        Assert.NotNull((await StateAsync(stokvelId)).Cycles[0].ClosedAtUtc);   // closed
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Running_twice_gives_the_same_state_as_running_once()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(2);
        var (stokvelId, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, new DateOnly(2026, 3, 25));
        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 26, 8, 0));

        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);
        var once = await StateAsync(stokvelId);
        var second = await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);
        var twice = await StateAsync(stokvelId);

        Assert.Equal(0, second.CyclesClosed);
        Assert.Equal(once.Cycles.Count, twice.Cycles.Count);
        Assert.Equal(once.Arrears.Count, twice.Arrears.Count);
        Assert.Equal(once.Cycles.Select(c => c.ClosedAtUtc), twice.Cycles.Select(c => c.ClosedAtUtc));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Two_runs_at_the_same_time_close_the_cycle_once_and_record_each_arrear_once()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(3);
        var (stokvelId, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member), (u[2], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, new DateOnly(2026, 3, 25));
        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 26, 8, 0));

        // each RunOnceAsync creates its own scope + DbContext inside, like two replicas would
        var results = await Task.WhenAll(job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]), job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]));

        Assert.Equal(1, results.Sum(r => r.CyclesClosed));
        var (all, arrears) = await StateAsync(stokvelId);
        Assert.Equal(2, all.Count);                     // original + exactly one next cycle
        Assert.Equal(3, arrears.Count);                 // one per member
        Assert.Equal(3, arrears.Select(a => a.UserId).Distinct().Count());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Stokvel_three_cycles_behind_closes_all_missed_cycles_and_opens_the_current_one()
    {
        var u = await UsersAsync(2);
        var (stokvelId, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u[0], StokvelRole.Member), (u[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, new DateOnly(2026, 1, 25));
        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 4, 10, 9, 0));   // Jan 25, Feb 25 and Mar 25 are all over

        await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);
        var first = await StateAsync(stokvelId);

        Assert.Equal(4, first.Cycles.Count);
        Assert.All(first.Cycles.Take(3), c => Assert.NotNull(c.ClosedAtUtc));   // 3 missed cycles closed
        Assert.Null(first.Cycles[3].ClosedAtUtc);                                // current one is open
        Assert.Equal(new DateOnly(2026, 4, 25), first.Cycles[3].EndsOn);
        Assert.Equal(6, first.Arrears.Count);                                    // 2 members x 3 missed cycles

        var again = await job.RunOnceAsync([stokvelId]);                         // second run changes nothing
        var second = await StateAsync(stokvelId);
        Assert.Equal(0, again.CyclesClosed);
        Assert.Equal(4, second.Cycles.Count);
        Assert.Equal(6, second.Arrears.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task One_failing_stokvel_does_not_stop_another_and_the_job_does_not_throw()
    {
        var uA = await UsersAsync(2);
        var uB = await UsersAsync(2);
        var endsOn = new DateOnly(2026, 3, 25);
        var (bad, badCycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(uA[0], StokvelRole.Member), (uA[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, endsOn);
        var (good, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(uB[0], StokvelRole.Member), (uB[1], StokvelRole.Member)], 1, 500m, endsOn);

        // impossible state: an arrear already exists for an OPEN cycle -> the unique index makes the close fail
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(bad, badCycles[0], uA[0], 100, DateTime.UtcNow));
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        var (job, _) = MakeJob(Sast(2026, 3, 26, 8, 0));
        var result = await job.RunOnceAsync([bad, good]);   // must not throw

        Assert.Equal(1, result.StokvelsFailed);
        Assert.NotNull((await StateAsync(good)).Cycles[0].ClosedAtUtc);      // the healthy one closed
        var badState = await StateAsync(bad);
        Assert.Null(badState.Cycles[0].ClosedAtUtc);                         // the failed one is untouched (rolled back)
        Assert.Single(badState.Cycles);
        Assert.Single(badState.Arrears);                                     // only the pre-inserted one
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\ExceptionHandlerLoggingTests.cs -----
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Errors;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.2: the handler's logging rules, tested without HTTP or a database
public class ExceptionHandlerLoggingTests
{
    // builds the real handler with our capturing logger
    private static (RondiExceptionHandler Handler, CapturingLoggerProvider Logs) Build()
    {
        var logs = new CapturingLoggerProvider();
        var loggerFactory = LoggerFactory.Create(b => b.AddProvider(logs));
        return (new RondiExceptionHandler(loggerFactory.CreateLogger<RondiExceptionHandler>()), logs);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_4xx_Is_Logged_At_Information_With_The_Type_But_Not_The_Message()
    {
        var (handler, logs) = Build();
        var context = new DefaultHttpContext();
        context.Response.Body = new MemoryStream();   // the handler writes the response here

        await handler.TryHandleAsync(context, new DomainConflictException("secret-person@example.com"), CancellationToken.None);

        var entry = Assert.Single(logs.Entries);
        Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Information, entry.Level);                       // 4xx = Information
        Assert.Contains("DomainConflictException", entry.Message);             // the type is logged
        Assert.DoesNotContain("secret-person@example.com", entry.AllText);    // the message is not
        Assert.Null(entry.Exception);                                          // no stack trace for a 4xx
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_5xx_Is_Logged_At_Error_With_The_Exception_And_The_Client_Gets_A_Generic_Detail()
    {
        var (handler, logs) = Build();
        var context = new DefaultHttpContext();
        context.Response.Body = new MemoryStream();

        await handler.TryHandleAsync(context, new InvalidOperationException("internal-detail"), CancellationToken.None);

        var entry = Assert.Single(logs.Entries);
        Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Error, entry.Level);                  // 5xx = Error
        Assert.Contains("internal-detail", entry.Exception);        // the full exception is in the log

        context.Response.Body.Position = 0;
        var body = await new StreamReader(context.Response.Body).ReadToEndAsync();
        Assert.DoesNotContain("internal-detail", body);             // but never in the response
        Assert.Contains("An unexpected error occurred.", body);     // generic detail
        Assert.Contains("correlationId", body);                     // plus the id to quote
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\FrontendContractTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// 6.3: what a BROWSER needs: CORS, 429 contract, idempotency under 429, home screen, error contract
// ADJUST: if your other tests get the factory differently (collection fixture), change this constructor.
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class FrontendContractTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    // 6.3: each test builds its OWN host with its OWN settings, so it never uses up the shared allowance
    private WebApplicationFactory<Program> With(params (string Key, string Value)[] settings) =>
        factory.WithWebHostBuilder(b => { foreach (var (k, v) in settings) b.UseSetting(k, v); });

    private static HttpClient AuthedClient(WebApplicationFactory<Program> f, Guid userId)
    {
        var c = f.CreateClient();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", TestSeed.Token(f.Services, userId));
        return c;
    }

    private static HttpRequestMessage ContributionPost(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId, string key)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions")
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(new { userId, cycleId, amount = 100m })
        };
        req.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", key);
        return req;
    }

    // ---------------- CORS ----------------
    [Fact]
    public async Task Preflight_from_frontend_with_idempotency_key_is_allowed_with_credentials()
    {
        using var f = With(("Cors:AllowedOrigins:0", "http://localhost:3000"));
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Options, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}/contributions");
        req.Headers.Add("Origin", "http://localhost:3000");
        req.Headers.Add("Access-Control-Request-Method", "POST");
        req.Headers.Add("Access-Control-Request-Headers", "idempotency-key,content-type,authorization");

        var res = await f.CreateClient().SendAsync(req);

        Assert.True(res.IsSuccessStatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("http://localhost:3000", res.Headers.GetValues("Access-Control-Allow-Origin").Single());
        Assert.Equal("true", res.Headers.GetValues("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials").Single());
        Assert.Contains("idempotency-key",
            string.Join(",", res.Headers.GetValues("Access-Control-Allow-Headers")), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Preflight_from_another_origin_gets_no_cors_headers()
    {
        using var f = With(("Cors:AllowedOrigins:0", "http://localhost:3000"));
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Options, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}/contributions");
        req.Headers.Add("Origin", "http://evil.example");
        req.Headers.Add("Access-Control-Request-Method", "POST");

        var res = await f.CreateClient().SendAsync(req);

        Assert.False(res.Headers.Contains("Access-Control-Allow-Origin"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Stokvel_scoped_404_with_an_origin_carries_cors_header()
    {
        using var f = With(("Cors:AllowedOrigins:0", "http://localhost:3000"));
        var outsider = Guid.NewGuid();                                     // signed in, member of nothing
        var client = AuthedClient(f, outsider);
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}/cycles");
        req.Headers.Add("Origin", "http://localhost:3000");

        var res = await client.SendAsync(req);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, res.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("http://localhost:3000", res.Headers.GetValues("Access-Control-Allow-Origin").Single());
    }

    // ---------------- Rate limiting ----------------
    [Fact]
    public async Task Login_returns_429_problem_json_with_retry_after_once_limit_is_passed()
    {
        using var f = With(("RateLimiting:Login:PermitLimit", "2"), ("RateLimiting:Login:WindowSeconds", "60"));
        var client = f.CreateClient();
        object body = new { email = "nobody@test.example", password = "wrong-password-123" };

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, (await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", body)).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, (await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", body)).StatusCode);
        var res = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", body);   // 3rd = over the limit

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests, res.StatusCode);
        Assert.True(res.Headers.Contains("Retry-After"));
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", res.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        Assert.True(doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("title", out _));
        Assert.True(doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("detail", out _));
        Assert.True(doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("correlationId", out _));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Rejected_request_does_not_use_its_idempotency_key()
    {
        var userId = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var (stokvelId, cycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services, [(userId, StokvelRole.Member)], cycles: 2);

        // 1 token, refills 1 every 2 seconds
        using var f = With(("RateLimiting:Contribution:TokenLimit", "1"),
                           ("RateLimiting:Contribution:TokensPerPeriod", "1"),
                           ("RateLimiting:Contribution:ReplenishSeconds", "2"));
        var client = AuthedClient(f, userId);

        // 1) uses the only token (cycle 1)
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, (await client.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, userId, cycles[0], "key-first"))).StatusCode);

        // 2) key K is rejected with 429 (must NOT be stored)
        var k = $"key-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests, (await client.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, userId, cycles[1], k))).StatusCode);

        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.5));   // wait out the short window

        // 3) same K now succeeds exactly once
        var ok = await client.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, userId, cycles[1], k));
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, ok.StatusCode);
        Assert.False(ok.Headers.Contains("Idempotency-Replayed"));

        // 4) third time = replay, not a second contribution
        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.5));   // let the bucket refill so it reaches the idempotency check
        var replay = await client.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, userId, cycles[1], k));
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, replay.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("true", replay.Headers.GetValues("Idempotency-Replayed").Single());

        // 5) exactly one row for that cycle
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        Assert.Equal(1, await db.Contributions.CountAsync(c => c.CycleId == cycles[1] && c.UserId == userId));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task One_users_money_limit_does_not_affect_another_user()
    {
        var u1 = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var u2 = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var (stokvelId, cycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(u1, StokvelRole.Member), (u2, StokvelRole.Member)], cycles: 2);

        using var f = With(("RateLimiting:Contribution:TokenLimit", "1"),
                           ("RateLimiting:Contribution:TokensPerPeriod", "1"),
                           ("RateLimiting:Contribution:ReplenishSeconds", "60"));
        var c1 = AuthedClient(f, u1);
        var c2 = AuthedClient(f, u2);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, (await c1.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, u1, cycles[0], $"k-{Guid.NewGuid():N}"))).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests, (await c1.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, u1, cycles[1], $"k-{Guid.NewGuid():N}"))).StatusCode);
        // user 2 still has a full bucket
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, (await c2.SendAsync(ContributionPost(stokvelId, u2, cycles[0], $"k-{Guid.NewGuid():N}"))).StatusCode);
    }

    // ---------------- Home screen ----------------
    [Fact]
    public async Task Home_shows_both_stokvels_with_the_right_role_in_each()
    {
        var user = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var other = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var (s1, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services, [(user, StokvelRole.Treasurer), (other, StokvelRole.Member)]);
        var (s2, _) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services, [(user, StokvelRole.Member), (other, StokvelRole.Treasurer)]);

        var res = await AuthedClient(factory, user).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/home");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, res.StatusCode);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        var roles = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("stokvels").EnumerateArray()
            .ToDictionary(x => x.GetProperty("stokvelId").GetGuid(), x => x.GetProperty("role").GetString());
        Assert.Equal(2, roles.Count);
        Assert.Equal("Treasurer", roles[s1]);
        Assert.Equal("Member", roles[s2]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Home_for_a_user_in_no_stokvels_is_an_empty_list_not_404()
    {
        var res = await AuthedClient(factory, Guid.NewGuid()).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/home");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, res.StatusCode);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        Assert.Equal(0, doc.RootElement.GetProperty("stokvels").GetArrayLength());
    }

    // ---------------- Error contract ----------------
    [Fact]
    public async Task Validation_failure_returns_errors_map_keyed_by_camelCase_field()
    {
        var client = AuthedClient(factory, Guid.NewGuid());
        var json = """{"name":"","contributionAmount":-5,"frequency":"Monthly","maxMembers":5}""";

        var res = await client.PostAsync("/api/v1/stokvels", new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, res.StatusCode);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        Assert.True(doc.RootElement.GetProperty("errors").TryGetProperty("name", out _));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Number_sent_as_string_is_400_without_internal_type_names()
    {
        var client = AuthedClient(factory, Guid.NewGuid());
        var json = """{"name":"X","contributionAmount":100,"frequency":"Monthly","maxMembers":"5"}""";

        var res = await client.PostAsync("/api/v1/stokvels", new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
        var body = await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, res.StatusCode);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("System.", body);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("Int32", body);
    }

    // ---------------- Refresh at the versioned path ----------------
    [Fact]
    public async Task Refresh_works_at_versioned_path()
    {
        using var f = With(("RateLimiting:Login:PermitLimit", "1000"));   // don't trip the login limit
        var client = f.CreateClient();
        var email = $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}@test.example";
        const string password = "Correct-Horse-9!";

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created,
            (await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register", new { fullName = "Refresh Tester", email, password })).StatusCode);
        var login = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", new { email, password });
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, login.StatusCode);

        var cookie = login.Headers.GetValues("Set-Cookie").Single(c => c.StartsWith("rondi_refresh="));
        Assert.Contains("path=/api/v1/auth", cookie, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);   // cookie moved with the routes
        var value = cookie.Split(';')[0]["rondi_refresh=".Length..];

        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/v1/auth/refresh");
        req.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Cookie", $"rondi_refresh={value}");   // test host is http, Secure cookie isn't auto-sent
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await client.SendAsync(req)).StatusCode);
    }

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\HealthAndCorrelationTests.cs -----
using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.2: probes work without a token, and every problem response carries the caller's trace id
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class HealthAndCorrelationTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private const string SentTraceId = "0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c";          // the trace id we send
    private const string Traceparent = $"00-{SentTraceId}-b7ad6b7169203331-01";   // W3C traceparent header value

    // ---- probes ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Liveness_Returns_200_Without_A_Token()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient().GetAsync("/health/live");   // no token on purpose

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("Healthy", await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());   // only the status word
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Readiness_Returns_200_Without_A_Token()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient().GetAsync("/health/ready");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("Healthy", await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
    }

    // ---- correlation id ----

    private static HttpRequestMessage WithTraceparent(string url)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, url);
        request.Headers.Add("traceparent", Traceparent);   // pretend the caller already has a trace
        return request;
    }

    private static async Task<string?> CorrelationIdAsync(HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        return doc.RootElement.GetProperty("correlationId").GetString();   // read it from the problem json
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Anonymous_401_Returns_The_Sent_Trace_Id_As_CorrelationId()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient()
            .SendAsync(WithTraceparent($"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}"));

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(SentTraceId, await CorrelationIdAsync(response));   // same id we sent
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Non_Member_404_Returns_The_Sent_Trace_Id_As_CorrelationId()
    {
        Guid stokvelId;
        await using (var db = TestDb.NewDb())
        {
            var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Corr {Guid.NewGuid()}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
            db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);   // a real stokvel with NO members
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            stokvelId = stokvel.Id;
        }

        var outsider = factory.CreateClientFor(Guid.NewGuid());   // signed in, but not a member
        var response = await outsider.SendAsync(WithTraceparent($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}"));

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(SentTraceId, await CorrelationIdAsync(response));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Framework_403_Returns_The_Sent_Trace_Id_As_CorrelationId()
    {
        var user = factory.CreateClientFor(Guid.NewGuid());   // not a platform admin
        var response = await user.SendAsync(WithTraceparent("/api/v1/stokvels"));   // platform admins only

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(SentTraceId, await CorrelationIdAsync(response));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Without_A_Traceparent_The_CorrelationId_Is_A_New_32_Character_Trace_Id()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient().GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}");

        Assert.Matches("^[0-9a-f]{32}$", await CorrelationIdAsync(response));   // 32 hex characters
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\HousekeepingTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using RondiTrack.Auth;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Jobs;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// 6.4: housekeeping must delete old rows WITHOUT weakening reuse detection or idempotency
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class HousekeepingTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private static string RandomHash() => Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32));   // 64 hex chars

    private async Task<Guid> TokenRowAsync(Guid userId, DateTime expiresAtUtc, string? hash = null, Guid? family = null)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        var t = new RefreshToken(userId, family ?? Guid.NewGuid(), hash ?? RandomHash(), DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-40), expiresAtUtc);
        db.RefreshTokens.Add(t);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return t.Id;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Token_inside_retention_survives_and_token_past_it_is_deleted()
    {
        var user = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var recent = await TokenRowAsync(user, DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1));    // expired yesterday (N = 30 days)
        var old = await TokenRowAsync(user, DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-31));      // expired 31 days ago

        var result = await factory.Services.GetRequiredService<HousekeepingJob>().RunOnceAsync();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        Assert.True(await db.RefreshTokens.AnyAsync(t => t.Id == recent));
        Assert.False(await db.RefreshTokens.AnyAsync(t => t.Id == old));
        Assert.True(result.RefreshTokensDeleted >= 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Reuse_detection_still_works_on_a_token_that_expired_yesterday()
    {
        var user = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var family = Guid.NewGuid();
        var (raw, hash) = factory.Services.GetRequiredService<ITokenService>().CreateRefreshToken();

        var spent = await TokenRowAsync(user, DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1), hash, family);     // old, already used, expired yesterday
        var live = await TokenRowAsync(user, DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(5), null, family);       // the user's current token, same login
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            await db.RefreshTokens.Where(t => t.Id == spent).ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(t => t.UsedAtUtc, (DateTime?)DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-2)));
        }

        await factory.Services.GetRequiredService<HousekeepingJob>().RunOnceAsync();   // must keep the spent token

        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/v1/auth/refresh");
        req.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Cookie", $"rondi_refresh={raw}");
        var res = await factory.CreateClient().SendAsync(req);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, res.StatusCode);
        using var scope2 = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db2 = scope2.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        Assert.NotNull((await db2.RefreshTokens.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(t => t.Id == live)).RevokedAtUtc);   // whole session revoked
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Idempotency_record_inside_retention_still_replays_and_an_old_one_is_deleted()
    {
        var user = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var (stokvelId, cycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services, [(user, StokvelRole.Member)]);
        var client = factory.CreateClient();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", TestSeed.Token(factory.Services, user));

        HttpRequestMessage Post(string key)
        {
            var r = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions")
            { Content = JsonContent.Create(new { userId = user, cycleId = cycles[0], amount = 100m }) };
            r.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", key);
            return r;
        }

        var key = $"hk-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, (await client.SendAsync(Post(key))).StatusCode);

        var oldKey = $"old-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            db.IdempotencyEntries.Add(new IdempotencyEntry(oldKey, RandomHash(), "{}", DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-200)));   // M = 168 h
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        await factory.Services.GetRequiredService<HousekeepingJob>().RunOnceAsync();

        var replay = await client.SendAsync(Post(key));
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, replay.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("true", replay.Headers.GetValues("Idempotency-Replayed").Single());   // still replays

        using var scope2 = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db2 = scope2.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        Assert.False(await db2.IdempotencyEntries.AnyAsync(e => e.Key == oldKey));          // the old one is gone
    }
}
