----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\LogLeakTests.cs -----
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.2: the log-leak test. No personal or secret data may reach a log, and a 409 is not an error.
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class LogLeakTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private const string CookieName = "rondi_refresh";
    private const string Amount = "1234.56";   // a distinctive amount to search for

    private readonly HttpClient _client = factory.CreateAnonymousClient();

    private sealed record IdDto(Guid Id);
    private sealed record TokenDto(string AccessToken);

    // reads the refresh token out of the Set-Cookie header
    private static string? CookieValue(HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        if (!response.Headers.TryGetValues("Set-Cookie", out var values)) return null;
        var line = values.FirstOrDefault(v => v.StartsWith($"{CookieName}="));
        return line?.Split(';')[0][(CookieName.Length + 1)..];
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task No_Log_Line_Contains_Personal_Or_Secret_Data_And_A_409_Is_Not_An_Error()
    {
        var logStart = factory.CapturedLogs.Entries.Count;   // only look at lines written by THIS test
        var email = $"leak{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com";
        var password = $"pw-{Guid.NewGuid():N}-xyz";

        // 1. register
        var register = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register",
            new { FullName = "Leak Tester", Email = email, Password = password });
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, register.StatusCode);
        var userId = (await register.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdDto>())!.Id;

        // 2. log in
        var login = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/login", new { Email = email, Password = password });
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, login.StatusCode);
        var accessToken1 = (await login.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<TokenDto>())!.AccessToken;
        var refreshToken1 = CookieValue(login)!;

        // 3. refresh (rotates both tokens)
        var refreshRequest = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/api/v1/auth/refresh");
        refreshRequest.Headers.Add("Cookie", $"{CookieName}={refreshToken1}");
        var refresh = await _client.SendAsync(refreshRequest);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, refresh.StatusCode);
        var accessToken2 = (await refresh.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<TokenDto>())!.AccessToken;
        var refreshToken2 = CookieValue(refresh)!;

        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(accessToken1));   // so we never search for an empty string
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(refreshToken2));

        // 4. record a contribution with the distinctive amount (user joins a fresh stokvel)
        Guid stokvelId, cycleId;
        await using (var db = TestDb.NewDb())
        {
            var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Leak {Guid.NewGuid()}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
            db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();   // parent first

            var cycle = new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, 1, 100m);
            db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, userId, 1));
            db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            stokvelId = stokvel.Id;
            cycleId = cycle.Id;
        }

        var contribution = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions")
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(new { UserId = userId, CycleId = cycleId, Amount = 1234.56m })
        };
        contribution.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", accessToken2);
        contribution.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", $"leak-{Guid.NewGuid()}");
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, (await _client.SendAsync(contribution)).StatusCode);

        // 5. trigger the duplicate-registration 409
        var beforeConflict = factory.CapturedLogs.Entries.Count;   // remember where the 409 logs start
        var duplicate = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/auth/register",
            new { FullName = "Leak Again", Email = email, Password = password });
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Conflict, duplicate.StatusCode);

        var all = factory.CapturedLogs.Entries.Skip(logStart).ToList();   // all lines from this test

        // the 409 must not be an Error, and the handler must have logged it at Information
        var forConflict = factory.CapturedLogs.Entries.Skip(beforeConflict).ToList();
        Assert.DoesNotContain(forConflict, e => e.Level >= LogLevel.Error);
        Assert.Contains(forConflict, e => e.Level == LogLevel.Information && e.Message.Contains("409"));

        // nothing secret or personal anywhere in the captured logs
        var secrets = new[] { email, password, accessToken1, accessToken2, refreshToken1, refreshToken2, Amount, "1234,56" };
        foreach (var entry in all)
            foreach (var secret in secrets)
                Assert.DoesNotContain(secret, entry.AllText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 8.1: tests for GET /api/v1/me, GET /api/v1/me/stokvels and the new fields on GET /api/v1/stokvels/{id}
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class MyStokvelsTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    // ---- helpers ----

    private static async Task<(Guid Id, string Email)> CreateUserAsync()
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        var email = $"me-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com";
        var user = new User("Me Tester", email);
        db.Users.Add(user);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return (user.Id, email);
    }

    // a stokvel (contribution R100) with one open cycle and the given members
    private static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid CycleId)> SeedStokvelAsync(
        string name, params (Guid UserId, StokvelRole Role)[] members)
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();

        var stokvel = new Stokvel(name, 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
        db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();   // parent first

        var cycle = new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, 1, 100m);
        var position = 1;
        foreach (var (userId, role) in members)
            db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, userId, position++, role));
        db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return (stokvel.Id, cycle.Id);
    }

    private static async Task<JsonDocument> ReadAsync(HttpResponseMessage response) =>
        JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());

    // ---- tests ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Me_Returns_The_Signed_In_Users_Details()
    {
        var (userId, email) = await CreateUserAsync();

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(userId).GetAsync("/api/v1/me");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);
        using var doc = await ReadAsync(response);
        Assert.Equal(userId, doc.RootElement.GetProperty("id").GetGuid());
        Assert.Equal(email, doc.RootElement.GetProperty("email").GetString());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Me_Without_A_Token_Returns_401()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient().GetAsync("/api/v1/me");
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, response.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task My_Stokvels_Is_200_With_An_Empty_List_For_A_User_In_No_Stokvels()
    {
        var (userId, _) = await CreateUserAsync();

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(userId).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/stokvels");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);   // NOT 404, NOT 403
        using var doc = await ReadAsync(response);
        Assert.Equal(0, doc.RootElement.GetArrayLength());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task My_Stokvels_Returns_My_Role_In_Each_Stokvel_And_Nothing_Else()
    {
        var (me, _) = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (other, _) = await CreateUserAsync();
        var nameA = $"Family {Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        var nameB = $"Work {Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        await SeedStokvelAsync(nameA, (me, StokvelRole.Treasurer));                                // Treasurer here
        await SeedStokvelAsync(nameB, (other, StokvelRole.Treasurer), (me, StokvelRole.Member));   // Member here
        await SeedStokvelAsync($"Not Mine {Guid.NewGuid():N}", (other, StokvelRole.Member));       // not mine

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(me).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/stokvels");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);
        using var doc = await ReadAsync(response);
        var items = doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray().ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, items.Count);   // only my two
        Assert.Equal("Treasurer", items.Single(i => i.GetProperty("name").GetString() == nameA).GetProperty("myRole").GetString());
        Assert.Equal("Member", items.Single(i => i.GetProperty("name").GetString() == nameB).GetProperty("myRole").GetString());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task My_Stokvels_Shows_Paid_And_Owed_For_The_Open_Cycle()
    {
        var (me, _) = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync($"Paid {Guid.NewGuid():N}", (me, StokvelRole.Member));

        await using (var db = TestDb.NewDb())
        {
            db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, me, cycleId, 40m));   // I paid R40 of R100
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(me).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/stokvels");

        using var doc = await ReadAsync(response);
        var item = doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray().Single();
        Assert.Equal(40m, item.GetProperty("paidThisCycle").GetDecimal());
        Assert.Equal(60m, item.GetProperty("owedThisCycle").GetDecimal());
        Assert.Equal(JsonValueKind.String, item.GetProperty("nextPayoutDateUtc").ValueKind);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Stokvel_Detail_Includes_My_Role_And_The_Current_Cycle_Summary()
    {
        var (me, _) = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync($"Detail {Guid.NewGuid():N}", (me, StokvelRole.Treasurer));

        await using (var db = TestDb.NewDb())
        {
            db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, me, cycleId, 100m));
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(me).GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, response.StatusCode);
        using var doc = await ReadAsync(response);
        Assert.Equal("Treasurer", doc.RootElement.GetProperty("myRole").GetString());
        Assert.Equal(1, doc.RootElement.GetProperty("memberCount").GetInt32());
        var cycle = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("currentCycle");
        Assert.Equal(1, cycle.GetProperty("cycleNumber").GetInt32());
        Assert.Equal(100m, cycle.GetProperty("collectedAmount").GetDecimal());
    }
}


----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\PagingTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 5.3: proves the paging contract through the real HTTP endpoint.
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class PagingTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private readonly HttpClient _client = factory.CreateClient();

    // Builds a stokvel with 3 members who each contributed once. Returns the list URL.
    private async Task<string> SeedThreeContributionsAsync()
    {
        var stokvel = (await (await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/stokvels",
            new { Name = $"Paging {Guid.NewGuid()}", ContributionAmount = 100m, Frequency = 1, MaxMembers = 5 }))
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdDto>())!;

        var cycle = (await (await _client.PostAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvel.Id}/cycles",
            new { CycleNumber = 1, TargetAmount = 100m })).Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdDto>())!;

        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var user = (await (await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/users",
                new { FullName = $"Pager {i}", Email = $"pager{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com" }))
                .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<IdDto>())!;
            await _client.PostAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvel.Id}/members", new { UserId = user.Id });

            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvel.Id}/contributions")
            {
                Content = JsonContent.Create(new { UserId = user.Id, CycleId = cycle.Id, Amount = 100m })
            };
            request.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", $"k-{Guid.NewGuid()}");
            await _client.SendAsync(request);
        }

        return $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvel.Id}/cycles/{cycle.Id}/contributions";
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Walking_all_pages_returns_every_row_once_and_ends_with_an_empty_token()
    {
        var url = await SeedThreeContributionsAsync();
        var seen = new List<Guid>();
        var token = "";

        do
        {
            var query = $"{url}?pageSize=2" + (token == "" ? "" : $"&pageToken={Uri.EscapeDataString(token)}");
            var page = (await _client.GetFromJsonAsync<PageDto>(query))!;
            seen.AddRange(page.Items.Select(i => i.Id));
            token = page.NextPageToken;
        } while (token != "");

        Assert.Equal(3, seen.Count);
        Assert.Equal(3, seen.Distinct().Count());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Negative_page_size_returns_400()
    {
        var url = await SeedThreeContributionsAsync();
        var response = await _client.GetAsync($"{url}?pageSize=-1");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Unknown_sort_field_returns_400()
    {
        var url = await SeedThreeContributionsAsync();
        var response = await _client.GetAsync($"{url}?sort=memberName");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Token_reused_with_a_different_sort_returns_400()
    {
        var url = await SeedThreeContributionsAsync();
        var first = (await _client.GetFromJsonAsync<PageDto>($"{url}?pageSize=1"))!;
        Assert.NotEqual("", first.NextPageToken);

        var response = await _client.GetAsync(
            $"{url}?pageSize=1&sort=-date&pageToken={Uri.EscapeDataString(first.NextPageToken)}");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response.StatusCode);
    }

    private sealed record IdDto(Guid Id);
    private sealed record PageDto(List<IdDto> Items, string NextPageToken);
}


----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\PayoutTransactionTest.cs -----
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Services;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

[Collection("Postgres collection")]   // CHANGED 5.4: makes sure the Testcontainers database is started first
public class PayoutTransactionTests
{
    // A hook that throws between the two writes, to force a failure mid-transaction
    private sealed class ThrowingHook : IPayoutFaultHook
    {
        public void AfterPayoutInserted() =>
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure after the payout insert");
    }

    // CHANGED 5.4: no more user-secrets, so it uses the Testcontainers database through TestDb
    private static RondiTrackDbContext NewDb() => TestDb.NewDb();

    // EDIT 5.2: with real foreign keys the parents (users, stokvel) must be saved BEFORE members, cycle and contributions.
    // It now returns the first member's UserId (StokvelMember has no Id any more).
    private static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid CycleId, Guid FirstUserId)> SeedAsync()
    {
        using var db = NewDb();

        var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Payout Test {Guid.NewGuid()}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
        var user1 = new User("Payout One", $"p1-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");
        var user2 = new User("Payout Two", $"p2-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");
        var cycle = new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, 1, 200m);

        db.Users.AddRange(user1, user2);
        db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                       // parents first

        db.StokvelMembers.AddRange(
            new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, user1.Id, 1),
            new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, user2.Id, 2));
        db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                       // then members and cycle

        db.Contributions.AddRange(
            new Contribution(stokvel.Id, user1.Id, cycle.Id, 100m),
            new Contribution(stokvel.Id, user2.Id, cycle.Id, 100m));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                       // then contributions

        return (stokvel.Id, cycle.Id, user1.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ProcessNextPayout_WhenItFailsAfterThePayoutInsert_LeavesNothingBehind()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId, _) = await SeedAsync();

        using (var db = NewDb())
        {
            // EDIT 5.2: PayoutService now takes the member repository too
            var service = new PayoutService(db, new ThrowingHook(), new EfStokvelMemberRepository(db));
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
                () => service.ProcessNextPayoutAsync(stokvelId, cycleId));
        }

        // Re-query with a brand new DbContext: the database is the evidence, not a status code
        using var verify = NewDb();
        Assert.Equal(0, await verify.Payouts.CountAsync(p => p.CycleId == cycleId));

        var cycle = await verify.ContributionCycles.SingleAsync(c => c.Id == cycleId);
        Assert.Equal(CycleStatus.Open, cycle.Status);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ProcessNextPayout_PaysTheFirstMemberInRotationAndMarksTheCyclePaidOut()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId, firstUserId) = await SeedAsync();

        using (var db = NewDb())
        {
            var result = await new PayoutService(db, new NoOpPayoutFaultHook(), new EfStokvelMemberRepository(db))
                .ProcessNextPayoutAsync(stokvelId, cycleId);

            Assert.Equal(firstUserId, result.RecipientUserId);   // EDIT 5.2: was RecipientMemberId
            Assert.Equal(200m, result.Amount);
        }

        using var verify = NewDb();
        Assert.Equal(1, await verify.Payouts.CountAsync(p => p.CycleId == cycleId));

        var cycle = await verify.ContributionCycles.SingleAsync(c => c.Id == cycleId);
        Assert.Equal(CycleStatus.PaidOut, cycle.Status);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.1: the authorization matrix, checked against the real database
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class StokvelAuthorizationTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    // ---- helpers ----

    private static async Task<Guid> CreateUserAsync()
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        var user = new User("Test User", $"u-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");
        db.Users.Add(user);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return user.Id;
    }

    // a stokvel + one cycle + memberships with the roles you ask for (users must already exist)
    private static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid CycleId)> SeedStokvelAsync(
        params (Guid UserId, StokvelRole Role)[] members)
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();

        var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Auth {Guid.NewGuid()}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
        db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                       // parent first

        var cycle = new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, 1, 100m);
        var position = 1;
        foreach (var (userId, role) in members)
            db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, userId, position++, role));
        db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return (stokvel.Id, cycle.Id);
    }

    private static async Task AddContributionAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId)
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, 100m));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private static async Task RemoveMembershipAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid userId)
    {
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        await db.StokvelMembers.Where(m => m.StokvelId == stokvelId && m.UserId == userId).ExecuteDeleteAsync();
    }

    private static Task<HttpResponseMessage> RecordAsync(HttpClient client, Guid stokvelId, Guid userId, Guid cycleId)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions")
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(new { UserId = userId, CycleId = cycleId, Amount = 100m })
        };
        request.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", $"k-{Guid.NewGuid()}");
        return client.SendAsync(request);
    }

    // the endpoint used for the 404 / 403 / 201 comparison: open a cycle (officer only)
    private static Task<HttpResponseMessage> OpenCycleAsync(HttpClient client, Guid stokvelId) =>
        client.PostAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles", new { CycleNumber = 2, TargetAmount = 100m });

    // ---- 401 ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Request_With_No_Token_Returns_401_Problem()
    {
        var response = await factory.CreateAnonymousClient().GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Request_With_A_Garbage_Token_Returns_401_Problem()
    {
        var client = factory.CreateAnonymousClient();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", "not.a.real-token");

        var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{Guid.NewGuid()}");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    // ---- 404 / 403 / success on the SAME endpoint ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Non_Member_Gets_404_On_An_Officer_Endpoint()
    {
        var outsider = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync();

        var response = await OpenCycleAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(outsider), stokvelId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Member_Without_The_Role_Gets_403_On_The_Same_Endpoint()
    {
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync((member, StokvelRole.Member));

        var response = await OpenCycleAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(member), stokvelId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, response.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(StokvelRole.Treasurer)]
    [InlineData(StokvelRole.Admin)]   // Admin is the chairperson role from 5.2
    public async Task Treasurer_Or_Chairperson_Succeeds_On_The_Same_Endpoint(StokvelRole role)
    {
        var officer = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync((officer, role));

        var response = await OpenCycleAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(officer), stokvelId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Platform_Admin_Succeeds_On_The_Same_Endpoint()
    {
        var (stokvelId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync();

        var response = await OpenCycleAsync(factory.CreateClient(), stokvelId);   // default client = platform admin

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.StatusCode);
    }

    // ---- refusal must not leak ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Non_Member_404_Looks_The_Same_As_A_Stokvel_That_Does_Not_Exist()
    {
        var outsider = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (realId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync();
        var fakeId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var client = factory.CreateClientFor(outsider);

        var real = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{realId}");
        var fake = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{fakeId}");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, real.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, fake.StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", real.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);
        Assert.Equal("application/problem+json", fake.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType);

        // same status, title and detail once the id is blanked out
        var (realStatus, realTitle, realDetail) = await ProblemJson.ReadAsync(real);
        var (fakeStatus, fakeTitle, fakeDetail) = await ProblemJson.ReadAsync(fake);
        Assert.Equal(realStatus, fakeStatus);
        Assert.Equal(realTitle, fakeTitle);
        Assert.Equal(realDetail!.Replace(realId.ToString(), "{id}"), fakeDetail!.Replace(fakeId.ToString(), "{id}"));
    }

    // ---- what a member may do ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Member_Can_View_Stokvel_Cycles_And_Contributions()
    {
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((member, StokvelRole.Member));
        var client = factory.CreateClientFor(member);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}")).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles")).StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles/{cycleId}/contributions")).StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Member_Records_Their_Own_Contribution()
    {
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((member, StokvelRole.Member));

        var response = await RecordAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(member), stokvelId, member, cycleId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Member_Is_Refused_When_Recording_Someone_Elses_Contribution()
    {
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var other = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((member, StokvelRole.Member), (other, StokvelRole.Member));

        var response = await RecordAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(member), stokvelId, other, cycleId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, response.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Treasurer_Can_Record_A_Contribution_For_Any_Member()
    {
        var treasurer = await CreateUserAsync();
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((treasurer, StokvelRole.Treasurer), (member, StokvelRole.Member));

        var response = await RecordAsync(factory.CreateClientFor(treasurer), stokvelId, member, cycleId);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.StatusCode);
    }

    // ---- payouts ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Member_Cannot_Process_A_Payout_But_A_Treasurer_Can()
    {
        var treasurer = await CreateUserAsync();
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((treasurer, StokvelRole.Treasurer), (member, StokvelRole.Member));
        await AddContributionAsync(stokvelId, member, cycleId);   // a payout needs at least one contribution

        var url = $"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles/{cycleId}/payouts";

        var asMember = await factory.CreateClientFor(member).PostAsync(url, null);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden, asMember.StatusCode);

        var asTreasurer = await factory.CreateClientFor(treasurer).PostAsync(url, null);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, asTreasurer.StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Non_Member_Gets_404_On_The_Payout_Endpoint()
    {
        var outsider = await CreateUserAsync();
        var member = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedStokvelAsync((member, StokvelRole.Treasurer));

        var response = await factory.CreateClientFor(outsider)
            .PostAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles/{cycleId}/payouts", null);

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, response.StatusCode);
    }

    // ---- the core design point ----

    [Fact]
    public async Task Removed_Member_With_A_Still_Valid_Token_Is_Refused_At_Once()
    {
        var treasurer = await CreateUserAsync();
        var (stokvelId, _) = await SeedStokvelAsync((treasurer, StokvelRole.Treasurer));
        var client = factory.CreateClientFor(treasurer);   // ONE token, used before and after

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, (await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}")).StatusCode);

        await RemoveMembershipAsync(stokvelId, treasurer);   // the chairperson removes them

        // same token, still not expired, but the database says they are out
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, (await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}")).StatusCode);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 7.2: what the styled stokvel view needs from the API
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class StokvelViewContractTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    // a stokvel with two members and three cycles: #1 PaidOut, #2 Closed, #3 Open
    private async Task<(Guid User, Guid Other, Guid Stokvel, Guid[] Cycles)> SeedAsync()
    {
        var user = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var other = await TestSeed.UserAsync(factory.Services);
        var (stokvelId, cycles) = await TestSeed.StokvelAsync(factory.Services,
            [(user, StokvelRole.Member), (other, StokvelRole.Member)], cycles: 3, amount: 500m);

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        await db.ContributionCycles.Where(c => c.Id == cycles[0])
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.Status, CycleStatus.PaidOut));
        await db.ContributionCycles.Where(c => c.Id == cycles[1])
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.ClosedAtUtc, (DateTime?)DateTime.UtcNow));
        return (user, other, stokvelId, cycles);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Cycle_list_is_newest_first_with_status_due_date_and_totals_in_cents()
    {
        var (user, _, stokvelId, cycles) = await SeedAsync();
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, user, cycles[2], 150.50m));
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        var res = await factory.CreateClientFor(user).GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, res.StatusCode);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        var items = doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray().ToList();
        Assert.Equal(new[] { 3, 2, 1 }, items.Select(i => i.GetProperty("number").GetInt32()));
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "Open", "Closed", "PaidOut" }, items.Select(i => i.GetProperty("status").GetString()));
        Assert.Equal(15050, items[0].GetProperty("collectedCents").GetInt64());
        Assert.Equal(0, items[1].GetProperty("collectedCents").GetInt64());
        Assert.Equal(100000, items[0].GetProperty("dueCents").GetInt64());   // R500 x 2 members
        Assert.EndsWith("Z", items[0].GetProperty("endsAt").GetString());     // every timestamp ends in Z
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Contributions_carry_cycle_id_cents_and_status_and_no_email()
    {
        var (user, other, stokvelId, cycles) = await SeedAsync();
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, user, cycles[2], 0.10m));   // 10 cents, Paid by default
            var confirmed = new Contribution(stokvelId, other, cycles[2], 150.50m);
            db.Contributions.Add(confirmed);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            await db.Contributions.Where(c => c.Id == confirmed.Id)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s.SetProperty(c => c.Status, ContributionStatus.Confirmed));
        }

        var res = await factory.CreateClientFor(user)
            .GetAsync($"/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles/{cycles[2]}/contributions");

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, res.StatusCode);
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        var items = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray().ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, items.Count);
        Assert.All(items, i =>
        {
            Assert.Equal(cycles[2], i.GetProperty("cycleId").GetGuid());
            Assert.False(i.TryGetProperty("memberEmail", out _));   // nothing extra
            Assert.False(i.TryGetProperty("amount", out _));        // cents only
        });
        Assert.Equal(new long[] { 10, 15050 }, items.Select(i => i.GetProperty("amountCents").GetInt64()).Order().ToList());
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "Confirmed", "Paid" }, items.Select(i => i.GetProperty("status").GetString()).Order().ToList());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Home_shows_only_the_callers_own_arrears_and_the_open_cycle_number()
    {
        var (user, other, stokvelId, cycles) = await SeedAsync();
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
            db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(stokvelId, cycles[1], user, 30000, DateTime.UtcNow));
            db.Arrears.Add(new Arrear(stokvelId, cycles[1], other, 50000, DateTime.UtcNow));
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        async Task<JsonElement> EntryAsync(Guid caller)
        {
            var res = await factory.CreateClientFor(caller).GetAsync("/api/v1/me/home");
            Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, res.StatusCode);
            var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
            return doc.RootElement.GetProperty("stokvels").EnumerateArray()
                .Single(s => s.GetProperty("stokvelId").GetGuid() == stokvelId).Clone();
        }

        var mine = await EntryAsync(user);
        Assert.Equal(30000, mine.GetProperty("arrearsCents").GetInt64());               // my own, not 80000
        Assert.Equal(50000, (await EntryAsync(other)).GetProperty("arrearsCents").GetInt64());

        var cycle = mine.GetProperty("currentCycle");
        Assert.Equal(3, cycle.GetProperty("number").GetInt32());                         // the closed and paid-out cycles are not current
        Assert.EndsWith("Z", cycle.GetProperty("endsAt").GetString());
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\TelemetryTests.cs -----
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;
using RondiTrack.Dtos;
using RondiTrack.Services;
using RondiTrack.Telemetry;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 6.2: the payout metric and the payout.process span
[Collection("Postgres collection")]   // starts the Testcontainers database first (TestDb needs it)
public class TelemetryTests
{
    // throws between the two writes, to force a failed payout
    private sealed class ThrowingHook : IPayoutFaultHook
    {
        public void AfterPayoutInserted() => throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure");
    }

    // a stokvel with one member, one cycle and one contribution, so a payout can succeed
    private static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid CycleId)> SeedPayableCycleAsync()
    {
        var (stokvelId, userId, cycleId) = await TestDb.SeedMemberAndCycleAsync();
        await using var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        db.Contributions.Add(new Contribution(stokvelId, userId, cycleId, 100m));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return (stokvelId, cycleId);
    }

    // builds the real PayoutService and runs one payout
    private static Task<PayoutResponse> PayAsync(Guid stokvelId, Guid cycleId, IPayoutFaultHook? hook = null)
    {
        var db = TestDb.NewDb();
        return new PayoutService(db, hook ?? new NoOpPayoutFaultHook(), new EfStokvelMemberRepository(db))
            .ProcessNextPayoutAsync(stokvelId, cycleId);
    }

    // built-in MeterListener: records the "outcome" tag of every payouts measurement
    private static MeterListener ListenToPayouts(List<string?> outcomes)
    {
        var listener = new MeterListener();
        listener.InstrumentPublished = (instrument, l) =>
        {
            if (instrument.Meter.Name == RondiTelemetry.MeterName && instrument.Name == RondiMetrics.PayoutsProcessedName)
                l.EnableMeasurementEvents(instrument);   // only listen to our payouts counter
        };
        listener.SetMeasurementEventCallback<long>((instrument, value, tags, state) =>
        {
            string? outcome = null;
            foreach (var tag in tags)
                if (tag.Key == "outcome") outcome = tag.Value?.ToString();
            lock (outcomes) outcomes.Add(outcome);
        });
        listener.Start();
        return listener;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_Successful_Payout_Increments_The_Payouts_Counter_With_Outcome_Success()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedPayableCycleAsync();
        var outcomes = new List<string?>();
        using var listener = ListenToPayouts(outcomes);

        await PayAsync(stokvelId, cycleId);

        lock (outcomes) Assert.Contains("success", outcomes);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_Refused_Payout_Is_Counted_As_Rejected_And_A_Broken_One_As_Error()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedPayableCycleAsync();
        var outcomes = new List<string?>();
        using var listener = ListenToPayouts(outcomes);

        await PayAsync(stokvelId, cycleId);                                                       // first payout works
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<DomainConflictException>(() => PayAsync(stokvelId, cycleId));   // already paid = rejected

        var (stokvel2, cycle2) = await SeedPayableCycleAsync();
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
            () => PayAsync(stokvel2, cycle2, new ThrowingHook()));                                // a bug mid-transaction = error

        lock (outcomes)
        {
            Assert.Contains("rejected", outcomes);
            Assert.Contains("error", outcomes);
        }
    }

    // records finished payout.process spans
    private static ActivityListener ListenToSpans(List<Activity> spans)
    {
        var listener = new ActivityListener
        {
            ShouldListenTo = source => source.Name == RondiTelemetry.ActivitySourceName,   // only our source
            Sample = (ref ActivityCreationOptions<ActivityContext> _) => ActivitySamplingResult.AllDataAndRecorded,
            ActivityStopped = activity => { lock (spans) spans.Add(activity); }
        };
        ActivitySource.AddActivityListener(listener);
        return listener;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Payout_Span_Carries_Safe_Tags_And_No_Error_Status_On_Success()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedPayableCycleAsync();
        var spans = new List<Activity>();
        using var listener = ListenToSpans(spans);

        await PayAsync(stokvelId, cycleId);

        Activity span;
        lock (spans) span = Assert.Single(spans, a => a.OperationName == "payout.process");
        Assert.Equal("success", span.GetTagItem("payout.outcome")?.ToString());
        Assert.Equal("1", span.GetTagItem("payout.cycle_number")?.ToString());
        Assert.NotEqual(ActivityStatusCode.Error, span.Status);

        // the payout was 100: no tag value may contain the amount
        Assert.All(span.TagObjects, t => Assert.DoesNotContain("100", t.Value?.ToString() ?? ""));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_Failed_Payout_Sets_The_Span_Status_To_Error()
    {
        var (stokvelId, cycleId) = await SeedPayableCycleAsync();
        var spans = new List<Activity>();
        using var listener = ListenToSpans(spans);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => PayAsync(stokvelId, cycleId, new ThrowingHook()));

        Activity span;
        lock (spans) span = Assert.Single(spans, a => a.OperationName == "payout.process");
        Assert.Equal(ActivityStatusCode.Error, span.Status);
        Assert.Equal("error", span.GetTagItem("payout.outcome")?.ToString());
        Assert.Equal("InvalidOperationException", span.GetTagItem("error.type")?.ToString());
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// NEW 5.3: helpers so tests can talk to PostgreSQL directly with their own DbContexts.
public static class TestDb
{
    // CHANGED 5.4: the factory sets this to the Testcontainers connection string
    public static string? ConnectionString { get; set; }

    // Every call returns a brand new, independent DbContext (own connection, own tracking).
    public static RondiTrackDbContext NewDb()
    {
        // CHANGED 5.4: no more user-secrets, so tests can never touch the dev database
        var connectionString = ConnectionString
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Test container is not started. Add [Collection(\"Postgres collection\")] to the test class.");

        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<RondiTrackDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql(connectionString, n => n.EnableRetryOnFailure(4, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), null))
            .Options;

        return new RondiTrackDbContext(options);
    }

    // A brand new stokvel + user + member + cycle, so a test never depends on leftover data.
    public static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid UserId, Guid CycleId)> SeedMemberAndCycleAsync()
    {
        await using var db = NewDb();

        var stokvel = new Stokvel($"Test {Guid.NewGuid()}", 100m, ContributionFrequency.Monthly, 5);
        var user = new User("Test Member", $"t-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");
        db.Users.Add(user);
        db.Stokvels.Add(stokvel);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                 // parents first

        var cycle = new ContributionCycle(stokvel.Id, 1, 100m);
        db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(stokvel.Id, user.Id, 1));
        db.ContributionCycles.Add(cycle);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return (stokvel.Id, user.Id, cycle.Id);
    }

    public static async Task<Guid> SeedPayoutAsync()
    {
        var (stokvelId, userId, cycleId) = await SeedMemberAndCycleAsync();
        await using var db = NewDb();
        var payout = new Payout(stokvelId, cycleId, userId, 100m);
        db.Payouts.Add(payout);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return payout.Id;
    }
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\TestSeed.cs -----
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using RondiTrack.Auth;
using RondiTrack.Data;
using RondiTrack.Domain;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// 6.3/6.4: shared helpers so each test builds its own users/stokvels (no leftovers between tests)
public static class TestSeed
{
    // Makes a real user row, returns its id
    public static async Task<Guid> UserAsync(IServiceProvider sp)
    {
        using var scope = sp.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();
        var u = new User("Test User", $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}@test.example");
        db.Users.Add(u);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return u.Id;
    }

    // Makes a stokvel with the given members/roles and N cycles.
    // firstEndsOn = null -> plain cycles (no end date, the job ignores them)
    public static async Task<(Guid StokvelId, Guid[] CycleIds)> StokvelAsync(
        IServiceProvider sp, (Guid UserId, StokvelRole Role)[] members, int cycles = 1,
        decimal amount = 500m, DateOnly? firstEndsOn = null,
        ContributionFrequency freq = ContributionFrequency.Monthly)
    {
        using var scope = sp.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RondiTrackDbContext>();

        var s = new Stokvel($"Test {Guid.NewGuid():N}", amount, freq, Math.Max(2, members.Length));
        db.Stokvels.Add(s);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();                         // parent first

        for (var i = 0; i < members.Length; i++)
            db.StokvelMembers.Add(new StokvelMember(s.Id, members[i].UserId, i + 1, members[i].Role));

        var ids = new List<Guid>();
        for (var n = 1; n <= cycles; n++)
        {
            var c = firstEndsOn is null
                ? new ContributionCycle(s.Id, n, amount)
                : new ContributionCycle(s.Id, n, amount, firstEndsOn.Value.AddMonths(n - 1), DateTime.UtcNow);
            db.ContributionCycles.Add(c);
            ids.Add(c.Id);
        }
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return (s.Id, ids.ToArray());
    }

    // Mints a real access token with the host's own TokenService (same key, same checks)
    public static string Token(IServiceProvider sp, Guid userId) =>
        sp.GetRequiredService<ITokenService>().CreateAccessToken(userId, false).Value;
}

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\UntrackedReadTests.cs -----
using RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Xunit;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests;

// EDIT 5.2: new file. Proves a PUT still persists now that every read is AsNoTracking
// EDIT 5.3: the PUT must now send If-Match (the ETag from the POST/GET), otherwise it is a 428.
[Collection("Postgres collection")]
public class UntrackedReadTests(PostgresApiFactory factory)
{
    private readonly HttpClient _client = factory.CreateClient();

    [Fact]
    public async Task Update_User_Persists_After_Untracked_Read()
    {
        var created = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/users",
            new { FullName = "Before Rename", Email = $"before{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com" });
        var user = (await created.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<UserDto>())!;
        var etag = created.Headers.ETag!.Tag;   // EDIT 5.3: the token comes back with the response

        var newName = $"Renamed {Guid.NewGuid()}";
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, $"/api/v1/users/{user.Id}")
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(new { FullName = newName, Email = $"after{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com" })
        };
        request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("If-Match", etag);   // EDIT 5.3
        var put = await _client.SendAsync(request);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, put.StatusCode);

        var get = await _client.GetFromJsonAsync<UserDto>($"/api/v1/users/{user.Id}");
        Assert.Equal(newName, get!.FullName);
    }

    private sealed record UserDto(Guid Id, string FullName);
}


----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\TestSupport\CapturingLoggerProvider.cs -----
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;

// One captured log line: the text, the exception text and the structured values
public sealed record CapturedLog(string Category, LogLevel Level, string Message, string? Exception, string Properties)
{
    public string AllText => $"{Message} {Exception} {Properties}";   // everything we search for leaks
}

// Test-only logger provider that remembers every log line in memory
public sealed class CapturingLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
{
    private readonly ConcurrentQueue<CapturedLog> _entries = new();   // safe when many requests log at once

    public IReadOnlyList<CapturedLog> Entries => _entries.ToArray();   // a snapshot copy

    public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => new CapturingLogger(categoryName, _entries);

    public void Dispose() { }

    private sealed class CapturingLogger(string category, ConcurrentQueue<CapturedLog> sink) : ILogger
    {
        public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null;

        public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;   // capture every level

        public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception,
            Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
        {
            var properties = state is IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> values
                ? string.Join(";", values.Select(v => $"{v.Key}={v.Value}"))   // structured values too
                : "";
            sink.Enqueue(new CapturedLog(category, logLevel, formatter(state, exception), exception?.ToString(), properties));
        }
    }
}

namespace RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;                       // folder is TestSupport, NOT Infrastructure

using System.Net.Http.Headers;                                // AuthenticationHeaderValue
using System.Security.Cryptography;                           // random test signing key
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;                           // IWebHostBuilder
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;                       // WebApplicationFactory
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;                          // UseNpgsql, MigrateAsync

using RondiTrack.Auth;                                        // ITokenService
using RondiTrack.Data;                                        // RondiTrackDbContext
using Testcontainers.PostgreSql;                              // the PostgreSQL container

public class PostgresApiFactory : WebApplicationFactory<Program>, IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly PostgreSqlContainer _container = new PostgreSqlBuilder("postgres:17")   // CHANGED: image goes in the constructor (removes the obsolete warning)
        .WithDatabase("ronditrack_test")                      // test database name
        .WithUsername("postgres")                             // test username
        .WithPassword("postgres")                             // test password
        .Build();                                             // create the container object

    // NEW 6.1: a random signing key made fresh on every run. Nothing is committed.
    private readonly string _jwtKey = Convert.ToBase64String(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(48));

    // NEW 6.2: every log line the app writes during a test run ends up here
    public CapturingLoggerProvider CapturedLogs { get; } = new();

    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        await _container.StartAsync();                        // start the Docker container first

        TestDb.ConnectionString = _container.GetConnectionString();   // TestDb helpers use the container too

        // Program.cs seeds data at startup (Development), so the tables must exist BEFORE the app starts.
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<RondiTrackDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql(_container.GetConnectionString())      // point at the container
            .Options;                                         // build the options
        await using var db = new RondiTrackDbContext(options); // temporary context just for migrating
        await db.Database.MigrateAsync();                     // create all tables in the empty container
    }

    protected override void ConfigureWebHost(IWebHostBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.ConfigureLogging(logging => logging.AddProvider(CapturedLogs));   // NEW 6.2: capture logs for the leak test

        // UseSetting (NOT ConfigureAppConfiguration) so Program.cs sees it at startup.
        // "RondiTrack" is the exact key your Program.cs reads.
        builder.UseSetting("ConnectionStrings:RondiTrack", _container.GetConnectionString());
        builder.UseSetting("Jwt:SigningKey", _jwtKey);
        builder.UseSetting("RateLimiting:Login:PermitLimit", "10000");   // old tests must not trip the limits
        builder.UseSetting("RateLimiting:Contribution:TokenLimit", "10000");
        builder.UseSetting("RateLimiting:Payout:TokenLimit", "10000");        // NEW 6.1: the app refuses to start without it
    }

    // NEW 6.1: every client made with CreateClient() starts signed in as a platform admin.
    // That is how the old tests (which know nothing about auth) keep passing without any change.
    protected override void ConfigureClient(HttpClient client)
    {
        base.ConfigureClient(client);
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
            new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", MintToken(Guid.NewGuid(), platformAdmin: true));
    }

    // NEW 6.1: makes a real access token with the app's own TokenService (same key, same validation path)
    public string MintToken(Guid userId, bool platformAdmin = false) =>
        Services.GetRequiredService<ITokenService>().CreateAccessToken(userId, platformAdmin).Value;

    // NEW 6.1: a client signed in as one specific (non-admin) user
    public HttpClient CreateClientFor(Guid userId)
    {
        var client = CreateClient();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", MintToken(userId));
        return client;
    }

    // NEW 6.1: a client with no token. Uses https and no cookie handling, so tests read Set-Cookie by hand.
    public HttpClient CreateAnonymousClient()
    {
        var client = CreateClient(new WebApplicationFactoryClientOptions
        {
            BaseAddress = new Uri("https://localhost"),
            HandleCookies = false,
            AllowAutoRedirect = false
        });
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = null;
        return client;
    }

    async Task IAsyncLifetime.DisposeAsync() => await _container.DisposeAsync(); // remove container after tests
}

[CollectionDefinition("Postgres collection")]                 // name the test classes use
public class PostgresCollection : ICollectionFixture<PostgresApiFactory> { } // one shared container for all tests

----- FILE: RondiTrack.Tests\TestSupport\ProblemJson.cs -----
namespace RondiTrack.Tests.TestSupport;

using System.Text.Json;

// NEW 6.1: reads a problem response so two responses can be compared
public static class ProblemJson
{
    public static async Task<(int Status, string? Title, string? Detail)> ReadAsync(HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
        var root = doc.RootElement;
        return (
            root.GetProperty("status").GetInt32(),
            root.TryGetProperty("title", out var title) ? title.GetString() : null,
            root.TryGetProperty("detail", out var detail) ? detail.GetString() : null);
    }
}

----- FILE: web\README.md -----
# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is enabled on this template. See [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler) for more information.

Note: This will impact Vite dev & build performances.
You can also try [the experimental native React Compiler support in plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react/README.md#rust-react-compiler) by using `compiler: true` in the plugin options instead of using the Babel plugin.

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

import type { components } from "./schema";

type Home = components["schemas"]["HomeResponse"];

// Total still owed across all stokvels, in integer cents (exact in JavaScript)
export function totalOwedCents(home: Home): number {
  return home.stokvels.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.owedCents, 0);
}

----- FILE: web\src\App.tsx -----
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { logout, onSignedOut, refreshAccessToken } from './auth/session';
import { Dashboard } from './components/Dashboard';
import { LoginForm } from './components/LoginForm';
import { queryClient } from './lib/queryClient';
import { clearSelectedStokvel } from './state/selectedStokvel';

type Status = 'checking' | 'signedIn' | 'signedOut';

export default function App() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('checking');

  useEffect(() => {
    // Sign-out (button OR failed refresh): show the form, clear the cache AND the selected stokvel
    const stopListening = onSignedOut(() => {
      setStatus('signedOut');
      clearSelectedStokvel();
      queryClient.clear();
    });
    // After a page reload, try the cookie once to see if the member is still signed in
    void refreshAccessToken().then((token) => setStatus(token ? 'signedIn' : 'signedOut'));
    return stopListening;
  }, []);

  if (status === 'checking') return <p>Loadingâ€¦</p>;
  if (status === 'signedOut') return <LoginForm onSignedIn={() => setStatus('signedIn')} />;

  return (
    <main style={{ maxWidth: 640, margin: '0 auto', padding: 16 }}>
      <header style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <h1>RondiTrack</h1>
        <button onClick={() => void logout()}>Sign out</button>
      </header>
      <Dashboard />
    </main>
  );
}

----- FILE: web\src\api\apiError.ts -----
// The one error type the whole app uses for failed API calls.
// problem = the problem+json body (read defensively, no hand-written API types).
export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly problem: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  readonly retryAfter: string | null; // raw Retry-After header text

  constructor(
    status: number,
    problem: Record<string, unknown> | null,
    retryAfter: string | null,
  ) {
    super(
      typeof problem?.title === 'string' ? problem.title : `Request failed with ${status}`,
    );
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.status = status;
    this.problem = problem;
    this.retryAfter = retryAfter;
  }
}

// Turns a failed Response into an ApiError (body may be empty, so we guard it)
export async function apiErrorFromResponse(res: Response): Promise<ApiError> {
  let problem: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  try {
    const body: unknown = await res.json();
    if (body && typeof body === 'object') problem = body as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    // no JSON body, that is fine
  }
  return new ApiError(res.status, problem, res.headers.get('Retry-After'));
}

----- FILE: web\src\api\client.ts -----
import createClient from 'openapi-fetch';
import type { paths } from './schema'; // generated by npm run api:types, never edited by hand
import { authFetch } from '../auth/session';
import { ApiError } from './apiError';
import { API_BASE_URL } from './config';

// The one client for the whole app; authFetch adds the token and handles refresh
export const api = createClient<paths>({ baseUrl: API_BASE_URL, fetch: authFetch });

// Returns the data or throws an ApiError (status + problem body + Retry-After)
export async function unwrap<T>(result: {
  data?: T;
  error?: unknown;
  response: Response;
}): Promise<T> {
  if (result.response.ok && result.data !== undefined) return result.data;
  const problem =
    result.error && typeof result.error === 'object'
      ? (result.error as Record<string, unknown>)
      : null;
  throw new ApiError(result.response.status, problem, result.response.headers.get('Retry-After'));
}

----- FILE: web\src\api\queries.ts -----
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api, unwrap } from './client';
import { queryKeys } from './queryKeys';

// Components only use these hooks, never api.GET or fetch directly.
// Removed useMe: my API has no /api/v1/me endpoint (noted in README Known gaps).

export function useHome() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.home,
    queryFn: async () => unwrap(await api.GET('/api/v1/me/home')),
  });
}

export function useStokvels() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.stokvels,
    queryFn: async () => unwrap(await api.GET('/api/v1/stokvels')),
  });
}

export function useStokvel(id: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.stokvel(id),
    // Changed: the path parameter is called stokvelId in my API
    queryFn: async () =>
      unwrap(await api.GET('/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}', { params: { path: { stokvelId: id } } })),
  });
}

export function useCycles(id: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.cycles(id),
    queryFn: async () =>
      unwrap(
        await api.GET('/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles', { params: { path: { stokvelId: id } } }),
      ),
  });
}

// Contributions are paged and belong to one cycle of one stokvel
export function useContributions(stokvelId: string, cycleId: string | undefined) {
  return useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.contributions(stokvelId, cycleId ?? ''),
    enabled: cycleId !== undefined, // wait until we know which cycle to load
    // NO placeholderData: keepPreviousData here. It would show the OLD stokvel's rows
    // under the NEW stokvel's key (the Part 4 trap).
    initialPageParam: undefined as string | undefined,
    queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) =>
      unwrap(
        await api.GET('/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/cycles/{cycleId}/contributions', {
          params: {
            path: { stokvelId, cycleId: cycleId ?? '' },
            query: { PageToken: pageParam }, // capital P, exactly as in my schema
          },
        }),
      ),
    // "" and null both mean "no next page" (check 4), so || undefined handles both
    getNextPageParam: (lastPage) => lastPage.nextPageToken || undefined,
  });
}

// NEW 7.4: all members of a stokvel (only a Treasurer needs this, so it is switched on by `enabled`).
export function useMembers(stokvelId: string, enabled: boolean) {
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.members(stokvelId),
    enabled,
    initialPageParam: undefined as string | undefined,
    queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) =>
      unwrap(
        await api.GET('/api/v1/stokvels/{stokvelId}/members', {
          params: { path: { stokvelId }, query: { pageToken: pageParam } },
        }),
      ),
    getNextPageParam: (lastPage) => lastPage.nextPageToken || undefined,
  });

  // Keep loading pages until there are no more, so the Treasurer can pick ANY member
  const { hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage } = query;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage) void fetchNextPage();
  }, [hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage]);

  return query;
}

----- FILE: web\src\api\queryKeys.ts -----
// Every key in one place. Data for one stokvel ALWAYS starts with ['stokvels', id],
// so invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.stokvel(id) }) refreshes one stokvel only.
export const queryKeys = {
  home: ['me', 'home'] as const,
  stokvels: ['stokvels'] as const,
  stokvel: (id: string) => ['stokvels', id] as const,
  cycles: (id: string) => ['stokvels', id, 'cycles'] as const,
  // Changed: contributions belong to a cycle in my API, so the cycle id is in the key too
  contributions: (id: string, cycleId: string) =>
    ['stokvels', id, 'cycles', cycleId, 'contributions'] as const,
  // NEW 7.4: the member list (a Treasurer picks from it)
  members: (id: string) => ['stokvels', id, 'members'] as const,
};

----- FILE: web\src\auth\session.test.ts -----
// @vitest-environment node
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { authFetch, login, onSignedOut, __resetSessionForTests } from './session';

const BASE = 'http://localhost:5134';

type Call = { auth: string | null; body: string };
let fake: {
  refreshCount: number;
  refreshOk: boolean;
  validToken: string; // the only token the fake API accepts
  nextToken: string; // what /auth/refresh hands out
  calls: Call[]; // every non-auth request the fake saw
};

const json = (data: unknown) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

beforeEach(() => {
  __resetSessionForTests(); // fresh module state for every test
  fake = { refreshCount: 0, refreshOk: true, validToken: 'new', nextToken: 'new', calls: [] };

  // Fake API. openapi-fetch passes a Request object, so we handle Request AND string URLs.
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const isReq = input instanceof Request;
    const url = isReq ? input.url : String(input);
    const headers = isReq ? input.headers : new Headers(init?.headers);

    if (url.endsWith('/auth/login')) return json({ accessToken: 'old' });
    if (url.endsWith('/auth/refresh')) {
      fake.refreshCount++;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20)); // delay so the race can really happen
      if (!fake.refreshOk) return new Response(null, { status: 401 });
      return json({ accessToken: fake.nextToken });
    }

    const body = isReq ? await input.clone().text() : String(init?.body ?? '');
    const auth = headers.get('Authorization');
    fake.calls.push({ auth, body });
    return auth === `Bearer ${fake.validToken}` ? json({ ok: true }) : new Response(null, { status: 401 });
  });
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

const get = () => authFetch(new Request(`${BASE}/api/v1/stokvels`));

describe('session', () => {
  it('five parallel 401s cause exactly one refresh', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw'); // token "old" is not accepted by the fake
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get(), get(), get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([200, 200, 200, 200, 200]);
  });

  it('a later expiry starts a new refresh', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    await Promise.all([get(), get(), get(), get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);

    // token "expires": the fake now only accepts "newer"
    fake.validToken = 'newer';
    fake.nextToken = 'newer';
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get()]);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(2); // the first promise was cleared
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([200, 200]);
  });

  it('a failed refresh signs out once', async () => {
    fake.refreshOk = false;
    const signedOut = vi.fn();
    onSignedOut(signedOut);
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    const responses = await Promise.all([get(), get()]);
    expect(signedOut).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1);
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(2); // each request sent once, never retried
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([401, 401]);
  });

  it('no token means no loop', async () => {
    fake.refreshOk = false; // fresh visitor: no cookie
    const res = await get();
    expect(fake.refreshCount).toBe(1); // one refresh attempt
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(1); // one request
    expect(res.status).toBe(401); // comes straight back
  });

  it('a POST body survives the retry', async () => {
    await login('a@b.c', 'pw');
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ amount: 500 });
    const res = await authFetch(
      new Request(`${BASE}/api/v1/contributions`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: payload,
      }),
    );
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(fake.calls).toHaveLength(2); // first try 401, retry 200
    expect(fake.calls[0].body).toBe(payload);
    expect(fake.calls[1].body).toBe(payload); // same body on the retry
  });
});

----- FILE: web\src\auth\session.ts -----
/*
 * WHY THE REFRESH MUST BE SINGLE-FLIGHT FOR MY API:
 * My API rotates the refresh cookie, so every refresh uses up the cookie it was sent with.
 * If five requests expire together and each sends its own refresh with the SAME old cookie,
 * the first wins and the other four are rejected ([FILL IN: the status you saw in check 5,
 * e.g. 401 or 409]), which would sign the member out. One shared refresh avoids that.
 *
 * This is the ONLY file in the project that reads or writes the access token.
 */
import { apiErrorFromResponse } from '../api/apiError';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../api/config';

// Token lives only in this variable (never in browser storage, JS-set cookies, or React state)
let accessToken: string | null = null;
// The refresh that is currently running (shared by everyone who asks at the same time)
let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
const signedOutListeners = new Set<() => void>();

// The rest of the app subscribes here to hear "member signed out"
export function onSignedOut(listener: () => void): () => void {
  signedOutListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    signedOutListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function notifySignedOut() {
  signedOutListeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

// Reads accessToken out of a JSON body without hand-writing a type
function tokenFrom(body: unknown): string | null {
  if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'accessToken' in body && typeof body.accessToken === 'string') {
    return body.accessToken;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/login`, {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'include', // so the browser stores the refresh cookie
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw await apiErrorFromResponse(res);
  const token = tokenFrom(await res.json());
  if (!token) throw new Error('Login response had no access token');
  accessToken = token;
}

export async function logout(): Promise<void> {
  const tokenBefore = accessToken;
  accessToken = null; // forget the token first, no matter what happens next
  try {
    await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/logout`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
      headers: tokenBefore ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenBefore}` } : {},
    });
  } catch {
    // network failed: we still sign out locally
  } finally {
    notifySignedOut(); // always tell the app
  }
}

// The real refresh call. Success stores the token; failure clears it and signs out.
async function doRefresh(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    const token = res.ok ? tokenFrom(await res.json()) : null;
    if (!token) throw new Error('refresh failed');
    accessToken = token;
    return token;
  } catch {
    accessToken = null;
    notifySignedOut();
    return null;
  }
}

export function refreshAccessToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  // SINGLE-FLIGHT: if a refresh is already running, everyone gets that same promise.
  // .finally clears it (success OR failure) so the next expiry can start a new refresh.
  refreshPromise ??= doRefresh().finally(() => {
    refreshPromise = null;
  });
  return refreshPromise;
}

// Sends a copy of the request with the token and cookie settings added
function send(req: Request, token: string | null): Promise<Response> {
  const headers = new Headers(req.headers);
  if (token) headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  return fetch(new Request(req, { headers, credentials: 'include' }));
}

// The fetch we hand to openapi-fetch
export async function authFetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  // A body can only be read once, so keep a clone for a possible retry
  const retryCopy = request.clone();

  // After a page reload memory is empty: get a token using the cookie first
  if (!accessToken) await refreshAccessToken();

  const tokenUsed = accessToken;
  const response = await send(request, tokenUsed);

  // Not a 401, or we had NO token to begin with: return now (this stops the endless loop)
  if (response.status !== 401 || !tokenUsed) return response;

  // If another request already got a newer token, use it instead of refreshing again
  const freshToken =
    accessToken && accessToken !== tokenUsed ? accessToken : await refreshAccessToken();

  if (!freshToken) return response; // refresh failed, doRefresh already signed us out
  return send(retryCopy, freshToken); // retry exactly once
}

// ONLY for tests: wipes module state between tests
export function __resetSessionForTests() {
  accessToken = null;
  refreshPromise = null;
  signedOutListeners.clear();
}

// NEW 7.4: the signed-in user's id, read from the "sub" claim of the access token.
// It lives here because this is the ONLY file allowed to touch the token. Returns null when signed out.
export function currentUserId(): string | null {
  if (!accessToken) return null;
  try {
    const payload = accessToken.split('.')[1];
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(atob(payload.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')));
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'sub' in parsed && typeof parsed.sub === 'string') {
      return parsed.sub;
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

        <label htmlFor="open-by-id">Open a stokvel by id (testing)</label>{' '}
        <input id="open-by-id" value={typedId} onChange={(e) => setTypedId(e.target.value)} />{' '}
        <button onClick={() => typedId && setSelectedStokvelId(typedId.trim())}>Open</button>
      </div>
